fields.name: Name
fields.description: Required. Label is Account Name. Name of the account. Maximum size is 255 characters. If the account has a record type of Person Account: This value is the concatenation of the FirstName, MiddleName, LastName, and Suffix of the associated person contact. You can't modify this value.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Type of account, for example, Customer, Competitor, or Partner.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: ID of the parent object, if any.

fields.name: BillingStreet
fields.description: Street address for the billing address of this account.

fields.name: BillingCity
fields.description: Details for the billing address of this account. Maximum size is 40 characters.

fields.name: BillingState
fields.description: Details for the billing address of this account. Maximum size is 80 characters.

fields.name: BillingPostalCode
fields.description: Details for the billing address of this account. Maximum size is 20 characters.

fields.name: BillingCountry
fields.description: Details for the billing address of this account. Maximum size is 80 characters.

fields.name: BillingLatitude
fields.description: Used with BillingLongitude to specify the precise geolocation of a billing address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields.

fields.name: BillingLongitude
fields.description: Used with BillingLatitude to specify the precise geolocation of a billing address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields.

fields.name: BillingGeocodeAccuracy
fields.description: Accuracy level of the geocode for the billing address. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields.

fields.name: BillingAddress
fields.description: The compound form of the billing address. Read-only. See Address Compound Fields for details on compound address fields.

fields.name: ShippingStreet
fields.description: The street address of the shipping address for this account. Maximum of 255 characters.

fields.name: ShippingCity
fields.description: Details of the shipping address for this account. City maximum size is 40 characters

fields.name: ShippingState
fields.description: Details of the shipping address for this account. State maximum size is 80 characters.

fields.name: ShippingPostalCode
fields.description: Details of the shipping address for this account. Postal code maximum size is 20 characters.

fields.name: ShippingCountry
fields.description: Details of the shipping address for this account. Country maximum size is 80 characters.

fields.name: ShippingLatitude
fields.description: Used with ShippingLongitude to specify the precise geolocation of a shipping address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields.

fields.name: ShippingLongitude
fields.description: Used with ShippingLatitude to specify the precise geolocation of an address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields.

fields.name: ShippingGeocodeAccuracy
fields.description: Accuracy level of the geocode for the shipping address. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields.

fields.name: ShippingAddress
fields.description: The compound form of the shipping address. Read-only. See Address Compound Fields for details on compound address fields.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: Phone number for this account. Maximum size is 40 characters.

fields.name: Fax
fields.description: Fax number for the account.

fields.name: AccountNumber
fields.description: Account number assigned to this account (not the unique, system-generated ID assigned during creation). Maximum size is 40 characters.

fields.name: Website
fields.description: The website of this account. Maximum of 255 characters.

fields.name: PhotoUrl
fields.description: Path to be combined with the URL of a Salesforce instance (for example, https://yourInstance.salesforce.com/) to generate a URL to request the social network profile image associated with the account. Generated URL returns an HTTP redirect (code 302) to the social network profile image for the account. Blank if Social Accounts and Contacts isn't enabled for the org or if Social Accounts and Contacts is disabled for the requesting user.

fields.name: Sic
fields.description: Standard Industrial Classification code of the company’s main business categorization, for example, 57340 for Electronics. Maximum of 20 characters. This field is available on business accounts, not person accounts.

fields.name: Industry
fields.description: An industry associated with this account. Maximum size is 40 characters.

fields.name: AnnualRevenue
fields.description: Estimated annual revenue of the account.

fields.name: NumberOfEmployees
fields.description: Label is Employees. Number of employees working at the company represented by this account. Maximum size is eight digits.

fields.name: Ownership
fields.description: Ownership type for the account, for example Private, Public, or Subsidiary.

fields.name: TickerSymbol
fields.description: The stock market symbol for this account. Maximum of 20 characters. This field is available on business accounts, not person accounts.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Text description of the account. Limited to 32,000 KB.

fields.name: Rating
fields.description: The account’s prospect rating, for example Hot, Warm, or Cold.

fields.name: Site
fields.description: Name of the account’s location, for example Headquarters or London. Label is Account Site. Maximum of 80 characters.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The ID of the user who currently owns this account. Default value is the user logged in to the API to perform the create. If you have set up account teams in your org, updating this field has different consequences depending on your version of the API: For API version 12.0 and later, sharing records are kept, as they are for all objects. For API version before 12.0, sharing records are deleted. For API version 16.0 and later, users must have the “Transfer Record” permission in order to update (transfer) account ownership using this field.

fields.name: LastActivityDate
fields.description: Value is one of the following, whichever is the most recent: Due date of the most recent event logged against the record. Due date of the most recently closed task associated with the record.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: Jigsaw
fields.description: References the ID of a company in Data.com. If an account has a value in this field, it means that the account was imported from Data.com. If the field value is null, the account was not imported from Data.com. Maximum size is 20 characters. Available in API version 22.0 and later. Label is Data.com Key. This field is available on business accounts, not person accounts.The Jigsaw field is exposed in the API to support troubleshooting for import errors and reimporting of corrected data. Do not modify the value in the Jigsaw field.

fields.name: CleanStatus
fields.description: Indicates the record’s clean status as compared with Data.com. Values are: Matched, Different, Acknowledged, NotFound, Inactive, Pending, SelectMatch, or Skipped. Several values for CleanStatus display with different labels on the account record detail page. Matched displays as In Sync Acknowledged displays as Reviewed Pending displays as Not Compared

fields.name: AccountSource
fields.description: The source of the account record. For example, Advertisement, Data.com, or Trade Show. The source is selected from a picklist of available values, which are set by an administrator. Each picklist value can have up to 40 characters.

fields.name: DunsNumber
fields.description: The Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) number is a unique, nine-digit number assigned to every business location in the Dun & Bradstreet database that has a unique, separate, and distinct operation. D-U-N-S numbers are used by industries and organizations around the world as a global standard for business identification and tracking. Maximum size is 9 characters. This field is available on business accounts, not person accounts.This field is only available to organizations that use Data.com Prospector or Data.com Clean.

fields.name: Tradestyle
fields.description: A name, different from its legal name, that an org may use for conducting business. Similar to “Doing business as” or “DBA”. Maximum length is 255 characters. This field is available on business accounts, not person accounts.This field is only available to organizations that use Data.com Prospector or Data.com Clean.

fields.name: NaicsCode
fields.description: The six-digit North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is the standard used by business and government to classify business establishments into industries, according to their economic activity for the purpose of collecting, analyzing, and publishing statistical data related to the U.S. business economy. Maximum size is 8 characters. This field is available on business accounts, not person accounts.This field is only available to organizations that use Data.com Prospector or Data.com Clean.

fields.name: NaicsDesc
fields.description: A brief description of an org’s line of business, based on its NAICS code. Maximum size is 120 characters. This field is available on business accounts, not person accounts.This field is only available to organizations that use Data.com Prospector or Data.com Clean.

fields.name: YearStarted
fields.description: The date when an org was legally established. Maximum length is 4 characters. This field is available on business accounts, not person accounts.This field is only available to organizations that use Data.com Prospector or Data.com Clean.

fields.name: SicDesc
fields.description: A brief description of an org’s line of business, based on its SIC code. Maximum length is 80 characters. This field is available on business accounts, not person accounts.

fields.name: OperatingHoursId
fields.description: The operating hours associated with the account. Available only if Field Service is enabled.

typeDefs.name: AccountSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an individual account, which is an organization or person involved with your business (such as customers, competitors, and partners).

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The name of the action link group template to use in code.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language of the MasterLabel.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The name of the action link group template.

fields.name: ExecutionsAllowed
fields.description: The number of times an action link can be executed. Values are:Once—An action link can be executed only once across all users. OncePerUser—An action link can be executed only once for each user. Unlimited—An action link can be executed an unlimited number of times by each user. If the action link’s actionType is Api or ApiAsync, you can’t use this value.

fields.name: HoursUntilExpiration
fields.description: The number of hours from when the action link group is created until it's removed from associated feed elements and can no longer be executed. The maximum value is 8,760.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: The location of the action link group within the feed element. Values are:Primary—The action link group is displayed in the body of the feed element. Overflow—The action link group is displayed in the overflow menu of the feed element.

fields.name: IsPublished
fields.description: If true, the action link group template is published. Action link group templates shouldn’t be published until at least one is associated with it. Once set to true, this can’t be set back to false.

typeDefs.name: ActionLinkGroupTemplateSObject
typeDefs.description: Action link templates let you reuse action link definitions and package and distribute action links. An action link is a button on a feed element. Clicking on an action link can take a user to another Web page, initiate a file download, or invoke an API call to an external server or Salesforce. Use action links to integrate Salesforce and third-party services into the feed. Every action link belongs to an action link group and action links within the group are mutually exclusive.

fields.name: ActionLinkGroupTemplateId
fields.description: ID of the with which this action link template is associated.

fields.name: LabelKey
fields.description: Key for the set of labels to display for these action link states: new, pending, success, failed. For example, the Approve set contains these labels: Approve, Pending, Approved, Failed. For a complete list of keys and labels, see Action Links Labels in the Connect REST API Developer Guide or the Apex Developer Guide.

fields.name: Method
fields.description: HTTP method for the action URL. One of these values:HttpDelete—Returns HTTP 204 on success. Response body or output class is empty. HttpGet—Returns HTTP 200 on success. HttpHead—Returns HTTP 200 on success. Response body or output class is empty. HttpPatch—Returns HTTP 200 on success or HTTP 204 if the response body or output class is empty. HttpPost—Returns HTTP 201 on success or HTTP 204 if the response body or output class is empty. Exceptions are the batch posting resources and methods, which return HTTP 200 on success. HttpPut—Return HTTP 200 on success or HTTP 204 if the response body or output class is empty. Ui and Download action links must use HttpGet.

fields.name: LinkType
fields.description: The type of action link. One of these values:Api—The action link calls a synchronous API at the action URL. Salesforce sets the status to SuccessfulStatus or FailedStatus based on the HTTP status code returned by your server. ApiAsync—The action link calls an asynchronous API at the action URL. The action remains in a PendingStatus state until a third party makes a request to /connect/action-links/actionLinkId to set the status to SuccessfulStatus or FailedStatus when the asynchronous operation is complete. Download—The action link downloads a file from the action URL. Ui—The action link takes the user to a web page at the action URL.

fields.name: Position
fields.description: An integer specifying the position of the action link template relative to other action links in the group. 0 is the first position.

fields.name: IsConfirmationRequired
fields.description: If true, a confirmation dialog appears before the action is executed.

fields.name: IsGroupDefault
fields.description: If true, action links derived from this template are the default or primary action in their action groups. There can be only one default action per action group.

fields.name: UserVisibility
fields.description: Who can see the action link. This value is set per action link, not per action link group. One of these values: Creator—Only the creator of the action link can see the action link. Everyone—Everyone can see the action link. EveryoneButCreator—Everyone but the creator of the action link can see the action link. Manager—Only the manager of the creator of the action link can see the action link. CustomUser—Only the custom user can see the action link. CustomExcludedUser—Everyone but the custom user can see the action link.

fields.name: UserAlias
fields.description: If you selected CustomUser or CustomExcludedUser for UserVisibility, this field is the alias for the custom user. Use the alias in a template binding to specify the custom user when an action link group is created using the template.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: A custom label to display on the action link button. If none of the LabelKey values make sense for an action link, use a custom label. Set the LabelKey field to None and enter a label name in the Label field.

fields.name: ActionUrl
fields.description: The action link URL. For example, a Ui action link URL is a Web page. A Download action link URL is a link to the file to download. Ui and Download action link URLs are provided to clients. An Api or ApiAsync action link URL is a REST resource. Api and ApiAsync action link URLs aren’t provided to clients. Links to Salesforce can be relative. All other links must be absolute and start with https://. Links to resources hosted on Salesforce servers can be relative, starting with a /. All other links must be absolute and start with https://. This field can contain context variables and binding variables in the form {!Bindings.key}, for example, https://www.example.com/{!Bindings.itemId}. Set the binding variable’s value when you instantiate the action link group from the template.

fields.name: RequestBody
fields.description: Template for the HTTP request body sent when corresponding action links are invoked. This field can be used only for Api and ApiAsync action links. This field can contain context variables and binding variables in the form {!Bindings.key}.

fields.name: Headers
fields.description: Template for the HTTP headers sent when corresponding action links are invoked. This field can be used only for Api and ApiAsync action links. This field can contain context variables and binding variables in the form {!Bindings.key}.

typeDefs.name: ActionLinkTemplateSObject
typeDefs.description: Action link templates let you reuse action link definitions and package and distribute action links. An action link is a button on a feed element. Clicking an action link can take a user to another Web page, initiate a file download, or invoke an API call to an external server or Salesforce. Use action links to integrate Salesforce and third-party services into the feed.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: Indicates the ID of the related account, which is determined as follows: The account associated with the WhatId, if it exists; or The account associated with the WhoId, if it exists; otherwise null For information on IDs, see ID Field Type.

fields.name: WhoId
fields.description: The WhoId represents a human such as a lead or a contact. WhoIds are polymorphic. Polymorphic means a WhoId is equivalent to a contact’s ID or a lead’s ID. The label is Name ID. If Shared Activities is enabled, the value of this field is the ID of the related lead or primary contact. If you add, update, or remove the WhoId field, you might encounter problems with triggers, workflows, and data validation rules that are associated with the record. The label is Name ID. If your organization uses Shared Activities, when you query activities in API version 30.0 or later, the returned value of the WhoId field matches the value in the queried object, not necessarily in the activity record itself. If Shared Activities is enabled, the value of this field is not populated and the field PrimaryWhoId should be queried instead.

fields.name: WhatId
fields.description: The WhatId represents nonhuman objects such as accounts, opportunities, campaigns, cases, or custom objects. WhatIds are polymorphic. Polymorphic means a WhatId is equivalent to the ID of a related object. The label is Related To ID.

fields.name: Subject
fields.description: Contains the subject of the task or event.

fields.name: IsTask
fields.description: If the value of this field is set to true, then the activity is a task. If the value is set to false, then the activity is an event. Label is Task.

fields.name: ActivityDate
fields.description: Indicates one of the following: The due date of a task The due date of an event if IsAllDayEvent is set to true

fields.name: ActivityDateTime
fields.description: Contains the event’s due date if the IsAllDayEvent flag is set to false. The time portion of this field is always transferred in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone. Translate the time portion to or from a local time zone for the user or the application, as appropriate. Label is Due Date Time.The value for this field and StartDateTime must match, or one of them must be null.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: Indicates the ID of the user or group who owns the activity.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Indicates the current status of a task, such as in progress or complete. Each predefined status field sets a value for IsClosed. To obtain picklist values, query TaskStatus.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Indicates the priority of a task, such as high, normal, or low.

fields.name: IsHighPriority
fields.description: Indicates a high-priority task. This field is derived from the Priority field.

fields.name: ActivityType
fields.description: Represents one of the following values: Call, Email, Meeting, or Other. Label is Type. These are default values, and can be changed.

fields.name: IsClosed
fields.description: Indicates whether a task is closed; value is always true. This field is set indirectly by setting the Status field on the task—each picklist value has a corresponding IsClosed value. Label is Closed.

fields.name: IsAllDayEvent
fields.description: If the value of this field is set to true, then the activity is an event spanning a full day, and the ActivityDate defines the date of the event. If the value of this field is set to false, then the activity may be an event spanning less than a full day, or it may be a task. Label is All-Day Event.

fields.name: IsVisibleInSelfService
fields.description: If the value of this field is set to true, then the activity can be viewed in the self-service portal. Label is Visible in Self-Service.

fields.name: DurationInMinutes
fields.description: Indicates the duration of the event or task.

fields.name: Location
fields.description: If the activity is an event, then this field contains the location of the event. If the activity is a task, then the value is null.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Contains a description of the event or task. Limit is 32 KB.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the activity has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

fields.name: CallDurationInSeconds
fields.description: Duration of the call in seconds.

fields.name: CallType
fields.description: The type of call being answered: Inbound, Internal, or Outbound.

fields.name: CallDisposition
fields.description: Represents the result of a given call, for example, “we'll call back,” or “call unsuccessful.” Limit is 255 characters.

fields.name: CallObject
fields.description: Name of a call center. Limit is 255 characters.

fields.name: ReminderDateTime
fields.description: Represents the time when the reminder is scheduled to fire, if IsReminderSet is set to true. If IsReminderSet is set to false, then the user may have deselected the reminder checkbox in the Salesforce user interface, or the reminder has already fired at the time indicated by the value.

fields.name: IsReminderSet
fields.description: Indicates whether a reminder is set for an activity (true) or not (false).

fields.name: EndDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the end date and time of the event or task. Available in versions 27.0 and later. This field is optional, depending on the following: If IsAllDayEvent is true, you can supply a value for either DurationInMinutes or EndDateTime. Supplying values in both fields is allowed if the values add up to the same amount of time. If both fields are null, the duration defaults to one day. If IsAllDayEvent is false, a value must be supplied for either DurationInMinutes or EndDateTime. Supplying values in both fields is allowed if the values add up to the same amount of time.

fields.name: StartDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the start date and time of the event. Available in versions 29.0 and later. If the event’s IsAllDayEvent flag is set to true (indicating an all-day event), then the time stamp in StartDateTime is always set to midnight in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone. Don’t attempt to alter the time stamp to account for any time zone differences. If the event’s IsAllDayEvent flag is set to false, then you must translate the time portion of the time stamp in StartDateTime to or from a local time zone for the user or the application, as appropriate. The translation must be in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone. If this field has a value, then ActivityDate and ActivityDateTime either must be null or must match the value of this field. If the activity is a task, StartDateTime is null

fields.name: ActivitySubtype
fields.description: Provides standard subtypes to facilitate creating and searching for specific activity subtypes. This field isn’t updateable. ActivitySubtype values: Task Email Call Event List Email

fields.name: AlternateDetailId
fields.description: The ID of a record the activity is related to which contains more details about the activity. For example, an activity can be related to an EmailMessage record.

typeDefs.name: ActivityHistorySObject
typeDefs.description: This read-only object is displayed in a related list of closed activities—past events and closed tasks—related to an object. It includes activities for all contacts related to the object. ActivityHistory fields for phone calls are only available if your organization uses Salesforce CRM Call Center.

fields.name: CallCenterId
fields.description: System field that contains the ID of the user who created the call center associated with this additional number. If value is null, this additional number is displayed in every call center's phone directory.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the additional number. Limit: 80 characters.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the additional number, such as Conference Room B. Limit: 255 characters.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: The phone number that corresponds to this additional number.

typeDefs.name: AdditionalNumberSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an optional additional number for a call center. This additional number is visible in the call center's phone directory.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: An auto-generated number identifying the address.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: A lookup field to the parent location.

fields.name: LocationType
fields.description: Picklist of location types. The available values are: Warehouse (default) Site Van Plant

fields.name: AddressType
fields.description: Picklist of address types. The values are: Mailing Shipping Billing Home

fields.name: Street
fields.description: The address street.

fields.name: City
fields.description: The address city.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The address state.

fields.name: PostalCode
fields.description: The address postal code.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: The address country.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Used with Longitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Used with Latitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: GeocodeAccuracy
fields.description: The level of accuracy of a location’s geographical coordinates compared with its physical address. A geocoding service typically provides this value based on the address’s latitude and longitude coordinates.

fields.name: Address
fields.description: The full address.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A brief description of the address.

fields.name: DrivingDirections
fields.description: Directions to the address.

fields.name: TimeZone
fields.description: Picklist of available time zones.

typeDefs.name: AddressSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a mailing, billing, or home address.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the AIInsightAction.

fields.name: AiRecordInsightId
fields.description: The unique ID of the associated AIRecordInsight.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The type of action. Possible values are: InvocableAction—Invocable Action Macro—Macro QuickAction—Quick action. StandardAction—Standard Action. An example standard action would be to update a record.

fields.name: Confidence
fields.description: Relative confidence strength of the generated prediction insight. Higher values (near 1.0) indicate stronger confidence.

fields.name: ActionName
fields.description: The ID of the action. For example, a value of “Case.SendEmail” indicates a send email quick action on Case.

fields.name: ActionId
fields.description: The unique ID of the associated action, such as the ID of a Macro.

typeDefs.name: AIInsightActionSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an Einstein prediction insight action.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the AIInsightFeedback.

fields.name: AiRecordInsightId
fields.description: The unique ID of the associated AIRecordInsight.

fields.name: AiInsightFeedbackType
fields.description: The nature of the feedback. Possible values are: Explicit—Explicit feedback. For example, a user applies and saves an Einstein recommendation on a case. Implicit—Implicit feedback. For example, a user edits or updates a case field without viewing or applying field recommendations from Einstein.

fields.name: AiFeedback
fields.description: The feedback user sentiment. Possible values are: Negative—Negative feedback Neutral—Neutral feedback Positive—Positive feedback

fields.name: Rank
fields.description: The feedback score.

fields.name: ValueId
fields.description: The unique ID of the associated AIInsightValue.

fields.name: ActualValue
fields.description: The raw feedback value. This field is null when no recommendation is selected.

typeDefs.name: AIInsightFeedbackSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an Einstein prediction insight feedback.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the AIInsightReason.

fields.name: AiInsightValueId
fields.description: The unique ID of the associated AIInsightValue.

fields.name: Intensity
fields.description: The intensity weight for this insight reason.

fields.name: Contribution
fields.description: The contribution weight for this insight reason.

fields.name: Variance
fields.description: The variance weight for this insight reason.

fields.name: FieldName
fields.description: The name of the field the insight uses for its evaluation.

fields.name: Operator
fields.description: The logical operator the insight uses to compare the field value with the expression value. For example, if the prediction evaluates whether the fieldValue for the field bonus__c is greater than $5,000, the logical operator is greater than.

fields.name: FieldValue
fields.description: The value for the field the insight uses for its evaluation.

fields.name: FeatureValue
fields.description: The value of the feature, such as TRUE or FALSE.

fields.name: FeatureType
fields.description: The type of the feature, such as BOOL.

typeDefs.name: AIInsightReasonSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an Einstein prediction insight reason.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the AIInsightValue.

fields.name: AiRecordInsightId
fields.description: The unique ID of the associated AIRecordInsight.

fields.name: AiInsightActionId
fields.description: The unique ID of the associated AIInsightAction.

fields.name: ValueType
fields.description: The data type of the prediction result insight value. Possible values are: Boolean—Boolean Currency—Currency DateTime—DateTime Enum—Enum Lookup—Lookup Number—Number String—String

fields.name: SobjectType
fields.description: The type of the value object, such as Account or Case, if this insight value references an object.

fields.name: Field
fields.description: The name of the target field Einstein is making predictions for, such as “AnnualRevenue”.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The prediction result insight value.

fields.name: FieldValueLowerBound
fields.description: The lower bound value.

fields.name: FieldValueUpperBound
fields.description: The upper bound value.

fields.name: Confidence
fields.description: Relative confidence strength of the generated prediction insight. Higher values (near 1.0) indicate stronger confidence.

fields.name: SobjectLookupValueId
fields.description: The unique ID of the value object, if this insight value references an object.

typeDefs.name: AIInsightValueSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an Einstein prediction insight value.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the AIRecordInsight.

fields.name: AiApplicationId
fields.description: The unique ID of the AiApplication that generated this prediction.

fields.name: TargetId
fields.description: The unique ID of the record Einstein is making predictions for.

fields.name: TargetSobjectType
fields.description: The type of the target object, such as Account or Case.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The type of insight. Possible values are: Action—An insight that indicates a suggested action, such as sending an email. Lookup—An insight that indicates a related value not directly related to the target object and field. MultiValue—An insight with multiple values, such as a multi-class classification. SimilarRecord—An insight that indicates similar or duplicate records. SingleValue—A single value insight, such as a regression number or a score.

fields.name: RunGuid
fields.description: A unique identifier for the Einstein process that made the prediction.

fields.name: RunStartTime

fields.name: ProviderType
fields.description: Required. The third-party authentication provider to use. Valid values include: Apple. Available in API version 48.0 and later. Facebook. Salesforce. Janrain. LinkedIn. Available in API version 32.0 and later. Twitter. Available in API version 32.0 and later. OpenIdConnect. Available in API version 29.0 and later. MicrosoftACS—Microsoft Access Control Service provides authentication for a Microsoft Office 365 service, like SharePoint Online. Available in API version 31.0 and later. GitHub—Provides authentication for a GitHub provider. Used to log in users of your Lightning Platform app to GitHub using OAuth. When logged in to GitHub, your app can make calls to GitHub APIs. The GitHub provider isn’t available as an SSO provider, so users can’t log in to your Salesforce org using their GitHub login credentials. Available in API version 35.0 and later. Custom—A provider configured with a custom authentication provider plug-in. Available in API version 36.0 and later.

fields.name: FriendlyName
fields.description: Required. A user-friendly name for the authentication provider.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: Required. Used when referring to the authentication provider from a program.

fields.name: RegistrationHandlerId
fields.description: An existing Apex class that implements the Auth.RegistrationHandler interface.

fields.name: ExecutionUserId
fields.description: Required when specifying a registration handler class. The username of the Salesforce admin or system user who runs the Apex handler, which provides the context in which the Apex handler runs. For example, if the Apex handler creates a contact, the creation can be easily traced back to the registration process. In production, use a system user. The user must have the Manage Users permission. Available in API version 27.0 and later.

fields.name: ConsumerKey
fields.description: The app’s key that is registered at the third-party (external) authentication provider. In API version 33.0 and later, for Salesforce-managed auth providers, leave the field blank to let Salesforce supply and manage the value.

fields.name: ConsumerSecret
fields.description: The consumer secret of the authentication provider that is registered at the third-party SSO provider. It’s used by the consumer for identification to Salesforce. In API version 33.0 and later, for Salesforce-managed auth providers, leave the field blank to let Salesforce supply and manage the value. You can create your own consumer secret on create(). However, after you set it, you can’t change the value.

fields.name: ErrorUrl
fields.description: A custom error URL for the authentication provider to use to report errors.

fields.name: AuthorizeUrl
fields.description: Required when creating an OpenID Connect authentication provider. The OAuth authorization endpoint URL. Available in API version 29.0 and later. In API version 33.0 and later, for Salesforce-managed auth providers, leave the field blank to let Salesforce supply and manage the value.

fields.name: TokenUrl
fields.description: The OAuth token endpoint URL of an OpenID Connect authentication provider. Available in API version 29.0 and later. In API version 33.0 and later, for Salesforce-managed auth providers, leave the field blank to let Salesforce supply and manage the value.

fields.name: UserInfoUrl
fields.description: The OpenID Connect endpoint URL of the OpenID Connect authentication provider. Available in API version 29.0 and later. In API version 33.0 and later, for Salesforce-managed auth providers, leave the field blank to let Salesforce supply and manage the value.

fields.name: DefaultScopes
fields.description: For OpenID Connect authentication providers, the scopes to send with the authorization request, if not specified when a flow starts. Available in API version 29.0 and later. In API version 33.0 and later, for Salesforce-managed auth providers, leave the field blank to let Salesforce supply and manage the value.

fields.description: Available when configuring an OpenID Connect authentication provider, the source of the authentication token in https: URI format. If provided, Salesforce validates the returned id_token value. OpenID Connect requires returning an id_token value with the access_token value. Available in API version 30.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsSendAccessTokenInHeader
fields.description: If enabled (true), the access token is sent to the UserInfoUrl in a header instead of a query string. Available in API version 30.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsSendClientCredentialsInHeader
fields.description: Required when creating an OpenID Connect authentication provider. If enabled (true), the client credentials are sent in a header to the tokenUrl instead of a query string. The credentials are in the standard OpenID Connect Basic Credentials header format, which is Basic <token>, where <token> is the base64-encoded string "clientkey:clientsecret". Available in API version 30.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsIncludeOrgIdInId
fields.description: Used to differentiate between users with the same user ID from two sources (such as two sandboxes). If enabled (true), Salesforce stores the org ID of the third-party identity in addition to the user ID. After you enable this setting, you can’t disable it. Applies only to a Salesforce-managed auth provider. Available in API version 32.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsSendSecretInApis
fields.description: Determines whether the encrypted consumer secret appears in API responses. If enabled (default), the secret appears in the response. If disabled (false), responses don’t include the consumer secret. For security, you can disable the setting. However, keep in mind that: By disabling this setting, the consumer secret is excluded from API responses in all API versions. Change sets and other metadata deployments break because both the consumer key and secret are expected. To fix this problem, insert the consumer key manually during deployment. Available in API version 47.0 and later.

fields.name: IconUrl

fields.name: LogoutUrl
fields.description: The destination for users after they log out if they authenticated using single sign-on. The URL must be fully qualified with an http or https prefix, such as https://acme.my.salesforce.com. Available in API version 33.0 and later.

fields.name: PluginId

fields.name: CustomMetadataTypeRecord

fields.name: EcKey

fields.name: AppleTeam
fields.description: Required when using Apple as a third-party authentication provider. A 10-character team ID, obtained from an Apple developer account. Available in API version 48.0 and later.

fields.name: SsoKickoffUrl

fields.name: LinkKickoffUrl

fields.name: OauthKickoffUrl
fields.description: The URL for obtaining OAuth access tokens for a third party. This field is read-only. Available in API version 43.0 and later.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Identifies the background operation.

fields.name: SubmittedAt
fields.description: When the operation was added to the job queue.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Status of the background operation. The options are: New Scheduled Canceled Merged Waiting Running Error Complete

fields.name: ExecutionGroup
fields.description: Applies only if the operation is merged with other operations into an execution group to be processed in bulk. Identifies the execution group.

fields.name: SequenceGroup
fields.description: Identifies the sequence group. Applies only if the operation is merged with other operations into an execution group to be processed in bulk. Within an execution group, operations can be placed into a sequence group to be executed in a specific order.

fields.name: SequenceNumber
fields.description: Order position within the sequence group. Applies only if the operation is merged with other operations into an execution group to be processed in bulk. Within an execution group, operations can be placed into a sequence group to be executed in a specific order.

fields.name: GroupLeaderId
fields.description: Applies only if the operation is merged with other operations into an execution group to be processed in bulk. Identifies the operation that’s selected as the leader of the execution group.

fields.name: StartedAt
fields.description: When the operation started running.

fields.name: FinishedAt
fields.description: When the operation reached the status of completed or error.

fields.name: WorkerUri
fields.description: URI of the worker that performed the operation. Example for a Salesforce Connect OData operation: services/data/v35.0/xds/upsert

fields.name: Timeout
fields.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for results after the operation started running.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description: After this time, the operation is removed from the asynchronous job queue. Applies only if the operation has a status of complete, canceled, error, or merged.

fields.name: NumFollowers
fields.description: Applies only if the operation is merged with other operations into an execution group to be processed in bulk. Number of other operations that are in the execution group.

fields.name: ProcessAfter
fields.description: The operation is scheduled to be processed after this time.

fields.name: ParentKey
fields.description: Tag that identifies related sets of operations, if any.

fields.name: RetryLimit
fields.description: Maximum number of retries to attempt. Applies only if the operation has an error status.

fields.name: RetryCount
fields.description: Number of attempted retries. Applies only if the operation has an error status.

fields.name: RetryBackoff
fields.description: Applies only if the operation has an error status. The first retry is attempted immediately. Each subsequent retry is increasingly delayed according to an exponential expression that’s multiplied by the RetryBackoff, in milliseconds. Specifically, the delay time is (2n-1)×R, where n is the RetryCount, and R is the RetryBackoff. The default value for RetryBackoff depends on the type of operation. For example, the RetryBackoff default for write operations on external objects is 1,000 milliseconds. For write operations, retries are attempted immediately, after 3 seconds, after 7 seconds, after 15 seconds, and so on.

fields.name: Error
fields.description: The error message for the operation. Applies only if the operation has an error status.

typeDefs.description: Represents a background operation in an asynchronous job queue.

fields.description: Required. The permission granted to the user of the shared file in a library. This is determined by the permission the user already has in the library. This field is available in API version 25.0 and later. V Viewer permission. The user can explicitly view but not edit the shared file. C Collaborator permission. The user can explicitly view and edit the shared file. I Inferred permission. The user’s permission is determined by the related record. For shares with a library, this is defined by the permissions the user has in that library. Inferred permission on shares with libraries and file owners is available in API versions 21.0 and later. Inferred permission on shares with standard objects is available in API versions 36.0 and later.

fields.name: Visibility
fields.description: Specifies whether this file is available to all users, internal users, or shared users. This field is available in API version 26.0 and later. Visibility can have the following values. AllUsers—The file is available to all users who have permission to see the file. InternalUsers—The file is available only to internal users who have permission to see the file. SharedUsers—The file is available to all users who can see the feed to which the file is posted. SharedUsers is used only for files shared with users, and is available only when an org has private org-wide sharing on by default. The SharedUsers value is available in API version 32.0 and later. Note the following exceptions for Visibility. AllUsers & InternalUsers values apply to files posted on standard and custom object records, but not to users, groups, or content libraries. For posts to a record feed, Visibility is set to InternalUsers for all internal users by default. External users can set Visibility only to AllUsers. On user and group posts, only internal users can set Visibility to InternalUsers. For posts to a user feed, if the organization-wide default for user sharing is set to private, Visibility is set to SharedUsers. Only internal users can update Visibility. Visibility can be updated on links to files posted on standard and custom object records, but not to users, groups, or content libraries. Visibility is updatable in API version 43.0 and later.

fields.name: ContentAssetId

fields.name: Field
fields.description: The name of the field that was changed. Possible values include: contentVersionCreated—A new version is created. contentVersionUpdated—The title, description, or any custom field on the version is changed. contentVersionDownloaded—A version is downloaded. contentVersionViewed—The version details are viewed. contentVersionRated—The version is rated. contentVersionCommented—The version receives a comment. contentVersionDataReplaced—The new version replaces the previous version, which can happen only when the new version is uploaded immediately after the previous version.

fields.name: OldValue
fields.description: The latest value of the field before it was changed.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

fields.description: ID of the document.

fields.name: IsLatest
fields.description: Indicates whether this is the latest version of the document (true) or not (false).

fields.name: ContentUrl
fields.description: URL for links. This is only set for links. One of the fields that determines the FileType. The character limit in API versions 33.0 and later is 1,300. The character limit in API versions 32.0 and earlier was 255.

fields.name: ContentBodyId
fields.description: Allows inserting a file version independently of the file blob being uploaded. This field is available for query and insert only. It can only point to a ContentBody record. This field is available in API version 40.0 and later.

fields.name: VersionNumber
fields.description: The version number. The number increments with each version of the document, for example, 1, 2, 3.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: The title of a document.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the content version.

fields.name: ReasonForChange
fields.description: The reason why the document was changed. This field can only be set when inserting a new version (revising) a document.

fields.name: SharingOption
fields.description: Controls whether sharing is frozen for a file. Only administrators and file owners with Collaborator access to the file can modify this field. Default is Allowed, which means that new shares are allowed. When set to Restricted, new shares are prevented without affecting existing shares. This field is available in API versions 35.0 and later.

fields.name: SharingPrivacy
fields.description: Controls sharing privacy for a file. Only administrators and file owners with Collaborator access to the file can modify this field. Default is Visible to Anyone With Record Access. When set to Private on Records, the file is private on records but can be shared selectively with others. This field is available in API versions 41.0 and later.

fields.name: PathOnClient
fields.description: The complete path of the document. One of the fields that determines the FileType.Specify a complete path including the path extension in order for the document to be visible in the Preview tab.

fields.name: RatingCount
fields.description: Read only. Total number of positive and negative ratings.

fields.name: ContentModifiedDate
fields.description: Date the document was modified. ContentModifiedDate updates when, for example, the document is renamed or a new document version is uploaded. When uploading the first version of a document, ContentModifiedDate can be set to the current time or any time in the past.

fields.name: ContentModifiedById
fields.description: ID of the user who modified the document.

fields.name: PositiveRatingCount
fields.description: Read only. The number of times different users have given the document a thumbs up. Rating counts for the latest version are not version-specific. If Version 1 receives 10 thumbs-up votes, and Version 2 receives 2 thumbs-up votes, the PositiveRatingCount on Version 2 is 12. However, rating counts are not retroactive for prior versions. The PositiveRatingCount on Version 1 is 10.

fields.name: NegativeRatingCount
fields.description: Read only. The number of times different users have given the document a thumbs down. Rating counts for the latest version are not version-specific. If Version 1 receives 10 thumbs-down votes, and Version 2 receives 2 thumbs-down votes, the NegativeRatingCount on Version 2 is 12. However, rating counts are not retroactive for prior versions. The NegativeRatingCount on Version 1 is 10.

fields.name: FeaturedContentBoost
fields.description: Read only. Designates a document as featured.

fields.name: FeaturedContentDate
fields.description: Date the document was featured.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: ID of the owner of this document.

fields.name: TagCsv
fields.description: Text used to apply tags to a content version via the API.

fields.name: FileType
fields.description: Type of content determined by ContentUrl for links or PathOnClient for documents.

fields.name: PublishStatus
fields.description: Indicates if and how the document is published. Valid values are: P—The document is published to a public library and is visible to other users. Label is Public. R—The document is published to a personal library and is not visible to other users. Label is Personal Library. U—The document is not published because publishing was interrupted. Label is Upload Interrupted.

fields.name: VersionData
fields.description: The content or body of the note, which can include properly formatted HTML or plain text. When a document is uploaded or downloaded via the API, it should be base64 encoded (for upload) or decoded (for download). Any special characters within plain text in the Content field must be escaped. You can escape special characters by calling content.escapeHtml4().

fields.name: ContentSize
fields.description: Size of the document in bytes. Always zero for links.

fields.name: FileExtension
fields.description: File extension of the document. This field is available in API version 31.0 and later.

fields.name: FirstPublishLocationId
fields.description: ID of the location where the version was first published. If the version is first published into a user's personal library or My Files, the field will contain the ID of the user who owns the personal library or My Files. In Lightning Experience, if the first version is published into a public library, the field will contain the ID of that library. Accepts all record IDs supported by ContentDocumentLink (anything a file can be attached to, like records and groups). Setting FirstPublishLocationId allows you to create a file and share it with an initial record/group in a single transaction, and have the option to create more links to share the file with other records or groups later. When a file is created, it’s automatically linked to the record, and PublishStatus will change to Public from Pending/Personal. This field is only set the first time a version is published via the API. FirstPublishLocationId can’t be set to another ID when a new content version is inserted.Salesforce updates the FirstPublishLocationId updates automatically when a new OwnerId is added to the ContentVersion. For example, when you publish a new version with a different OwnerId than the current OwnerId, the FirstPublishLocationId of all previous versions updates to the previous OwnerId. The new published version sets the FirstPublishLocationId to the new OwnerId.

fields.name: Origin
fields.description: The source of the content version. Valid values are: C—Content document from the user's personal library. Label is Content. The FirstPublishLocationId must be the user's ID. If FirstPublishLocationId is left blank, it defaults to the user's ID. H—Salesforce file from the user's My Files. Label is Chatter. The FirstPublishLocationId must be the user's ID. If FirstPublishLocationId is left blank, it defaults to the user's ID. Origin can only be set to H if Chatter is enabled for your organization. This field defaults to C. Label is Content Origin.

fields.name: ContentLocation
fields.description: Origin of the document. Valid values are: S—Document is located within Salesforce. Label is Salesforce. E—Document is located outside of Salesforce. Label is External. L—Document is located on a social network and accessed via Social Customer Service. Label is Social Customer Service.

fields.name: TextPreview
fields.description: A preview of a document. Available in API version 35.0 and later.

fields.name: ExternalDocumentInfo1
fields.description: Stores the URL of the file in the external content repository. The integration from the external source determines the content for this string. After the reference or copy is created, the URL of the external file is updated when you: Republish a file reference in Lightning Experience Open the document Create a file reference in the Connect REST API with reuseReference set to true. When the file is updated, the shared link is updated to the most current version.

fields.name: ExternalDocumentInfo2
fields.description: Contains the external file ID. Salesforce determines the content for this string, which is private. The content can change without notice, depending on the external system. After the file reference is created, this field isn’t updated, even if the file path changes.

fields.name: ExternalDataSourceId
fields.description: ID of the external document referenced in the ExternalDataSource object.

fields.name: Checksum
fields.description: MD5 checksum for the file.

fields.name: IsMajorVersion
fields.description: true if the document is a major version; false if the document is a minor version. Major versions can’t be replaced.

fields.name: IsAssetEnabled
fields.description: Can be specified on insert of ContentVersion to automatically convert a ContentDocument file into a ContentAsset. This field can be SOQL queried, but it can’t be edited. This field is available in API version 38.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: ContentVersionSObject

fields.name: ContentWorkspaceId
fields.description: Read only. ID of the library.

fields.name: ContentDocumentId
fields.description: Read only. ID of the library document.

fields.name: IsOwner
fields.description: Read only. Indicates whether the library owns the document and determines permissions for that document (true) or not (false). Documents can belong to more than one library, but only one library owns the document and determines its permissions.

fields.name: ContentWorkspaceId

fields.name: ContentWorkspacePermissionId

fields.name: MemberId

fields.name: MemberType

typeDefs.name: ContentWorkspaceMemberSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a member of a content library.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the library.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Provides the type of access a user has to a library. Valid values are: Library Administrator Author Viewer Custom

fields.name: PermissionsManageWorkspace
fields.description: Permission for user to perform any action in the library. This privilege is required to edit a library’s name and description, add or remove library members, or delete a library. Manage Library is a super permission which provides all other permission options listed except Deliver Content. Creating a library requires the Manage Salesforce CRM Content app permission or Create Libraries system permission.

fields.name: PermissionsAddContent
fields.description: Permission for user to publish new content to the library, upload new content versions, or restore archived (deleted) content. Content authors can also change any tags associated with their content and archive or delete their own content.

fields.name: PermissionsAddContentOBO
fields.description: Permission for user to choose an author when publishing content in the library.

fields.name: PermissionsArchiveContent
fields.description: Permission for user to archive and restore any content in the library.

fields.name: PermissionsDeleteContent
fields.description: Permission for user to delete any content in the library. Authors can undelete their own content from the Recycle Bin.

fields.name: PermissionsFeatureContent
fields.description: Permission for user to identify any content in the library as “featured.”

fields.name: PermissionsViewComments
fields.description: Permission for user to view comments.

fields.name: PermissionsAddComment
fields.description: Permission for user to post comments to any content in the library and view all comments in the library. Users can edit or delete their own comments.

fields.name: PermissionsModifyComments
fields.description: Permission for user to edit or delete comments made to any content in the library.

fields.name: PermissionsTagContent
fields.description: Permission for user to add tags when publishing content or editing content details in the library.

fields.name: PermissionsDeliverContent
fields.description: Permission for user to share content outside the org via a content delivery or public link.

fields.name: PermissionsChatterSharing
fields.description: Permission for user to make content from this library accessible outside of the library, sharing with a record or in Chatter. From a record or from Chatter, select a file from the library and attach it to a record or a post.

fields.name: PermissionsOrganizeFileAndFolder
fields.description: Permission for user to create, rename, and delete folders in libraries.

fields.name: Name

fields.name: Description

fields.name: TagModel
fields.description: The type of tagging assigned to a library. Valid values are: U — Unrestricted. No restrictions on tagging. Users can enter any tag when publishing or editing content. G — Guided. Users can enter any tag when publishing or editing content, but they are also offered a list of suggested tags. R — Restricted. Users must choose from a list of suggested tags.

fields.name: DefaultRecordTypeId
fields.description: ID of the default content type for the library. Content types are the containers for custom fields in Salesforce CRM Content.

fields.name: IsRestrictContentTypes
fields.description: Read only. Indicates whether content types have been restricted (true) or not (false).

fields.name: IsRestrictLinkedContentTypes
fields.description: Read only. Indicates whether linked content types have been restricted (true) or not (false).

fields.name: WorkspaceType

fields.name: ShouldAddCreatorMembership
fields.description: Automatically create a library membership for the user creating the library. Please note this field is not meant for query and always returns false in query. This field is available in API version 40.0 and later.

fields.name: RootContentFolderId
fields.description: ID of root folder of the library. This field is available in API version 39.0 and later.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description: The unique name of the library in the API. Allows a link to the library to be packaged when an asset file is added to a package. Limit: 15 characters. This field is available in API version 39.0 and later.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The unique name of the library in the API. Allows a link to the library to be packaged when an asset file is added to a package. Although libraries are not a packageable entity, references to libraries with a developer name will be included in the package when asset files are packaged. These links can then be restored in the target org.

fields.name: WorkspaceImageId
fields.description: ID of a library image. Image files can be assigned to libraries for branding and easy identification. Library image is visible to all users, even if they are not library members. This field is available in API version 43.0 and later.

A contact can play different roles on the same contract.

fields.name: IsPrimary
fields.description: Specifies whether this Contact plays the primary role on this Contract (true) or not (false). Note that each contract has only one primary contact role. Default is false. Labels is Primary.

fields.name: IsDeleted

fields.name: LineItemNumber
fields.description: Automatically-generated number that identifies the contract line item.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: ServiceContractId
fields.description: Required. ID of the ServiceContract associated with the contract line item. Must be a valid asset ID.

fields.name: Product2Id
fields.description: The product related to the contract line item.

fields.name: AssetId
fields.description: Required. ID of the Asset associated with the contract line item. Must be a valid asset ID.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: The first day the contract line item is in effect.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: The last day the contract line item is in effect.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the contract line item.

fields.name: PricebookEntryId
fields.description: Required. ID of the associated PricebookEntry.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Number of units of the contract line item (product) included in the associated service contract.

fields.name: UnitPrice

fields.name: Discount
fields.description: The discount for the product as a percentage.

A client application can use this information to show whether the unit price (or sales price) of the line item differs from the pricebook entry list price.

fields.name: Subtotal
fields.description: Contract line item's sales price multiplied by the Quantity.

fields.name: TotalPrice
fields.description: This field is available only for backward compatibility. It represents the total price of the ContractLineItem

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Status of the contract line item.

fields.name: ParentContractLineItemId
fields.description: The line item’s parent line item, if it has one.

fields.name: RootContractLineItemId
fields.description: (Read only) The top-level line item in a contract line item hierarchy. Depending on where a line item lies in the hierarchy, its root could be the same as its parent.

fields.name: LocationId

fields.name: AccountId

fields.name: Pricebook2Id
fields.description: ID of the pricebook, if any, associated with this contract.

fields.name: OwnerExpirationNotice

fields.name: StartDate

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: Read-only. Calculated end date of the contract. This value is calculated by adding the ContractTerm to the StartDate.

fields.name: BillingStreet

fields.name: BillingCity

fields.name: BillingState
fields.description: Details for the billing address. Maximum size is 80 characters.

fields.name: BillingPostalCode
fields.description: Details for the billing address of this account. Maximum size is 20 characters.

fields.name: BillingCountry
fields.description: Details for the billing address of this account. Maximum size is 80 characters.

fields.name: BillingLatitude

fields.name: BillingLongitude
fields.description: Used with BillingLatitude to specify the precise geolocation of a billing address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: BillingGeocodeAccuracy
fields.description: The accuracy of the geocode for the billing address.

fields.name: BillingAddress
fields.description: The compound form of the billing address. Read-only. See Address Compound Fields for details on compound address fields.

fields.name: ContractTerm
fields.description: Number of months that the contract is valid.

fields.name: OwnerId

fields.name: Status

fields.name: CompanySignedId

fields.name: CompanySignedDate
fields.description: Date on which the contract was signed by your organization.

fields.name: CustomerSignedId
fields.description: ID of the Contact who signed this contract.

fields.name: CustomerSignedTitle
fields.description: Title of the customer who signed the contract.

fields.name: CustomerSignedDate
fields.description: Date on which the customer signed the contract.

fields.name: SpecialTerms
fields.description: Special terms that apply to the contract.

fields.name: ActivatedById
fields.description: ID of the User who activated this contract.

fields.name: ActivatedDate
fields.description: Date and time when this contract was activated.

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.description: The status category for the contract. A contract can be Draft, InApproval, or Activated. Label is Status Category.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the contract.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

fields.name: ContractNumber

fields.name: LastApprovedDate

fields.name: LastActivityDate

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: StatusCode

fields.name: ConversationId

fields.name: Seq

fields.name: EntryTime

fields.name: EntryTimeMilliSecs

fields.name: EntryType
fields.description: The type of entry in the chat history. Can be a message (text) or an event. The possible values include: Text AdminOptedIn AdminOptedOut BotEscalated ChatbotClosedIdleSession ChatbotEndedChatByAction—Conversation ended by automated action ChatbotEndedTransferNotConfigured—Conversation ended because transfer fail is not configured ChatbotEstablished ChatbotNotEstablished EndUserOptedIn EndUserOptedOut

fields.name: ActorType
fields.description: The author of this entry in the chat history. The valid values include: Agent Bot EndUser Supervisor System

fields.name: ActorId
fields.description: The ID of the author. The possible values can be null or any ID in the following domain set: BotDefinition LiveChatVisitor MessagingEndUser User

fields.name: ActorName
fields.description: The name of the author sending the message or event.

fields.name: Message
fields.description: The message or event sent by the author.

fields.name: MessageStatus
fields.description: The status of the message sent by the author. The valid values include: Delivered Error Pending Read Sent

fields.name: MessageStatusCode
fields.description: The code associated with a message status. MessageStatusCode is only populated when a message is undeliverable

fields.name: MessageSendTime
fields.description: Unused field reserved for future use.

fields.name: MessageDeliverTime
fields.description: Unused field reserved for future use.

fields.name: MessageReadTime
fields.description: Unused field reserved for future use.

fields.name: HasAttachments
fields.description: Indicates whether a message has attachments associated with it (true) or not (false).

fields.name: EntryEndTime
fields.description: The timestamp that this entry ended in the chat history. This field is available in API version 48.0 and later.

fields.name: ClientTimestamp
fields.description: The timestamp sent by the client when it generated the entry. This field is available in API version 51.0 and later.

fields.name: ClientDuration
fields.description: The length in milliseconds for the entry. This field is used with voice messages and other applicable use cases. This value may be 0 if not set by the client. This field is available in API version 51.0 and later.

fields.name: ServerReceivedTimestamp
fields.description: The timestamp recorded when the server received the entry. This is a unique value and is used for ordering. This value can also be referred to as the “transcripted timestamp.” This field is available in API version 51.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: ConversationEntrySObject

fields.name: ConversationId

fields.name: AppType

fields.name: ParticipantContext

fields.name: LeftTime
fields.description: The date and time that a participant left a conversation.

fields.name: LastActiveTime
fields.description: The date and time that a participant was last active during a conversation.

typeDefs.name: ConversationParticipantSObject

fields.name: Name

fields.name: ConversationIdentifier

fields.name: StartTime
fields.description: The date and time that a conversation starts.

fields.name: EndTime
fields.description: The date and time that a conversation ends.

fields.name: ConversationChannelId
fields.description: The record ID of the channel used to initialize the conversation. This can either be a messaging channel for the Messaging product or a call center for the Service Cloud Voice product. Available in API version 50.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: ConversationSObject

It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. This field is automatically generated but you can supply your own value if you create the record using the API.When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. fields.name: Language
fields.description: This picklist contains the following fully-supported languages: Chinese (Simplified): zh_CN Chinese (Traditional): zh_TW Danish: da Dutch: nl_NL English: en_US Finnish: fi French: fr German: de Italian: it Japanese: ja Korean: ko Norwegian: no Portuguese (Brazil): pt_BR Russian: ru Spanish: es Spanish (Mexico): es_MX Spanish (Mexico) defaults to Spanish for customer-defined translations. Swedish: sv Thai: th The Salesforce user interface is fully translated to Thai, but Help is in English.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: Primary label for the CORS allowlist entry.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description: For managed packages, this field is the namespace prefix assigned to the package. For unmanaged packages, this field is blank.

fields.name: UrlPattern
fields.description: The origin URL pattern must include the HTTPS protocol (unless you’re using your localhost) and a domain name, and can include a port. The wildcard character (*) is supported and must be in front of a second-level domain name. For example, https://*.example.com adds all subdomains of example.com to the allowlist.

typeDefs.name: CorsWhitelistEntrySObject
typeDefs.description: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) enables web browsers to request resources from origins other than their own. For example, using CORS, JavaScript code at https://www.example.com could request a resource from https://www.salesforce.com. To access supported Salesforce APIs, Apex REST resources, and Lightning Out from JavaScript code in a web browser, add the origin serving the code to a Salesforce CORS allowlist.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the associated scheduled job.

fields.name: JobType
fields.description: The type of the associated scheduled job. The following are the available job types. Each job type label is listed with its value in parenthesis. Use the job type value when querying for a specific job type. 1—Data Export 3—Dashboard Refresh 4—Reporting Snapshot 6—Scheduled Flow 7—Scheduled Apex 8—Report Run 9—Batch Job A—Reporting Notification

typeDefs.name: CronJobDetailSObject
typeDefs.description: Contains details about the associated scheduled job, such as the job’s name and type.

fields.name: CronJobDetailId
fields.description: The ID of the CronJobDetail record containing more details about this scheduled job.

fields.name: NextFireTime
fields.description: The next date and time the job is scheduled to run. null if the job is not scheduled to run again.

fields.name: PreviousFireTime
fields.description: The most recent date and time the job ran. null if the job has not run before current local time.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The current state of the job. The job state is managed by the system. Possible values are: WAITING—The job is waiting for execution. ACQUIRED—The job has been picked up by the system and is about to execute. EXECUTING—The job is executing. COMPLETE—The trigger has fired and is not scheduled to fire again. ERROR—The trigger definition has an error. DELETED—The job has been deleted. PAUSED—A job can have this state during patch and major releases. After the release has finished, the job state is automatically set to WAITING or another state. BLOCKED—Execution of a second instance of the job is attempted while one instance is running. This state lasts until the first job instance is completed. PAUSED_BLOCKED—A job has this state due to a release occurring. When the release has finished and no other instance of the job is running, the job’s status is set to another state.

fields.name: StartTime
fields.description: The date and time when the most recent iteration of the scheduled job started.

fields.name: EndTime
fields.description: The date and time when the job either finished or will finish.

fields.name: CronExpression
fields.description: The cron expression used to initiate the schedule.

fields.name: TimeZoneSidKey
fields.description: Returns the timezone ID. For example, America/Los_Angeles.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: Owner of the job.

fields.name: TimesTriggered
fields.description: The number of times this job has been triggered.

typeDefs.name: CronTriggerSObject
typeDefs.description: Contains schedule information for a scheduled job. CronTrigger is similar to a cron job on UNIX systems. This object is available in API version 17.0 and later.

typeDefs.description: Represents a CSP Trusted Site. The Lightning Component framework uses Content Security Policy (CSP) to impose restrictions on content. The main objective is to help prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) and other code injection attacks. To use third-party APIs that make requests to an external (non-Salesforce) server or to use a WebSocket connection, add a CSP Trusted Site.

fields.description: Values include: MotifZeronaryColor—The background color for the header. Label is Zeronary motif color. If this CustomBrandAsset is for a network, this is the header color for the network. If it is for an org, this is the header color when users access the Salesforce mobile app. MotifPrimaryColor—The color used for the active tab. Label is Primary motif color. Not used for the Salesforce mobile app branding. MotifSecondaryColor—The color used for the top borders of lists and tables. Label is Secondary motif color.Not used for the Salesforce mobile app branding. MotifTertiaryColor—The background color for section headers on edit and detail pages. Label is Tertiary motif color.Not used for the Salesforce mobile app branding. MotifQuaternaryColor—If this CustomBrandAsset is for a network, this is the background color for network pages. If it is for an org, this is the background color on a splash page. Label is Quaternary motif color. MotifZeronaryComplementColor—Font color used with zeronaryColor. Label is Zeronary motif colors complement color. MotifPrimaryComplementColor—Font color used with primaryColor. Label is Primary motif colors complement color.Not used for the Salesforce mobile app branding. MotifTertiaryComplementColor—Font color used with tertiaryColor. Label is Tertiary motif colors complement color.Not used for the Salesforce mobile app branding. MotifQuaternaryComplementColor—Font color used with quaternaryColor. Label is Quaternary motif colors complement color.Not used for the Salesforce mobile app branding. PageHeader—An image that appears on the header of the pages. Can be an .html, .gif, .jpg, or .png file. Label is Page Header.Not used for the Salesforce mobile app branding. PageFooter—An image that appears on the footer of the pages. Must be an .html file. Label is Footer text displayed on the login page.Not used for the Salesforce mobile app branding. LoginLogoImageId—The logo that appears on the login page for external users. In the Salesforce mobile app, this logo also appears on the Experience Cloud site splash page. Label is Logo image displayed on the login page. LargeLogoImageId—Only used for the Salesforce mobile app. The logo that appears on the splash page when you start the Salesforce mobile app. Label is Large logo image. StaticLogoImageURL—The logo that appears on the login page for external users. Label is Static logo image url. LoginRightFrameUrl—The URL to the contents that appears on right side of the Experience Cloud site login page for external users. Label is Login right frame url.
