In API version 38.0 and later, the system replaces special characters in rich text with escaped HTML. In API version 37.0 and prior, all rich text appears as a plain-text representation.

fields.name: IsVerified
fields.description: Determines whether a comment on a question is marked as Company Verified. This field is available in API version 41.0 and later.

fields.name: HasEntityLinks
fields.description: Indicates whether the feed CommentBody includes at least one link to a record.This field is available starting in API version 43.0.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Specifies whether this feed comment is published and visible to all who can access the parent feed item. To change a comment’s status, the comment’s parent feed item must be in a published state. This field is available in API version 38.0 and later.

fields.name: ThreadParentId
fields.description: The identifier of the feed item that is the parent of this comment. This field is available on the object when Allow discussion threads is selected in the Administration Workspace. This field is available in API version 44.0 and later.

fields.name: ThreadLevel
fields.description: The identifier that shows the level of this Feed Comment in a thread. By default, there are a maximum of three levels in a thread. The ThreadLevel value shows in which of the three levels this comment falls. This field is available on the object when Allow discussion threads is selected in the Administration Workspace. This field is available in API version 44.0 and later.

fields.name: ThreadChildrenCount
fields.description: The count of comments associated with this parent feed object. The feed object can be either a Feed Item or a Feed Comment. The count shows how many comments are directly subordinate to the parent. This field is available on the object when Allow discussion threads is selected in the Administration Workspace. This field is available in API version 44.0 and later.

fields.name: ThreadLastUpdatedDate
fields.description: The date and time the thread on this comment was last updated. This field is available on the object when Allow discussion threads is selected in the Administration Workspace. This field is available in API version 44.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: FeedCommentSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a comment added to a feed by a user.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: ID of the object type to which the feed item is related. For example, set this field to a UserId to post to someone’s profile feed, or an AccountId to post to a specific account.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The type of feed item. Except for ContentPost, LinkPost, and TextPost, don’t create feed items of other types directly from the API. ActivityEvent—indirectly generated event when a user or the API adds a Task associated with a feed-enabled parent record (excluding email tasks on cases). Also occurs when a user or the API adds or updates a Task or Event associated with a case record (excluding email and call logging). For a recurring Task with CaseFeed disabled, one event is generated for the series only. For a recurring Task with CaseFeed enabled, events are generated for the series and each occurrence. AdvancedTextPost—created when a user posts a group announcement and, in Lightning Experience as of API version 39.0 and later, when a user shares a post. AnnouncementPost—Not used. ApprovalPost—generated when a user submits an approval. BasicTemplateFeedItem—Not used. CanvasPost—a post made by a canvas app posted on a feed. CollaborationGroupCreated—generated when a user creates a public group. CollaborationGroupUnarchived—Not used. ContentPost—a post with an attached file. CreatedRecordEvent—generated when a user creates a record from the publisher. DashboardComponentAlert—generated when a dashboard metric or gauge exceeds a user-defined threshold. DashboardComponentSnapshot—created when a user posts a dashboard snapshot on a feed. LinkPost—a post with an attached URL. PollPost—a poll posted on a feed. ProfileSkillPost—generated when a skill is added to a user’s Chatter profile. QuestionPost—generated when a user posts a question. ReplyPost—generated when Chatter Answers posts a reply. RypplePost—generated when a user creates a Thanks badge in WDC. TextPost—a direct text entry on a feed. TrackedChange—a change or group of changes to a tracked field. UserStatus—automatically generated when a user adds a post. Deprecated. The following values appear in the Type picklist for all feed objects but apply only to CaseFeed: AttachArticleEvent—generated event when a user attaches an article to a case. CallLogPost—generated event when a user logs a call for a case through the user interface. CTI calls also generate this event. CaseCommentPost—generated event when a user adds a case comment for a case object. ChangeStatusPost—generated event when a user changes the status of a case. ChatTranscriptPost—generated event when Chat transcript is saved to a case. EmailMessageEvent—generated event when an email related to a case object is sent or received. FacebookPost—generated when a Facebook post is created from a case. Deprecated. MilestoneEvent—generated when a case milestone is completed or reaches violation status. SocialPost—generated when a social post is created from a case. If you set Type to ContentPost, also specify ContentData and ContentFileName.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Standard system field. Indicates whether the record has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false).

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: The revision number of the feed item.

fields.name: LastEditById
fields.description: ID of the user who last edited the feed item.

fields.name: LastEditDate
fields.description: The date the feed item was last edited.

fields.name: CommentCount
fields.description: The number of comments associated with this feed item.

fields.name: LikeCount
fields.description: The number of likes associated with this feed item.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: The title of the feed item. When the Type is LinkPost, the LinkUrl is the URL and this field is the link name. The Title field can be updated on posts of Type QuestionPost.

fields.name: Body
fields.description: The body of the feed item. Required when Type is TextPost or AdvancedTextPost. Optional when Type is ContentPost or LinkPost.

fields.name: LinkUrl
fields.description: The URL of a LinkPost.

fields.name: IsRichText
fields.description:
Indicates whether the feed item Body contains rich text. If you post a rich text feed comment using SOAP API, set IsRichText to true and escape HTML entities from the body. Otherwise, the post is rendered as plain text. Rich text supports the following HTML tags:

Though the
tag isn’t supported, you can use

 

to create lines.

The tag is accessible only through the API and must reference files in Salesforce similar to this example: In API version 35.0 and later, the system replaces special characters in rich text with escaped HTML. In API version 34.0 and prior, all rich text appears as a plain-text representation.

fields.name: RelatedRecordId
fields.description: ID of the ContentVersion record associated with a ContentPost. For WDC thanks posts, it’s the ID of the WorkThanks object associated with a RypplePost. This field is typically null for all posts except ContentPost and RypplePost. For example, set this field to an existing ContentVersion ID and post it to a feed with Type set to ContentPost.

fields.name: InsertedById
fields.description: ID of the user who added this item to the feed. For example, if an application migrates posts and comments from another application into a feed, the InsertedBy value is set to the ID of the context user.

fields.name: BestCommentId
fields.description: The ID of the comment marked as best answer on a question post.

fields.name: HasContent
fields.description: Indicates whether the feed item has content.

fields.name: HasLink
fields.description: Indicates whether the feed item has a link attached.

fields.name: HasFeedEntity
fields.description: Indicates whether the feed item has a feed entity, for example, a post, as an attachment. Available in API version 39 and later when sharing a feed entity in Lightning Experience.

fields.name: HasVerifiedComment
fields.description: Determines whether a question has an answer that is marked as Company Verified. This field is available in API version 41.0 and later.

fields.name: IsClosed
fields.description: As of API version 43, a read-only field that indicates whether the feed item is open or closed to new actions. A value of true places restrictions on the actions a user can take on a feed item and its comments. For more information, see the Usage section.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Specifies whether this feed item is published and visible to all who can access the feed. This field is available in API version 37.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: FeedItemSObject
typeDefs.description: FeedItem represents an entry in the feed, such as changes in a record feed, including text posts, link posts, and content posts.

fields.name: FeedItemId
fields.description: ID of the feed item that the user liked.

fields.name: FeedEntityId
fields.description: The ID of a feed item or feed comment the user liked. If the user liked a comment, FeedEntityId is set to the ID of the comment. If the user liked a feed item, FeedEntityId is set to the ID of the feed item. This field is optional. The default value is the ID of the feed item.

fields.name: InsertedById
fields.description: ID of the user who added this item to the feed. For example, if an application migrates posts and comments from another application into a feed, the InsertedBy value is set to the ID of the context user.

typeDefs.name: FeedLikeSObject
typeDefs.description: Indicates that a user has liked a feed item.

fields.name: FeedItemId
fields.description: ID of the feed item for the poll.

fields.name: Position
fields.description: Shows the position of the poll choice.

fields.name: ChoiceBody
fields.description: A choice in the poll.

typeDefs.name: FeedPollChoiceSObject
typeDefs.description: Shows the choices for a poll posted in the feed.

fields.name: FeedItemId
fields.description: ID of the feed item for the poll.

fields.name: ChoiceId
fields.description: Indicates which choice a user selected on a poll posted in a feed.

typeDefs.name: FeedPollVoteSObject
typeDefs.description: Shows how users voted on a poll posted in the feed.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the record has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). This field is a standard system field.

fields.name: FeedEntityId
fields.description: Identifies the modified feed item or comment.

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: The revision number of the feed item or comment.

fields.name: Action
fields.description: Holds the type of modification to the underlying feed item or comment attribute. Action can have the value Changed.

fields.name: EditedAttribute
fields.description: Identifies the part of the feed item or comment which was modified. A single revision can have many edited attributes.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: Identifies the value of the EditedAttribute field before the update.

typeDefs.name: FeedRevisionSObject
typeDefs.description: Holds the revision history of a specific feed item or comment, including a list of attributes that changed for each revision.

fields.name: FeedItemId
fields.description: ID of the parent feed that tracks the field change.

fields.name: FieldName
fields.description: The name of the field that was changed.This field also tracks other events that are not related to an individual field for a parent feed. These events occur as the parent record advances through its pipeline. For example, a value of leadConverted indicates that a lead has been converted to an opportunity. For a full list of values, see Tracking of Special Events.

fields.name: OldValue
fields.description: The last value of the field before it was changed.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

typeDefs.name: FeedTrackedChangeSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an individual field change or set of field changes. A FeedTrackedChange is a child object of a record feed, such as AccountFeed.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: The Id of the field’s parent PermissionSet.

fields.name: SobjectType
fields.description: The object’s API name. For example, Merchandise__c.

fields.name: Field
fields.description: The field’s API name. This name must be prefixed with the SobjectType. For example, Merchandise__c.Description__c

fields.name: PermissionsEdit
fields.description: If true, users assigned to the parent PermissionSet can edit this field. Requires PermissionsRead for the same field to be true.

fields.name: PermissionsRead
fields.description: If true, users assigned to the parent PermissionSet can view this field. A FieldPermissions record must have at minimum PermissionsRead set to true, or it will be deleted.

typeDefs.name: FieldPermissionsSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the enabled field permissions for the parent PermissionSet.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The data sensitivity picklist value. Default values: Public Internal Confidential Restricted MissionCritical

fields.name: ApiName
fields.description: The API name of the data sensitivity picklist value. Default values: Public Internal Confidential Restricted MissionCritical

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: The value’s position in the picklist.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description of the data sensitivity picklist value.

fields.name: IsHighRiskLevel
fields.description: Indicates that fields with this picklist value contain data highly sensitive to your company.

typeDefs.name: FieldSecurityClassificationSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a field’s data sensitivity value selected from the SecurityClassification picklist.

fields.name: PeriodId
fields.description: ID of the associated fiscal period.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: Start date of the fiscal year.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: End date of the fiscal year.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: A name for the fiscal year. Limit: 80 characters.

fields.name: IsStandardYear
fields.description: Indicates whether the fiscal year is a standard calendar year (true) or a custom fiscal year (false).

fields.name: YearType
fields.description: Indicates one of two types of fiscal years, Standard or Custom. Standard denotes the standard Gregorian calendar, while Custom means a fiscal year with a custom structure.

fields.name: QuarterLabelScheme
fields.description: The numbering scheme used for fiscal quarters.

fields.name: PeriodLabelScheme
fields.description: The numbering scheme used for fiscal periods.

fields.name: WeekLabelScheme
fields.description: The numbering scheme used for weeks.

fields.name: QuarterPrefix
fields.description: The prefix of fiscal quarters. For example, if “Q” is the prefix, then the fourth quarter would be “Q4.”

fields.name: PeriodPrefix
fields.description: The prefix of fiscal periods. For example, if p is the prefix, then the first period is “P1.”

fields.name: WeekStartDay
fields.description: The name of the day that starts the week, for example Monday or Sunday

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the setting.

typeDefs.name: FiscalYearSettingsSObject
typeDefs.description: Settings to define a custom or standard fiscal year for your organization. This object has a parent-child relationship with the Period object.

fields.name: FlexQueueItemId
fields.description: The primary key for this FlexQueueItem.

fields.name: JobType
fields.description: The type of the job. Valid values are: ApexToken BatchApex BatchApexWorker Future Queueable ScheduledApex SharingRecalculation TestRequest TestWorker Currently, queries are supported only on BatchApex jobs.

fields.name: AsyncApexJobId
fields.description: The ID of an that’s waiting in the flex queue.

fields.name: JobPosition
fields.description: The position in the flex queue of the waiting job. The highest-priority job in the queue is at position 0.

typeDefs.name: FlexQueueItemSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an asynchronous Apex job in the Apex flex queue. Provides information about the job type and flex queue position of the AsyncApexJob.

fields.name: DurableId
fields.description: The ID of the flow definition.

fields.name: ApiName
fields.description: The API name of the flow definition.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: The label of the flow definition.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Flow definition information, specified by the org’s admin.

fields.name: ProcessType
fields.description: The type of the flow. Valid values are:Appointments—A flow for Lightning Scheduler. This value is available in API version 44.0 and later. AutoLaunchedFlow—A flow that doesn’t require user interaction. CheckoutFlow—A flow used in Lightning B2B Commerce to create a checkout in a store. This value is available in API version 48.0 and later. ContactRequestFlow—A flow that lets customers request that customer support get back to them. This flow is used to create contact request records. This value is available in API version 45.0 and later. CustomerLifecycle—A Salesforce Surveys flow that lets you associate survey questions with different stages in customer lifecycles. This value is available in API version 49.0 and later and only when the Customer Lifecycle Designer license is enabled. CustomEvent—A process that is invoked when it receives a platform event message. In the UI, it’s an event process. This value is available in API version 41.0 and later. FieldServiceMobile—A flow for the Field Service mobile app. This value is available in API version 39.0 and later. FieldServiceWeb—A flow for embedded Appointment Booking. Its UI label is Field Service Embedded Flow. This value is available in API version 41.0 and later. Flow—A flow that requires user interaction because it contains one or more screens or local actions, choices, or dynamic choices. In the UI and Salesforce Help, it’s a screen flow. Screen flows can be launched from the UI, such as with a flow action, Lightning page, or web tab. FSCLending— A flow for Financial Services Cloud Mortgage. This value is available in API version 46.0 and later. FSCLending—A flow for login. This value is available in API version 51.0 and later. InvocableProcess—A process that can be invoked by another process or the Invocable Actions resource in REST API. This value is available in API version 38.0 and later. fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a subscriber’s organization. This name is unique by group type and corresponds to Group Name in the user interface. This field is available in API version 24.0 and later.When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, performance may slow while Salesforce generates one for each record.

fields.name: RelatedId

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Required. Type of the group. One of the following values: AllCustomerPortal—Public group that includes all Customer Portal or Customer Community Plus users. This type is only available when a Customer Portal or a Customer Site is enabled for your org. ChannelProgramGroup—Public group for partners in a channel program. CollaborationGroup—Chatter group. Manager—Public group that includes a user’s direct and indirect managers. This group is read-only. ManagerAndSubordinatesInternal—Public group that includes a user and the user’s direct and indirect reports. This group is read-only. Organization—Public group that includes all the User records in the organization. This group is read-only. Participant—Compliant Data Sharing group that includes internal users who have the Use Compliant Data Sharing permission. A group can contain other participant groups only, or a group can contain both internal users with the Use Compliant Data Sharing permission and other participant groups. This value is only available when Compliant Data Sharing is enabled for your org. PRMOrganization—Public group that includes all the partners in an organization that has the partner site or portal feature enabled. Queue—Public group that includes all the User records that are members of a queue. Regular—Standard public group. When you create() a group, its type must be Regular, unless a partner site or portal is enabled for the organization, in which case the type can be Regular or PRMOrganization. Role—Public group that includes all the User records in a particular UserRole. RoleAndSubordinates—Public group that includes all the User records in a particular UserRole and all the User records in any subordinate UserRole. RoleAndSubordinatesInternal—Public group that includes all the User records in an internal UserRole, excluding customer and partner roles, and all the User records in any subordinate internal UserRole. Territory—Public group that includes all the User records in an organization that has the territory feature enabled. TerritoryAndSubordinates—Public group that includes all the User records in a particular UserRole and all the User records in any subordinateUserRole in an organization that has the territory feature enabled. Only Personal, Regular, and Queue can be used when creating a group. The other values are reserved.

fields.name: RecurrenceEndDateOnly

fields.name: RecurrenceType

For each day of the week, the values are as follows: Sunday = 1 Monday = 2 Tuesday = 4 Wednesday = 8 Thursday = 16 Friday = 32 Saturday = 64 Multiple days are represented as the sum of their numerical values. For example, Tuesday and Thursday = 4 + 16 = 20.

fields.name: RecurrenceInstance

fields.description: The language of the MasterLabel.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The label for the chart.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The ID of the user who owns the chart.

fields.name: ChartType
fields.description: The type of chart to create. The supported chart types are horizontal bar chart, vertical bar chart, and donut chart.

fields.name: GroupingField
fields.description: The field that’s used to divide the data into collections. The field has to be supported by SOQL GROUP BY functionality. GroupingField can’t be the same as AggregateField.

fields.name: AggregateField
fields.description: The field that’s used for calculating data on each group. AggregateField can’t be the same as GroupingField.

fields.name: AggregateType
fields.description: The type of calculations to run on each group. The supported AggregateType values are Count, Sum, and Avg.

typeDefs.name: ListViewChartSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a graphical chart that’s displayed on Salesforce for Android, iOS, and mobile web list views. The chart aggregates data that is filtered based on the list view that’s currently displayed.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the list view.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The fully qualified developer name of the list view.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description: The namespace of the list view.

fields.name: SobjectType
fields.description: The API name of the sObject for the list view.

fields.name: IsSoqlCompatible
fields.description: Whether the list view can be used with SOQL..

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date and time when the list view was last viewed, with a precision of one second.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date and time when the list view was last referenced, with a precision of one second.

typeDefs.name: ListViewSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a list view. A list view specifies a set of records for an object, based on specific criteria.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a subscriber’s organization.When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, performance may slow while Salesforce generates one for each record.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language of the sensitive data rule.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: Label for the sensitive data rule.

fields.name: Pattern
fields.description: The pattern of text blocked by the rule. Written as a JavaScript regular expression (regex).

fields.name: Replacement
fields.description: The string of characters that replaces the blocked text (if ActionType Replace is selected).

fields.name: IsEnabled
fields.description: Specifies whether a sensitive data rule is active (true) or not (false). Default value (if none is provided) is false.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.description: The action to take on the text (remove or replace) when the sensitive data rule is triggered.

fields.name: EnforceOn
fields.description: Determines the roles on which the rule is enforced. The value is determined using bitwise OR operation. There are seven possible values: Rule enforced on Agent Rule enforced on Visitor Rule enforced on Agent and Visitor Rule enforced on Supervisor Rule enforced on Agent and Supervisor Rule enforced on Visitor and Supervisor Rule enforced on Agent, Visitor, and Supervisor

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description of the sensitive data rule—for example, “Block social security numbers.”

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Indicates the priority level of a Chat.

typeDefs.name: LiveChatSensitiveDataRuleSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a rule for masking or deleting data of a specified pattern. Written as a regular expression (regex).

fields.name: LocationGroupAssignment
fields.description: The name of the location group assignment.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. A null value can mean that this record has only been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

fields.name: LocationId
fields.description: (Master-Detail) The associated location.

fields.name: LocationGroupId
fields.description: (Master-Detail) The associated location group.

fields.name: LocationExternalReference
fields.description: The external reference of the associated location.

fields.name: LocationGroupExternalReference
fields.description: The external reference of the associated location group.

fields.name: LocationName
fields.description: The name of the associated location.

fields.name: LocationGroupName
fields.description: The location group name of the associated location group.

typeDefs.name: LocationGroupAssignmentSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the assignment of a location to a location group.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The ID of the user who currently owns this location group. Default value is the API user that created the record.

fields.name: LocationGroupName
fields.description: The name of the location group.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. A null value can mean that this record has only been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

fields.name: ExternalReference
fields.description: Used when OCI is integrated with B2C Commerce to associate the location group with an inventory list in B2C Commerce. This value must match the inventory list ID in B2C Commerce.

fields.name: IsEnabled
fields.description: Indicates whether the location group is in use. If set to false, then inventory functions ignore this location group and its data isn’t synchronized with OCI. The default value is true.

fields.name: ShouldSyncWithOci
fields.description: Specifies whether to synchronize inventory data for this location group with Omnichannel Inventory. The default value is true.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the location group.

typeDefs.name: LocationGroupSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a group of Omnichannel Inventory locations, providing an aggregate view of inventory availability across those locations. Omnichannel Inventory can create an inventory reservation for an order at the location group level, then assign the reservation to one or more locations in the group as needed.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The location’s owner or driver.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the location. For example, Service Van #4.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date the location was last viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the location was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: LocationType
fields.description: Picklist of location types. It has no default values, so you must populate it before creating any location records.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: The latitude of the location.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: The longitude of the location.

fields.name: Location
fields.description: The geographic location.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A brief description of the location.

fields.name: DrivingDirections
fields.description: Directions to the location.

fields.name: TimeZone
fields.description: Picklist of available time zones.

fields.name: ParentLocationId
fields.description: The location’s parent location. For example, if vans are stored at a warehouse when not in service, the warehouse is the parent location.

fields.name: PossessionDate
fields.description: The date the location was purchased.

fields.name: ConstructionStartDate
fields.description: Date construction began at the location.

fields.name: ConstructionEndDate
fields.description: Date construction ended at the location.

fields.name: OpenDate
fields.description: Date the location opened or came into service.

fields.name: CloseDate
fields.description: Date the location closed or went out of service.

fields.name: RemodelStartDate
fields.description: Date when remodel construction started at the location.

fields.name: RemodelEndDate
fields.description: Date when remodel construction ended at the location.

fields.name: IsMobile
fields.description: Indicates whether the location moves. For example, a truck or tool box.

fields.name: IsInventoryLocation
fields.description: Indicates whether the location stores parts.This field must be selected if you want to associate the location with product items.

fields.name: VisitorAddressId
fields.description: Lookup to an account’s or client’s address.

fields.name: RootLocationId
fields.description: (Read Only) The top-level location in the location’s hierarchy.

fields.name: LocationLevel
fields.description: The location’s position in a location hierarchy. If the location has no parent or child locations, its level is 1. Locations that belong to a hierarchy have a level of 1 for the root location, 2 for the child locations of the root location, 3 for their children, and so forth.

fields.name: ExternalReference
fields.description: Identifier of a location.

fields.name: ShouldSyncWithOci
fields.description: Indicates whether the location should sync its data with Omnichannel Inventory. The default value is false.

fields.name: LogoId
fields.description: A ContentAsset representing a logo for the location.

typeDefs.name: LocationSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a warehouse, service vehicle, work site, or other element of the region where your team performs field service work. In API version 49.0 and later, you can associate activities with specific locations. Activities, such as the tasks and events related to a location, appear in the activities timeline when you view the location detail page. Also in API version 49.0 and later, Work.com users can view Employees as a related list on Location records.

typeDefs.name: LoginEventSObject
typeDefs.description: The documentation has moved to LoginEvent in the Platform Events Developer Guide.

fields.name: LoginTime
fields.description: Time of the login attempt, in GMT time zone.

fields.name: CountryIso
fields.description: The ISO 3166 code for the country where the user’s IP address is physically located. For more information, see Country Codes - ISO 3166

fields.name: Country
fields.description: The country where the user’s IP address is physically located. This value is not localized.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: The latitude where the user’s IP address is physically located.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: The longitude where the user’s IP address is physically located.

fields.name: City
fields.description: The city where the user’s IP address is physically located. This value is not localized.

fields.name: PostalCode
fields.description: The postal code where the user’s IP address is physically located. This value is not localized.

fields.name: Subdivision
fields.description: The name of the subdivision where the user’s IP address is physically located. In the U.S., this value is usually the state name (for example, Pennsylvania). This value is not localized.

typeDefs.name: LoginGeoSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the geographic location of the user’s IP address for a login event. Due to the nature of geolocation technology, the accuracy of geolocation fields (for example, country, city, postal code) may vary.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: ID of the user logging in. Label is User ID.

fields.name: LoginTime
fields.description: Time zone is based on GMT. Label is Login Time.

fields.name: LoginType
fields.description: The type of login used to access the session. AppExchange Application (username and password login) Certificate (certificate-based authentication) ChatterCommunityPortalUnPwd (username and password login to Chatter site) ChatterCommunityThirdPartySso (single sign-on to Chatter site) EmployeeLoginToCommunity (employee username and password login to Experience Cloud site) LightningLogin NetworksPortalApiOnly (API login to Experience Cloud site) Oauth, Remote Access Client (OAuth 1.0 authorization) Oauth2, Remote Access 2.0 (OAuth 2.0 authorization) Partner (username and password login to partner portal) PasswordlessLogin (customer or partner passwordless login) Portal (username and password login to portal) PrmPortalThirdPartySso (single sign-on to Partner Relationship Management (PRM) portal) PortalThirdPartySso (single sign-on to portal) PrmPortal (username and password login to PRM portal) Saml (SAML 1.1 login) SamlChatterNetworks (SAML login to Experience Cloud site) SamlCspPortal (SAML login to Customer Service Portal (CSP)) SamlPrmPortal (SAML login to PRM portal) SamlSite (SAML login to site) Saml2 (SAML 2.0 login) SelfService (username and password login to Self-Service portal) ThirdPartySso (authentication provider login) Label is Login Type.

fields.name: SourceIp
fields.description: IP address of the machine from which the login request is coming. The address can be an IPv4 or IPv6 address in API version 23.0 or later. In API version 22.0 or earlier, the address is an IPv4 address, and IPv6 addresses are null. Label is Source IP.

fields.name: LoginUrl
fields.description: URL from which the login request is coming. Label is Login URL.

fields.name: AuthenticationServiceId
fields.description: The 18-character ID for an authentication service for a login event. For example, you can use this field to identify the SAML or authentication provider configuration with which the user logged in. This field is available in API version 34.0 and later. Label is Authentication Service Id.

fields.name: LoginGeoId
fields.description: The 18-character ID for the record of the geographic location of the user for a successful or unsuccessful login event. The accuracy of geolocation fields like country, city, or postal code can vary because of the nature of the technology. This field is available in API version 34.0 and later.

fields.name: TlsProtocol
fields.description: The TLS protocol used for the login. Possible values are: TLS 1.0 TLS 1.1 TLS 1.2 TLS 1.3 Unknown This field is available in API version 37.0 and later.

fields.name: CipherSuite
fields.description: The TLS cipher suite used for the login. Values are OpenSSL-style cipher suite names, with hyphen delimiters. For more information, see OpenSSL Cryptography and SSL/TLS Toolkit. This field is available in API version 37.0 and later.

fields.name: OptionsIsGet
fields.description: The HTTP method used for the session login is a GET request.

fields.name: OptionsIsPost
fields.description: The HTTP method used for the session login is a POST request.

fields.name: Browser
fields.description: The current browser version. Label is Browser.

fields.name: Platform
fields.description: Operating system on the login machine. Label is Platform.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Displays the status of the attempted login. Status is either success or a reason for failure. Label is Status.

fields.name: Application
fields.description: The application used to access the organization. Label is Application.

fields.name: ClientVersion
fields.description: Version of the API client. Label is Client Version.

fields.name: ApiType
fields.description: Indicates the API type, for example Soap Enterprise. Label is API Type.

fields.name: ApiVersion
fields.description: Displays the API version used by the client. Label is API Version.

fields.name: CountryIso
fields.description: The ISO 3166 code for the country where the user’s IP address is physically located. For more information, see Country Codes - ISO 3166. This field is available in API version 37.0 and later.

fields.name: AuthMethodReference
fields.description: The authentication method used by a third-party identification provider for an OpenID Connect single sign-on protocol. This field is available in API version 51.0 and later. Label is Authentication Method Reference.

typeDefs.name: LoginHistorySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the login history for all successful and failed login attempts for organizations and enabled portals.

fields.name: UsersId
fields.description: The ID of the user associated with this item.

fields.name: SourceIp
fields.description: The IP address the user logged in from.

fields.name: IsAuthenticated
fields.description: If true, the user has already been authenticated.

fields.name: ChallengeSentDate
fields.description: The date and time that the user was authenticated.

fields.name: ChallengeMethod
fields.description: The challenge method used to confirm the user’s identity. Possible values include the following. Email SMS TOTP_CHOICE: The user chooses multi-factor authentication. TOTP_ONLY: The user is required to use multi-factor authentication.

typeDefs.name: LoginIpSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a validated IP address.

typeDefs.name: LogoutEventStreamSObject
typeDefs.description: The documentation has moved to LogoutEventStream in the Platform Events Developer Guide.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: Indicates the ID of the related account, which is determined as follows: The account associated with the WhatId, if it exists; or The account associated with the WhoId, if it exists; otherwise null

fields.name: WhoId
fields.description: The WhoId represents a human such as a lead or a contact. WhoIds are polymorphic. Polymorphic means a WhoId is equivalent to a contact’s ID or a lead’s ID. The label is Name ID.

fields.name: WhatId
fields.description: The WhatId represents nonhuman objects such as accounts, opportunities, campaigns, cases, or custom objects. WhatIds are polymorphic. Polymorphic means a WhatId is equivalent to the ID of a related object. The label is Related To ID.

fields.name: Subject
fields.description: Contains the subject of the task or event.

fields.name: IsTask
fields.description: If the value of this field is set to true, then the activity is a task; if the value is set to false, then the activity is an event. Label is Task.

fields.name: ActivityDate
fields.description: Indicates one of the following: The due date of a task The date of an event if IsAllDayEvent is set to true

fields.name: ActivityDateTime
fields.description: Contains the event’s due date if the IsAllDayEvent flag is set to false. The time portion of this field is always transferred in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone. Translate the time portion to or from a local time zone for the user or the application, as appropriate. Label is Due Date Time.The value for this field and StartDateTime must match, or one of them must be null.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: Indicates the ID of the user or group who owns the activity.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Indicates the current status of a task, such as in progress or complete. Each predefined status field sets a value for IsClosed.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Indicates the priority of a task, such as high, normal, or low.

fields.name: IsHighPriority
fields.description: Indicates a high-priority task. This field is derived from the Priority field.

fields.name: ActivityType
fields.description: Represents one of the following values: Call, Email, Meeting, or Other. Label is Type. These are default values, and can be changed.

fields.name: IsClosed
fields.description: Indicates whether a task is closed; value is always false. This field is set indirectly by setting Status on the task—each picklist value has a corresponding IsClosed value. Label is Closed.

fields.name: IsAllDayEvent
fields.description: If the value of this field is set to true, then the activity is an event spanning a full day, and the ActivityDate defines the date of the event. If the value of this field is set to false, then the activity may be an event spanning less than a full day, or it may be a task. Label is All-Day Event.

fields.name: IsVisibleInSelfService
fields.description: If the value of this field is set to true, then the activity can be viewed in the self-service portal. Label is Visible in Self-Service.

fields.name: DurationInMinutes
fields.description: Indicates the duration of the event or task.

fields.name: Location
fields.description: If the activity is an event, then this field represents the location of the event. If the activity is a task, then the value is null.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Contains a description of the event or task. Limit is 32 KB.

fields.name: CallDurationInSeconds
fields.description: Duration of the call in seconds.

fields.name: CallType
fields.description: The type of call being answered: Inbound, Internal, or Outbound.

fields.name: CallDisposition
fields.description: Represents the result of a given call; for example, “we’ll call back,” or “call unsuccessful.” Limit is 255 characters.

fields.name: CallObject
fields.description: Name of a call center. Limit is 255 characters.

fields.name: ReminderDateTime
fields.description: Represents the time at which a reminder is scheduled to fire if IsReminderSet is set to true. If IsReminderSet is set to false, then either the user has deselected the reminder checkbox in the user interface or the reminder has already fired at the time indicated by the value.

fields.name: IsReminderSet
fields.description: Indicates whether a reminder is set for an activity (true) or not (false).

fields.name: EndDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the end date and time of the event or task. Available in versions 27.0 and later. This field is optional, depending on the following: If IsAllDayEvent is true, you can supply a value for either DurationInMinutes or EndDateTime. Supplying values in both fields is allowed if the values add up to the same amount of time. If both fields are null, the duration defaults to one day. If IsAllDayEvent is false, a value must be supplied for either DurationInMinutes or EndDateTime. Supplying values in both fields is allowed if the values add up to the same amount of time.

fields.name: StartDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the start date and time of the event. Available in versions 13.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: LookedUpFromActivitySObject
typeDefs.description: This read-only object is displayed as a related list on an activity record (an event or a task); the list contains records that have custom lookup relationships from the activity to another object. This object is not queryable.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the instruction.

fields.name: MacroId
fields.description: ID of the macro that contains this instruction.

fields.name: Operation
fields.description: The action that the macro instruction performs. Valid values are: Select Set Insert Submit Close

fields.name: Target
fields.description: The object that’s the target of the operation. For example, the target for the active case tab (Tab.Case) or a quick action, like the Send Email action on the case object (QuickAction.Case.SendEmail).

fields.name: Value
fields.description: Value of a field. If the operation is Select, then the value is null, because the operation selects the object on which the macro performs an action. An instruction can contain both a Value field and a ValueRecord field, but only one of these fields can have a value. The other field value must be null.

fields.name: ValueRecord
fields.description: ID of the value or record. The ValueRecord can be either a value or a record, but not both. An instruction can contain both a Value field and a ValueRecord field, but only one of these fields can have a value. The other field value must be null.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order of this instruction in the macro.

typeDefs.name: MacroInstructionSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an instruction in a macro. An instruction can specify the object that the macro interacts with, the context or publisher that the macro works within, the operation or action that the macro performs, and the target of the macro’s actions.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: ID of the owner of the session record.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the macro.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date and time that the macro record was last viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date and time that the macro record was last referenced.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of what this macro does.

fields.name: IsAlohaSupported
fields.description: Specifies whether the macro is supported in Salesforce Classic.

fields.name: IsLightningSupported
fields.description: Specifies whether the macro is supported in Lightning Experience.

fields.name: StartingContext
fields.description: The object the macro performs actions on. In Salesforce Classic, macros are supported on objects with both feed-based layouts and quick actions. In Lightning Experience, macros are supported on standard and custom objects that allow quick actions and have a customizable page layout.

typeDefs.name: MacroSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a macro, which is a set of instructions that tells the system to perform one or more tasks.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: ID of the group or user that owns the macro.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the macro.

fields.name: ContextRecord
fields.description: ID of the record on which the macro was run.

fields.name: ExecutedInstructionCount
fields.description: The number of macro instructions that ran successfully. If the macro completed successfully, this value is the same as InstructionCount.

fields.name: InstructionCount
fields.description: The number of instructions in the macro at the start of execution.

fields.name: ExecutionEndTime
fields.description: The time at which macro execution completed.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: ID of the user that ran the macro.

fields.name: IsFromBulk
fields.description: If true, the macro was run as a bulk macro. When a bulk macro is run on multiple records, usage is recorded per record.

fields.name: AppContext
fields.description: Context in which the macro was run. Possible values are: Aloha—Salesforce Classic Lightning—Lightning Experience Unknown

fields.name: ConditionCount
fields.description: Number of conditional instructions contained in the macro at execution.

fields.name: ExecutionState
fields.description: The end state of macro execution. Possible values are SUCCESS FAILURE CANCELED

fields.name: DurationInMs
fields.description: The execution time, in milliseconds, for the macro.

fields.name: FailureReason
fields.description: If ExecutionState is failure, this field stores the reason for the failure. Possible values are: ACCESS GENERIC TIMEOUT UNSUPPORTED

typeDefs.name: MacroUsageSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents macro usage on a record, including which macro was used, who used it, and how they used it.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Required. Name of this mail merge template.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Required. Text description of this mail merge template. Limit: 255 characters.

fields.name: Filename
fields.description: Required. File name of the Microsoft Word document that was uploaded as a mail merge template. Limit: 255 characters in length.

fields.name: BodyLength
fields.description: Length of the Microsoft Word document.

fields.name: Body
fields.description: Required. Microsoft Word document to use as a mail merge template. Due to limitations with Microsoft Word mail merge templates, your client application can specify the Body field when creating these records, but not when updating them. Limit: 5 MB.

fields.name: LastUsedDate
fields.description: Date and time when this MailmergeTemplate was last used.

fields.name: SecurityOptionsAttachmentScannedForXSS
fields.description: Required. True if the attachment has been scanned for a cross site scripting threat.

fields.name: SecurityOptionsAttachmentHasXSSThreat
fields.description: Required. True if a cross site scripting threat was detected in the attachment.

fields.name: SecurityOptionsAttachmentScannedforFlash
fields.description: Required. True if the attachment has been scanned for Flash Injection.

fields.name: SecurityOptionsAttachmentHasFlash
fields.description: Required. True if Flash Injection was detected in the attachment.

typeDefs.name: MailmergeTemplateSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a mail merge template (a Microsoft Word document) used for performing mail merges for your organization.

fields.name: MatchingRuleId
fields.description: The ID for the matching rule.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: The order of the matching rule items for a matching rule.

fields.name: Field
fields.description: Indicates which field to compare when determining if a record is similar enough to an existing record to be considered a match.

fields.name: MatchingMethod
fields.description: Defines how the fields are compared. Choose between the exact matching method and various fuzzy matching methods. Valid values are: Exact FirstName LastName CompanyName Phone City Street Zip Title For details on each matching method, see “Matching Methods Used with Matching Rules” in the Salesforce Help.

fields.name: BlankValueBehavior
fields.description: Specifies how blank fields affect whether the fields being compared are considered matches. Valid values are: MatchBlanks NullNotAllowed (default)

typeDefs.name: MatchingRuleItemSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents criteria used by a matching rule to identify duplicate records.

fields.name: SobjectType
fields.description: The object for the matching rule.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The developer name for the matching rule.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language selected for your organization.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The name of the matching rule.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description: The namespace prefix for matching rules for your organization.

fields.name: MatchEngine
fields.description: The match engine used by the matching rule.

fields.name: BooleanFilter
fields.description: Specifies filter logic conditions.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description of the matching rule.

fields.name: RuleStatus
fields.description: Required. The activation status of the matching rule. Values are: Inactive Deactivating DeactivationFailed Active Activating ActivationFailed The only valid values you can declare when deploying a package are Active and Inactive.

fields.name: SobjectSubtype
fields.description: Read-only. Indicates if the matching rule is defined for the Person subtype of Account. Valid values are: PersonAccount None

typeDefs.name: MatchingRuleSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a matching rule that is used to identify duplicate records.

fields.name: MessagingChannelId
fields.description: ID of the MessagingChannel.

fields.name: SkillId
fields.description: ID of the Skill.

typeDefs.name: MessagingChannelSkillSObject
typeDefs.description: Junction object that represents an association between MessagingChannel and Skill.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The developer name for the messaging channel. This value is a concatenation of the messaging platform key and the message type.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: Reserved for future use.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: Unique name for the MessagingChannel.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Reserved for future use.

fields.name: MessageType
fields.description: Type of message. Possible values are: Facebook Phone Text WhatsApp

fields.name: MessagingPlatformKey
fields.description: Unique key for a channel that the end user can message.

fields.name: IsoCountryCode
fields.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the country that the phone number is associated with. For example, the code for United States is US.

fields.name: IsActive

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a subscriber’s organization. When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, performance can slow while Salesforce generates one for each record.

Corresponds to Per User Subject in the user interface. This field is available in API version 46.0 and later.

fields.description: External service or other allowed recipients for the JSON Web Token. Written as JSON, with a quoted string for a single audience and an array of quoted strings for multiple audiences. Single audience example: “aud1”.
