fields.name: PermissionsEdit
fields.description: If true, users assigned to the parent PermissionSet can edit records for this object. Requires PermissionsRead for the same object to be true.

fields.name: PermissionsDelete
fields.description: If true, users assigned to the parent PermissionSet can delete records for this object. Requires PermissionsRead and PermissionsEdit for the same object to be true.

fields.name: PermissionsViewAllRecords
fields.description: If true, users assigned to the parent PermissionSet can view all records for this object, regardless of sharing settings. Requires PermissionsRead for the same object to be true.

fields.name: PermissionsModifyAllRecords
fields.description: If true, users assigned to the parent PermissionSet can edit all records for this object, regardless of sharing settings. Requires PermissionsRead, PermissionsDelete, PermissionsEdit, and PermissionsViewAllRecords for the same object to be true.

typeDefs.name: ObjectPermissionsSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the enabled object permissions for the parent PermissionSet.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: Indicates the ID of the related account, which is determined as follows: The account associated with the WhatId, if it exists; or The account associated with the WhoId, if it exists; otherwise null

fields.name: WhoId
fields.description: The WhoId represents a human such as a lead or a contact. WhoIds are polymorphic. Polymorphic means a WhoId is equivalent to a contact’s ID or a lead’s ID. The label is Name ID. If Shared Activities is enabled, the value of this field is the ID of the related lead or primary contact. If you add, update, or remove the WhoId field, you might encounter problems with triggers, workflows, and data validation rules that are associated with the record. The label is Name ID.

fields.name: WhatId
fields.description: The WhatId represents nonhuman objects such as accounts, opportunities, campaigns, cases, or custom objects. WhatIds are polymorphic. Polymorphic means a WhatId is equivalent to the ID of a related object. The label is Related To ID.

fields.name: Subject
fields.description: Contains the subject of the task or event.

fields.name: IsTask
fields.description: If the value of this field is set to true, then the activity is a task; if the value is set to false, then the activity is an event. Label is Task.

fields.name: ActivityDate
fields.description: Indicates one of the following: The due date of a task The date of an event if IsAllDayEvent is set to true This field has a time stamp that is always set to midnight in the Universal Time Coordinated (UTC) time zone. The time stamp doesn’t represent the time of the activity; don’t attempt to alter it to accommodate time zone differences. Label is Date.

fields.name: ActivityDateTime
fields.description: Contains the event’s due date if the IsAllDayEvent flag is set to false. The time portion of this field is always transferred in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone. Translate the time portion to or from a local time zone for the user or the application, as appropriate. Label is Due Date Time.The value for this field and StartDateTime must match, or one of them must be null.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: Indicates the ID of the user or group who owns the activity.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Indicates the current status of a task, such as in progress or complete. Each predefined status field sets a value for IsClosed. To obtain picklist values, query TaskStatus.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Indicates the priority of a task, such as high, normal, or low.

fields.name: IsHighPriority
fields.description: Indicates a high-priority task. This field is derived from the Priority field.

fields.name: ActivityType
fields.description: Represents one of the following values: Call, Email, Meeting, or Other. Label is Type. These are default values, and can be changed.

fields.name: IsClosed
fields.description: Indicates whether a task is closed; value is always false). This field is set indirectly by setting Status on the task—each picklist value has a corresponding IsClosed value. Label is Closed.

fields.name: IsAllDayEvent
fields.description: If the value of this field is set to true, then the activity is an event spanning a full day, and the ActivityDate defines the date of the event. If the value of this field is set to false, then the activity may be an event spanning less than a full day, or it may be a task. Label is All-Day Event.

fields.name: IsVisibleInSelfService
fields.description: If the value of this field is set to true, then the activity can be viewed in the self-service portal. Label is Visible in Self-Service.

fields.name: DurationInMinutes
fields.description: Indicates the duration of the event or task.

fields.name: Location
fields.description: If the activity is an event, then this field represents the location of the event. If the activity is a task, then the value is null.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Contains a description of the event or task. Limit is 32 KB.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the activity has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

fields.name: CallDurationInSeconds
fields.description: Duration of the call in seconds.

fields.name: CallType
fields.description: The type of call being answered: Inbound, Internal, or Outbound.

fields.name: CallDisposition
fields.description: Represents the result of a given call, for example, “we'll call back,” or “call unsuccessful.” Limit is 255 characters.

fields.name: CallObject
fields.description: Name of a call center. Limit is 255 characters.

fields.name: ReminderDateTime
fields.description: Represents the time at which a reminder is scheduled to fire if IsReminderSet is set to true. If IsReminderSet is set to false, then either the user has deselected the reminder checkbox in the user interface or the reminder has already fired at the time indicated by the value.

fields.name: IsReminderSet
fields.description: Indicates whether a reminder is set for an activity (true) or not (false).

fields.name: EndDateTime
fields.description: Indicates the end date and time of the event or task. Available in versions 27.0 and later. This field is optional, depending on the following: If IsAllDayEvent is true, you can supply a value for either DurationInMinutes or EndDateTime. Supplying values in both fields is allowed if the values add up to the same amount of time. If both fields are null, the duration defaults to one day. If IsAllDayEvent is false, a value must be supplied for either DurationInMinutes or EndDateTime. Supplying values in both fields is allowed if the values add up to the same amount of time.

fields.name: AlternateDetailId
fields.description: The ID of a record the activity is related to which contains more details about the activity. For example, an activity can be related to an EmailMessage record.

typeDefs.name: OpenActivitySObject
typeDefs.description: This read-only object is displayed in a related list of open activities—future events and open tasks—related to an object. It includes activities for all contacts related to the object. OpenActivity fields for phone calls are only available if your organization uses Salesforce CRM Call Center.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the operating hours. For example, Summer Hours, Winter Hours, or Peak Season Hours.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the operating hours record was last viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the operating hours record was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description of the operating hours. Add any details that aren’t included in the name.

fields.name: TimeZone
fields.description: The time zone which the operating hours fall within.

typeDefs.name: OperatingHoursSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the hours in which a service territory, service resource, or account is available for field service work in Field Service and Lightning Scheduler.

fields.name: OpportunityId
fields.description: Required. ID of the associated Opportunity.

fields.name: CompetitorName
fields.description: Name of the competitor.

fields.name: Strengths
fields.description: Description of the competitor’s strengths. Limit: 1,000 characters.

fields.name: Weaknesses
fields.description: Description of the competitor’s weaknesses. Limit: 1,000 characters.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

typeDefs.name: OpportunityCompetitorSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a competitor on an Opportunity.

fields.name: OpportunityId
fields.description: Required. ID of an associated Opportunity. This field is non-nullable, and it cannot be updated. You must provide a value for this field when creating new records. You can’t change it after it has been created.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.description: ID of an associated Contact. The API applies user access rights to the associated Opportunity for this object, but not to the associated Contact. The API may return rows from a query on this object that include this field’s values for contacts to which the user does not have sufficient access rights. It may also return values for this field for contacts that have been deleted. In either case, the client must perform a query on the contact table for this field’s value to determine whether the Contact is accessible to the user and has not been deleted.

fields.name: Role
fields.description: Name of the role played by the associated Contact on the Opportunity, such as Business User or Decision Maker.

fields.name: IsPrimary
fields.description: Indicates whether the associated Contact plays the primary role on the Opportunity (true) or not (false). Each Opportunity has only one primary contact. Label is Primary.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the record has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). The IsDeleted flag is usable only when the parent record is deleted to the recycle bin, and not when the OpportunityContactRole record is deleted directly. Label is Deleted.

typeDefs.name: OpportunityContactRoleSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the role that a Contact plays on an Opportunity.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

fields.name: OpportunityId
fields.description: ID of the Opportunity. Label is Opportunity ID.

fields.name: Field
fields.description: The name of the field that was changed.

fields.name: OldValue
fields.description: The latest value of the field before it was changed.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

typeDefs.name: OpportunityFieldHistorySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the history of changes to the values in the fields of an opportunity.

fields.name: OpportunityId
fields.description: ID of the associated Opportunity.

fields.name: StageName
fields.description: Name of the current stage of the opportunity (for example, Prospect or Proposal).

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: Estimated total sale amount.

fields.name: ExpectedRevenue
fields.description: Calculated revenue based on the Amount and Probability fields.

fields.name: CloseDate
fields.description: Date when the opportunity is expected to close.

fields.name: Probability
fields.description: Percentage of estimated confidence in closing the opportunity.

fields.name: ForecastCategory
fields.description: Category that determines the column in which an opportunity is totaled in a forecast. Label is To ForecastCategory.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

fields.name: PrevAmount
fields.description: The value in the opportunity’s Amount field before the update of the opportunity.In OpportunityHistory records created before Winter ’21, the value is null.Available in API version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: PrevCloseDate
fields.description: The value in the opportunity’s Close Date field before the update of the opportunity.In OpportunityHistory records created before Winter ’21, the value is null.Available in API version 50.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: OpportunityHistorySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the stage history of an Opportunity.

fields.name: OpportunityId
fields.description: Required. ID of the associated Opportunity.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Number indicating the sort order selected by the user. Client applications can use this to match the sort order in Salesforce.

fields.name: PricebookEntryId
fields.description: Required. ID of the associated PricebookEntry. Exists only for those organizations that have Products enabled as a feature. In API versions 1.0 and 2.0, you can specify values for either this field or ProductId, but not both. For this reason, both fields are declared nillable. In API version 3.0 and later, you must specify values for this field instead of ProductId.

fields.name: Product2Id
fields.description: The ID of the related Product2 record. This is a read-only field available in API version 30.0 and later. Use the PricebookEntryId field instead, specifying the ID of the PricebookEntry record.

fields.name: ProductCode
fields.description: This read-only field is available in API version 30.0 and later. It references the value in the ProductCode field of the related Product2 record.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The opportunity line item name (known as “Opportunity Product” in the user interface). This read-only field is available in API version 30.0 and later.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Read-only if this record has a quantity schedule, a revenue schedule, or both a quantity and a revenue schedule. When updating these records: If you specify Quantity without specifying the UnitPrice, the UnitPrice value will be adjusted to accommodate the new Quantity value, and the TotalPrice will be held constant. If you specify both Discount and Quantity, you must also specify either TotalPrice or UnitPrice so the system can determine which one to automatically adjust.

fields.name: TotalPrice
fields.description: This field is available only for backward compatibility. It represents the total price of the OpportunityLineItem. If you do not specify UnitPrice, this field is required. If you specify Discount and Quantity, this field or UnitPrice is required. When updating these records, you can change either this value or the UnitPrice, but not both at the same time. This field is nillable, but you can’t set both TotalPrice and UnitPrice to null in the same update request. To insert the TotalPrice via the API (given only a unit price and the quantity), calculate this field as the unit price multiplied by the quantity. This field is read-only if the opportunity line item has a revenue schedule. If the opportunity line item does not have a schedule or only has quantity schedule, this field can be updated.

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: The unit price for the opportunity line item. In the Salesforce user interface, this field’s value is calculated by dividing the total price of the opportunity line item by the quantity listed for that line item. Label is Sales Price. This field or TotalPrice is required. You can’t specify both. If you specify Discount and Quantity, this field or TotalPrice is required.

fields.name: ListPrice
fields.description: Corresponds to the UnitPrice on the PricebookEntry that is associated with this line item, which can be in the standard price book or a custom price book. A client application can use this information to show whether the unit price (or sales price) of the line item differs from the price book entry list price.

fields.name: ServiceDate
fields.description: Date when the product revenue will be recognized and the product quantity will be shipped. Opportunity Close Date—ServiceDate is ignored. Product Date—ServiceDate is used if not null. Schedule Date—ServiceDate is used if not null and there are no revenue schedules present for this line item, that is, there are no OpportunityLineItemSchedule records with a field Type value of Revenue that are children of this record.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Text description of the opportunity line item. Limit: 80 characters.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed. Available in API version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record. Available in API version 50.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: OpportunityLineItemSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an opportunity line item, which is a member of the list of Product2 products associated with an Opportunity.

fields.name: OpportunityId
fields.description: ID of the Opportunity that is in the partner relationship.

fields.name: AccountToId
fields.description: ID of the partner Account in the partner relationship.

fields.name: Role
fields.description: The UserRole that the Account has on the Opportunity. For example, Reseller or Manufacturer.

fields.name: IsPrimary
fields.description: Indicates whether the account is the opportunity’s primary partner (true) or not (false). Label is Primary.

fields.name: ReversePartnerId
fields.description: ID of the account in a partner relationship.

typeDefs.name: OpportunityPartnerSObject
typeDefs.description: This object represents a partner relationship between an Account and an Opportunity. An OpportunityPartner record is created automatically when a Partner record is created for a partner relationship between an account and an opportunity.

fields.name: OpportunityId
fields.description: ID of the opportunity associated with this sharing entry. This field can’t be updated.

fields.name: UserOrGroupId
fields.description: ID of the user or group that has been given access to the opportunity. This field can’t be updated.

fields.name: OpportunityAccessLevel
fields.description: Level of access that the user or group has to the opportunity. The possible values are: Read Edit All—This value is not valid when creating, updating, or deleting records. This field must be set to an access level that’s higher than the org’s default access level for opportunities.

fields.name: RowCause
fields.description: Reason that this sharing entry exists. You can write to this field when its value is either omitted or set to Manual (default). You can create a value for this field in API versions 32.0 and later with the correct organization-wide sharing settings.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

typeDefs.name: OpportunityShareSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a sharing entry on an Opportunity.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: ID of the account associated with this opportunity.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Required. A name for this opportunity. Limit: 120 characters.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Text description of the opportunity. Limit: 32,000 characters.

fields.name: StageName
fields.description: Required. Current stage of this record. The StageName field controls several other fields on an opportunity. Each of the fields can be directly set or implied by changing the StageName field. In addition, the StageName field is a picklist, so it has additional members in the returned describeSObjectResult to indicate how it affects the other fields. To obtain the stage name values in the picklist, query the OpportunityStage object. If the StageName is updated, then the ForecastCategoryName, IsClosed, IsWon, and Probability are automatically updated based on the stage-category mapping.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: Estimated total sale amount. For opportunities with products, the amount is the sum of the related products. Any attempt to update this field, if the record has products, will be ignored. The update call will not be rejected, and other fields will be updated as specified, but the Amount will be unchanged.

fields.name: Probability
fields.description: Percentage of estimated confidence in closing the opportunity. It is implied, but not directly controlled, by the StageName field. You can override this field to a different value than what is implied by the StageName. If you're changing the Probability field through the API using a partner WSDL call, or an Apex before trigger, and the value may have several decimal places, we recommend rounding the value to a whole number. For example, the following Apex in a before trigger uses the round method to change the field value: o.probability = o.probability.round();

fields.name: ExpectedRevenue
fields.description: Read-only field that is equal to the product of the opportunity Amount field and the Probability. You can’t directly set this field, but you can indirectly set it by setting the Amount or Probability fields.

fields.name: TotalOpportunityQuantity
fields.description: Number of items included in this opportunity. Used in quantity-based forecasting.

fields.name: CloseDate
fields.description: Required. Date when the opportunity is expected to close.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Type of opportunity. For example, Existing Business or New Business. Label is Opportunity Type.

fields.name: NextStep
fields.description: Description of next task in closing opportunity. Limit: 255 characters.

fields.name: LeadSource
fields.description: Source of this opportunity, such as Advertisement or Trade Show.

fields.name: IsClosed
fields.description: Directly controlled by StageName. You can query and filter on this field, but you can’t directly set it in a create, upsert, or update request. It can only be set via StageName. Label is Closed.

fields.name: IsWon
fields.description: Directly controlled by StageName. You can query and filter on this field, but you can’t directly set the value. It can only be set via StageName. Label is Won.

fields.name: ForecastCategory
fields.description: Restricted picklist field. It is implied, but not directly controlled, by the StageName field. You can override this field to a different value than is implied by the StageName value. The values of this field are fixed enumerated values. The field labels are localized to the language of the user performing the operation, if localized versions of those labels are available for that language in the user interface. In API version 12.0 and later, the value of this field is automatically set based on the value of the ForecastCategoryName and can’t be updated any other way. The field properties Create, Defaulted on create, Nillable, and Update are not available in version 12.0.

fields.name: ForecastCategoryName
fields.description: Available in API version 12.0 and later. The name of the forecast category. It is implied, but not directly controlled, by the StageName field. You can override this field to a different value than is implied by the StageName value.

fields.name: CampaignId
fields.description: ID of a related Campaign. This field is defined only for those organizations that have the campaign feature Campaigns enabled. The User must have read access rights to the cross-referenced Campaign object in order to create or update that campaign into this field on the opportunity.

fields.name: HasOpportunityLineItem
fields.description: Read-only field that indicates whether the opportunity has associated line items. A value of true means that Opportunity line items have been created for the opportunity. An opportunity can have opportunity line items only if the opportunity has a price book. The opportunity line items must correspond to PricebookEntry objects that are listed in the opportunity Pricebook2. However, you can insert opportunity line items on an opportunity that does not have an associated Pricebook2. For the first opportunity line item that you insert on an opportunity without a Pricebook2, the API automatically sets the Pricebook2Id field, if the opportunity line item corresponds to a PricebookEntry in an active Pricebook2 that has a CurrencyIsoCode field that matches the CurrencyIsoCode field of the opportunity. If the Pricebook2 is not active or the CurrencyIsoCode fields do not match, then the API returns an error. You can’t update the Pricebook2Id or PricebookId fields if opportunity line items exist on the Opportunity. You must delete the line items before attempting to update the PricebookId field.

fields.name: Pricebook2Id
fields.description: ID of a related Pricebook2 object. The Pricebook2Id field indicates which Pricebook2 applies to this opportunity. The Pricebook2Id field is defined only for those organizations that have products enabled as a feature. You can specify values for only one field (Pricebook2Id or PricebookId)—not both fields. For this reason, both fields are declared nillable.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: ID of the User who has been assigned to work this opportunity. If you update this field, the previous owner's access becomes Read Only or the access specified in your organization-wide default for opportunities, whichever is greater. If you have set up opportunity teams in your organization, updating this field has different consequences depending on your version of the API: For API version 12.0 and later, sharing records are kept, as they are for all objects. For API version before 12.0, sharing records are deleted. For API version 16.0 and later, users must have the “Transfer Record” permission in order to update (transfer) account ownership using this field.

fields.name: LastActivityDate
fields.description: Value is one of the following, whichever is the most recent: Due date of the most recent event logged against the record. Due date of the most recently closed task associated with the record.

fields.name: FiscalQuarter
fields.description: Represents the fiscal quarter. Valid values are 1, 2, 3, or 4.

fields.name: FiscalYear
fields.description: Represents the fiscal year, for example, 2006.

fields.name: Fiscal
fields.description: If fiscal years are not enabled, the name of the fiscal quarter or period in which the opportunity CloseDate falls. Value should be in YYY Q format, for example, '2006 1' for first quarter of 2006.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.description: ID of the contact associated with this opportunity, set as the primary contact. Read-only field that is derived from the opportunity contact role, which is created at the same time the opportunity is created. This field can only be populated when it’s created, and can’t be updated. To update the value in this field, change the IsPrimary flag on the OpportunityContactRole associated with this opportunity. Available in API version 46.0 and later.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: HasOpenActivity
fields.description: Indicates whether an opportunity has an open event or task (true) or not (false). Available in API version 35.0 and later.

fields.name: HasOverdueTask
fields.description: Indicates whether an opportunity has an overdue task (true) or not (false). Available in API version 35.0 and later.

fields.name: LastAmountChangedHistoryId
fields.description: ID of the OpportunityHistory record that contains information about when the opportunity Amount field was last updated in Winter ’21 or later. Information includes the date and time of the change and the user who made the change. Available in API version 50.0 and later.

fields.name: LastCloseDateChangedHistoryId
fields.description: ID of the OpportunityHistory record that contains information about when the opportunity Close Date field was last updated in Winter ’21 or later. Information includes the date and time of the change and the user who made the change. Available in API version 50.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: OpportunitySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an opportunity, which is a sale or pending deal.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: Master label for this opportunity stage value. This display value is the internal label that does not get translated. Limit: 255 characters.

fields.name: ApiName
fields.description: Uniquely identifies a picklist value so it can be retrieved without using an id or master label.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Indicates whether this opportunity stage value is active (true) or not (false). Inactive opportunity stage values are not available in the picklist and are retained for historical purposes only.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Number used to sort this value in the opportunity stage picklist. These numbers are not guaranteed to be sequential, as some previous opportunity stage values might have been deleted.

fields.name: IsClosed
fields.description: Indicates whether this opportunity stage value represents a closed opportunity (true) or not (false). Multiple opportunity stage values can represent a closed opportunity. Label is Closed.

fields.name: IsWon
fields.description: Indicates whether this opportunity stage value represents a won opportunity (true) or not (false). Multiple opportunity stage values can represent a won opportunity. Label is Won.

fields.name: ForecastCategory
fields.description: The default forecast category for this opportunity stage value. The forecast category automatically determines how opportunities are tracked and totaled in a forecast.

fields.name: ForecastCategoryName
fields.description: Available in API version 12.0 and later. The default forecast category value for this opportunity stage value.

fields.name: DefaultProbability
fields.description: The default percentage estimate of the confidence in closing a specific opportunity for this opportunity stage value. Label is Probability (%).

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of this opportunity stage value. Limit: 255 characters.

typeDefs.name: OpportunityStageSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the stage of an Opportunity in the sales pipeline, such as New Lead, Negotiating, Pending, Closed, and so on.

fields.name: OrderId
fields.description: ID of the order associated with this record.

fields.name: Field
fields.description: Name of the order field that was modified, or a special value to indicate some other modification to the order.

fields.name: OldValue
fields.description: Previous value of the modified order field. Maximum of 255 characters.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.description: New value of the modified order field. Maximum of 255 characters.

typeDefs.name: OrderHistorySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents historical information about changes that have been made to the standard fields of the associated order, or to any custom fields with history tracking enabled.

fields.name: Product2Id
fields.description: ID of the Product2 associated with this OrderItem.

fields.name: OrderId
fields.description: ID of the order that this order product is a child of.

fields.name: PricebookEntryId
fields.description: Required. ID of the associated PricebookEntry. This field must be specified when creating OrderItem records. It can’t be changed in an update.

fields.name: OriginalOrderItemId
fields.description: Required if isReductionOrder on the parent order is true.

fields.name: AvailableQuantity
fields.description: Amount of an order product that is available to be reduced. Value must be greater than or equal to 0. An order product is reducible only if AvailableQuantity is greater than 0. Value is always 0 if the order product’s parent order is a reduction order.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Number of units of this order product.

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: Unit price for the order product.

fields.name: ListPrice
fields.description: List price for the order product. Value is inherited from the associated PriceBookEntry upon order product creation.

fields.name: TotalPrice
fields.description: Total price for this order product. The calculations for this field’s value are different if Commerce Orders is enabled.

fields.name: ServiceDate
fields.description: Start date for the order product.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: Optional. Last day the order product is available.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Text description of this object.

fields.name: OrderItemNumber
fields.description: Automatically generated number that identifies the order product.

typeDefs.name: OrderItemSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an order product that your organization sells.

fields.name: OrderId
fields.description: ID of the order associated with this sharing entry. This field can't be updated.

fields.name: UserOrGroupId
fields.description: ID of the user or group that has been given access to the order. This field can't be updated.

fields.name: OrderAccessLevel
fields.description: Level of access that the user or group has to the order.

fields.name: RowCause
fields.description: The reason that the user has access to the order.

typeDefs.name: OrderShareSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a sharing entry on an Order.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: Required. ID of the User or queue that owns this order.

fields.name: ContractId
fields.description: ID of the contract associated with this order. Can only be updated when the order’s StatusCode value is Draft.

fields.name: AccountId

fields.description: Parent payment for this payment line.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: Total amount applied or unapplied by this payment line.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Defines whether this payment line has been applied or unapplied to the target invoice.

fields.name: HasBeenUnapplied
fields.description: Defines whether this payment line has been unapplied from the target invoice. Has a value of NA when PaymentInvoiceLine’s Type field has a value of Unapplied. Can be No or Yes if Type has a value of Applied.

fields.name: Comments
fields.description: Users can add comments to provide additional details about a record. Maximum of 1000 characters.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: The date and time that this payment line was created.

fields.name: AppliedDate
fields.description: The date that this line was applied to an invoice or payment. If this field is null, it inherits the value of the payment line invoice’s Date field.

fields.name: EffectiveDate
fields.description: Defines the date and time when the payment line application or unapplication becomes effective.

fields.name: UnappliedDate
fields.description: The date that this payment line was unapplied from the target invoice. Populated only when the Type field equals Unapplied. Inherits the value of the Date field.

fields.name: AssociatedAccountId
fields.description: The account for this payment line’s target invoice.

fields.name: AssociatedPaymentLineId
fields.description: The paymentLine that was unapplied. Populated only when PaymentLineInvoice’s Type field has a value of Unapplied.

fields.name: ImpactAmount
fields.description: Shows the payment’s financial impact against the customer’s accounts receivable. If PaymentLineInvoice has a Type of Applied, the ImpactAmount is the negative equivalent of the line’s Amount field. Otherwise, ImpactAmount equals Amount.

fields.name: EffectiveImpactAmount
fields.description: Shows how this payment invoice line impacts a customer’s accounts receivable. This value is positive when PaymentLineInvoice’s Type field is Applied, and negative when PaymentLineInvoice’s Type is Unapplied. If there’s an unapplied line related to this record, EffectiveImpactAmount has a value of 0.

fields.name: PaymentBalance
fields.description: Total balance of this line’s parent payment record following the application or unapplication of this payment line.

typeDefs.name: PaymentLineInvoiceSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a payment allocated to or unallocated from an invoice.

fields.name: ImplementorType
fields.description: Shows the type of payment method.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: The account entity linked to this payment method.

fields.name: NickName
fields.description: User-defined nickname for this payment method.

fields.name: CompanyName
fields.description: Company name for this payment method. Part of the payment method’s address.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The state of the payment method.

fields.name: Comments
fields.description: Users can add comments to provide additional details about a record. Maximum of 1000 characters.

fields.name: PaymentMethodStreet
fields.description: Part of the address for this payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodCity
fields.description: Part of the address for this payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodState
fields.description: Part of the address for this payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodPostalCode
fields.description: Part of the address for this payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodCountry
fields.description: Part of the address for this payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodLatitude
fields.description: Part of the address for this payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodLongitude
fields.description: Part of the address for this payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodGeocodeAccuracy
fields.description: Part of the address for this payment method.

fields.name: PaymentMethodAddress
fields.description: Uses address column type. First name and last name are listed as separate fields.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Unique number assigned to the payment method. Numbers start at 1000 and are read only, but administrators can change the format.

typeDefs.name: PaymentMethodSObject
typeDefs.description: The method that a buyer uses to compensate the seller of a good or service. Common payment methods include cash, checks, credit or debit cards, money orders, bank transfers, and online payment services.

fields.name: PaymentNumber
fields.description: System-created unique ID for this payment record.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

fields.name: PaymentGroupId
fields.description: Payment groups organize all the payment transactions that have been made against a record such as an account or contract. Populated from the authorization record if there is delayed payment.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: The account of the customer who made the payment.

fields.name: PaymentAuthorizationId
fields.description: The authorization record for this payment. If there is a delayed capture (when the capture occurs after the authorization), all captures must be made against a previously successful authorization transaction.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: The date when this payment record was created.

fields.name: CancellationDate
fields.description: The date that the payment was voided.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: The amount to be debited or captured.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Defines the state of this payment.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Defines how the customer used this payment.

fields.name: ProcessingMode
fields.description: Defines whether the payment has been made outside of the payment platform.

fields.name: GatewayRefNumber
fields.description: Unique transaction ID created by the payment gateway.

fields.name: ClientContext
fields.description: Contains caller context for payment APIs. Useful for re-establishing context during an asynchronous payment transaction.

fields.name: GatewayResultCode
fields.description: Gateway-specific result code that must map to a Salesforce-specific result code. One Salesforce result code can map to multiple gateway result codes.

fields.name: SfResultCode
fields.description: Salesforce-specific result code that can map to one or more gateway result codes. We recommend configuring the payment gateway adapter layer to map gateway result codes to the appropriate Salesforce result code.

fields.name: GatewayDate
fields.description: The gateway provides this date for reference following a successful gateway communication.

fields.name: CancellationGatewayRefNumber
fields.description: System-provided unique transaction ID from the payment gateway.

fields.name: CancellationGatewayResultCode
fields.description: Gateway-specific result code. Must be mapped to a Salesforce-specific result code.

fields.name: CancellationSfResultCode
fields.description: A Salesforce result code that can be mapped to one or more gateway result codes. We recommend that the payment gateway adapter layer maps gateway-specific codes to the Salesforce result code.

fields.name: CancellationGatewayDate
fields.description: The gateway provides this date following a successful cancellation request.

fields.name: Comments
fields.description: Users can provide additional details about the payment record. Supports a maximum of 1000 characters.

fields.name: ImpactAmount
fields.description: Shows the payment’s financial impact against the customer’s accounts receivable. If the payment is valid, this value is the negative of the payment amount. If the payment is voided, this value is 0.

fields.name: EffectiveDate
fields.description: The date that this payment takes effect.

fields.name: CancellationEffectiveDate
fields.description: The date when the cancellation of this payment takes effect.

fields.name: GatewayResultCodeDescription
fields.description: Description of the gateway’s result code.

fields.name: GatewayRefDetails
fields.description: Additional data that can’t be stored in other fields on the payment record. You can use this field for transactions following the initial transaction that creates the payment record. You can use any data that isn’t normalized in financial entities. This field has a maximum length of 1000 characters and can store data as JSON or XML.

fields.name: IpAddress
fields.description: The IP address of the user who initiated the payment.

fields.name: MacAddress
fields.description: The MAC address of the user who initiated the payment.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: Phone number of the customer who initiated the payment.

fields.name: Email
fields.description: Email address of the user who initiated the payment.

fields.name: PaymentGatewayId
fields.description: ID of the payment gateway that processed the payment. Populated from the authorization record if there is delayed payment.

fields.name: PaymentMethodId
fields.description: The payment method that the customer used to provide this payment information.

fields.name: TotalApplied
fields.description: The total amount of this payment’s balance that has been applied against an invoice.

fields.name: TotalUnapplied
fields.description: The total amount of this payment that was previously applied and then unapplied.

fields.name: NetApplied
fields.description: Total payment amount of that has been applied, including adjustments.

fields.name: Balance
fields.description: The total amount – the net applied amount.

fields.name: TotalRefundApplied
fields.description: The total amount of a refund that has been applied against this payment.

fields.name: TotalRefundUnapplied
fields.description: The total amount of a previously applied refund that has since been unapplied from this payment.

fields.name: NetRefundApplied
fields.description: Total refund amount that has been applied to the payment, including adjustments.

typeDefs.name: PaymentSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a single event where the customer creates a payment. For credit cards, this is a payment capture or payment sale, which won’t show up in the end user’s credit card statement.

fields.name: FiscalYearSettingsId
fields.description: The parent record for this period.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Indicates whether the period is of type Month, Quarter, Week, or Year. Label is the field value.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: The first date of the fiscal period.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: The last date of the fiscal period.

fields.name: IsForecastPeriod
fields.description: Indicates whether the period is associated with Collaborative Forecasts (true) or not (false).

fields.name: QuarterLabel
fields.description: If the quarters in your fiscal year use custom names, then this field contains the appropriate name for rows of type Quarter.

fields.name: PeriodLabel
fields.description: If the months in your fiscal year use custom names, then this field contains the appropriate name for rows of type Month.

fields.name: Number
fields.description: If the labeling scheme of your fiscal year's quarters or months is numbered, this field indicates the relative number of the row.

fields.name: FullyQualifiedLabel
fields.description: Represents the period’s complete name in the UI. For example, “September FY 2016”.

typeDefs.name: PeriodSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a fiscal period defined in FiscalYearSettings.

fields.name: PermissionSetId
fields.description: ID of the PermissionSet to assign to the user specified in AssigneeId.

fields.name: PermissionSetGroupId
fields.description: If associated with a permission set group, this is the ID of that group. This field is available in API version 45.0 and later as part of a pilot. Refer to PermissionSetGroup for more information.

fields.name: AssigneeId
fields.description: ID of the User to assign the permission set specified in PermissionSetId.

typeDefs.name: PermissionSetAssignmentSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the association between a User and a PermissionSet.

fields.name: PermissionSetGroupId
fields.description: The unique permission set group ID.

fields.name: PermissionSetId
fields.description: The unique permission set ID of a permission set in a permission set group.

typeDefs.name: PermissionSetGroupComponentSObject
typeDefs.description: A junction object that relates the PermissionSetGroup and PermissionSet objects via their respective IDs; enables permission set group recalculation to determine the aggregated permissions for the group.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The permission set group name used in the API.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The Permission Set Group language.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The permission set group label for the aggregated permissions.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The Permission Set Group description.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Indicates permission set group recalculation status. Updated. The group is current. Outdated. The group requires recalculation. Updating. The group is in recalculation mode. Failed. The group recalculation failed.

typeDefs.name: PermissionSetGroupSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a group of permission sets and the permissions within them. Use permission set groups to organize permissions based on job functions or tasks. Then, you can package the groups as needed.

fields.name: PermissionSetLicenseId
fields.description: The ID of the permission set license the user is assigned to.

fields.name: AssigneeId
fields.description: ID of the User to assign the permission set license specified in PermissionSetLicenseId.

typeDefs.name: PermissionSetLicenseAssignSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the association between a User and a PermissionSetLicense.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, performance may slow while Salesforce generates one for each record.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language of the permission set license.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The label of the permission set license. Label is Permission Set License Label.

fields.name: PermissionSetLicenseKey
fields.description: A string that uniquely identifies a particular permission set license.

fields.name: TotalLicenses
fields.description: The total number of this permission set license that are available to your organization.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The status of a permission set license. If Active, the permission set license is available. If Disabled, the permission set license has expired.

fields.name: ExpirationDate
fields.description: The date at which the permission set license expires.

fields.name: MaximumPermissionsShowCompanyNameAsUserBadge
fields.description: When on, a user’s company name, if available, will be displayed in place of the community role.

fields.name: UsedLicenses
fields.description: The number of this permission set license that are currently assigned to users.

typeDefs.name: PermissionSetLicenseSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a license that’s used to enable one or more users to receive a specified permission without changing their profile or reassigning profiles. You can use permission set licenses to grant access, but not to deny access.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your organization. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. Corresponds to API Name in the user interface. Limit: 80 characters.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: The permission set label, which corresponds to Label in the user interface. Limit: 80 characters.

fields.name: LicenseId
fields.description: The ID of either the related PermissionSetLicense or UserLicense associated with this permission set. Available in API version 38.0 and later. Use this field instead of UserLicenseId, which is deprecated and only available up to API Version 37.0.

fields.name: ProfileId
fields.description: If the permission set is owned by a profile, this field returns the ID of the Profile. If the permission set isn’t owned by a profile, this field returns a null value. Available in API version 25.0 and later.

fields.name: IsOwnedByProfile
fields.description: If true, the permission set is owned by a profile. Available in API version 25.0 and later.

fields.name: IsCustom
fields.description: If true, the permission set is custom (created by an admin); if false, the permission set is standard and related to a specific permission set license.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A description of the permission set. Limit: 255 characters.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description: The namespace prefix for a permission set that's been installed as part of a managed package. If the permission set isn't packaged or is part of an unmanaged package, this value is empty. Available in API version 23.0 and later.

fields.name: HasActivationRequired
fields.description: Indicates whether the permission set requires an associated active session (true) or not (false).

fields.name: PermissionSetGroupId
fields.description: If the permission set is owned by a permission set group, this field returns the ID of the permission set group. If the permission set isn’t owned by a permission set group, this field returns a null value. Available in API version 45.0 and later.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Available in API version 46.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: PermissionSetSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a set of permissions that’s used to grant more access to one or more users without changing their profile or reassigning profiles.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: The permission set Id.

fields.name: Visibility
fields.description: Indicates whether the tab is visible by default. Possible values are: DefaultOff DefaultOn

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The tab name.

typeDefs.name: PermissionSetTabSettingSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a permission set tab setting. Requires the View Setup permission. Use this object to query all tab settings of the permission set.

fields.name: ExternalId
fields.description: The unique ID for the PlatformAction. If the action doesn’t have an ID, its API name is used.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: The label to display for this action.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The type of the action. Valid values are: ActionLink—An indicator on a feed element that targets an API, a web page, or a file, represented by a button in the Salesforce Chatter feed UI. CustomButton—When clicked, opens a URL or a Visualforce page in a window or executes JavaScript. InvocableAction ProductivityAction—Productivity actions are predefined and attached to a limited set of objects. Productivity actions include Send Email, Call, Map, View Website, and Read News. Except for the Call action, you can’t edit productivity actions. QuickAction—A global or object-specific action. StandardButton—A predefined Salesforce button such as New, Edit, and Delete.

fields.name: Subtype
fields.description: The subtype of the action. For quick actions, the subtype is QuickActionType. For custom buttons, the subtype is WebLinkTypeEnum. For action links, subtypes are Api, ApiAsync, Download, and Ui. Standard buttons and productivity actions have no subtype.

fields.name: ActionTarget
fields.description: The URL to invoke or describe the action when the action is invoked. If the action is a standard button overridden by a Visualforce page, the ActionTarget returns the URL of the Visualforce page, such as /apex/pagename.

fields.name: ActionTargetType
fields.description: The type of the target when this action is triggered. Valid values are: Describe—applies to actions with a user interface, such as quick actions Invoke—applies to actions with no user interface, such as action links or invocable actions Visualforce—applies to standard buttons overridden by a Visualforce page

fields.name: ConfirmationMessage
fields.description: Applies only to action links. The message to display before the action is invoked. Field is null if no confirmation is required before invoking the action.

fields.name: GroupId
fields.description: The unique ID of a group of action links.

fields.name: IsGroupDefault
fields.description: Denotes whether this action is the default in an action link group. False for other action types. Applies to action links only.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Applies only to action links. Denotes whether the action link shows up in the feed item list of actions or the overflow list of actions. Valid values are: Primary Overflow

fields.name: InvocationStatus
fields.description: The status of the action within the feed item. Applies to action links only. Valid values are: Failed New Pending Successful

fields.name: InvokedByUserId
fields.description: The ID of the user who most recently invoked this action within the current feed item. Applies to action links only.

fields.name: SourceEntity
fields.description: Required. The object or record with which this action is associated.

fields.name: ActionListContext
fields.description: Required. The list context this action applies to. Valid values are: ActionDefinition Assistant BannerPhoto Chatter Dockable FeedElement Flexipage Global ListView ListViewDefinition ListViewRecord Lookup MruList MruRow ObjectHomeChart Photo Record RecordEdit RelatedList RelatedListRecord

fields.name: DeviceFormat
fields.description: Specifies which action icon the PlatformAction query returns. If this field isn’t specified, it defaults to Phone. Valid values are: Aloha Desktop Phone Tablet

fields.name: IconContentType
fields.description: The content type—such as .jpg, .gif, or .png—of the icon for this action. Applies to both custom and standard icons assigned to actions.

fields.name: IconHeight
fields.description: The height of the icon for this action. Applies only to standard icons.

fields.name: IconWidth
fields.description: The width of the icon for this action. Applies only to standard icons.

fields.name: IconUrl
fields.description: The URL of the icon for this action.

fields.name: IsMassAction
fields.description: Indicates whether the action can be performed on multiple records. This field is available in API version 38.0 and later.

fields.name: PrimaryColor
fields.description: The primary color of the icon for this action.

fields.name: RelatedSourceEntity
fields.description: When the ActionListContext is RelatedList or RelatedListRecord, this field represents the API name of the related list to which the action belongs.

fields.name: Section
fields.description: The section of the user interface the action resides in. Applicable only to Lightning Experience. Valid values are: ActivityComposer CollaborateComposer NotesComposer Page SingleActionLinks This field is available in API version 35.0 and later.

fields.name: RelatedListRecordId
fields.description: Represents the ID of a record in an object’s related list. This field is available in API version 38.0 and later.

fields.name: TargetUrl
fields.description: The URL that a custom button or link points to. This field is available in API version 41.0 and later.

fields.name: TargetObject
fields.description: The type of object record the action creates, such as a contact or opportunity. This field is available in API version 41.0 and later.

typeDefs.name: PlatformActionSObject
typeDefs.description: PlatformAction is a virtual read-only object. It enables you to query for actions displayed in the UI, given a user, a context, device format, and a record ID. Examples include standard and custom buttons, quick actions, and productivity actions.

fields.name: ExternalId
fields.description: This field is not in use.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the metric to get usage for.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: The start date and time in UTC used for querying usage metrics. The date granularity is hourly.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: The end date and time in UTC used for querying usage metrics. The date granularity is hourly.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The usage value for the specified metric and date range.

typeDefs.name: PlatformEventUsageMetricSObject
typeDefs.description: Contains usage data for event publishing and CometD-client delivery. Usage data is available for the last 24 hours, ending at the last hour, and for historical daily usage. PlatformEventUsageMetric contains separate usage metrics for platform events and change data capture events.

typeDefs.name: PlatformStatusAlertEventSObject
typeDefs.description: The documentation has moved to PlatformStatusAlertEvent in the Platform Events Developer Guide.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). This is a standard system field. Label is Deleted.

fields.name: Pricebook2Id
fields.description: ID of the Pricebook2 associated with this record.

fields.name: Field
fields.description: Name of the price book field that was modified, or a special value to indicate some other modification to the price book.

fields.name: OldValue
fields.description: Previous value of the modified price book field. Maximum of 255 characters.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.description: New value of the modified price book field. Maximum of 255 characters.

typeDefs.name: Pricebook2HistorySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents historical information about changes that have been made to the standard fields of the associated Pricebook2, or to any custom fields with history tracking enabled.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the price book has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Required. Name of this object. This field is read-only for the standard price book. Label is Price Book Name.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the price book is active (true) or not (false). Inactive price books are hidden in many areas in the user interface. You can change this field’s value as often as necessary. Label is Active.

fields.name: IsArchived
fields.description: Indicates whether the price book has been archived (true) or not (false). This field is read only.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Text description of the price book.

fields.name: IsStandard
fields.description: Indicates whether the price book is the standard price book for the org (true) or not (false). Every org has one standard price book—all other price books are custom price books.

typeDefs.name: Pricebook2SObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a price book that contains the list of products that your org sells.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of this PricebookEntry record. This read-only field references the value in the Name field of the Product2 record. Label is Product Name.

fields.name: Pricebook2Id
fields.description: Required. ID of the Pricebook2 record with which this record is associated. This field must be specified when creating Pricebook2 records. It can’t be changed in an update.

fields.name: Product2Id
fields.description: Required. ID of the Product2 record with which this record is associated. This field must be specified when creating Product2 records. It can’t be changed in an update.

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: Required. Unit price for this price book entry. You can specify a value only if UseStandardPrice is set to false. Label is List Price.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Indicates whether this price book entry is active (true) or not (false). Although you can never delete PricebookEntry records, your client application can set this flag to false. Inactive PricebookEntry records are hidden in many areas in the user interface. You can change this flag on a PricebookEntry record as often as necessary.

fields.name: UseStandardPrice
fields.description: Indicates whether this price book entry uses the standard price defined in the standard Pricebook2 record (true) or not (false). If set to true, then the UnitPrice field is read-only, and the value will be the same as the UnitPrice value in the corresponding PricebookEntry in the standard price book (that is, the PricebookEntry record whose Pricebook2Id refers to the standard price book and whose Product2Id and CurrencyIsoCode are the same as this record). For PricebookEntry records associated with the standard Pricebook2 record, this field must be set to true.

fields.name: ProductCode
fields.description: Product code for this record. This read-only field references the value in the ProductCode field of the associated Product2 record.

fields.name: IsArchived
fields.description: Indicates whether the PricebookEntry has been archived (true) or not (false). This is set to true when the Product2 record it’s associated with is archived, or when the Pricebook2 record is archived. This field is read only. Available in API version 45.0 and later. Label is Archived.

typeDefs.name: PricebookEntrySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a product entry (an association between a Pricebook2 and Product2) in a price book.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The unique process name, used internally.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The external name of the process; the name seen by users.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The type of this process. Approval Process—Used to control the action taken for a record. State-based Process—Used internally to track various control processes, such as for developing Salesforce Knowledge articles.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A description of this process, with a maximum of 3,000 characters.

fields.name: TableEnumOrId
fields.description: Specifies the object associated with the approval process, such as Account or Contact.

fields.name: LockType
fields.description: The type of lock applied to the record being approved. When a record is in the approval process, it’s always locked, and only an administrator can edit it. However, the currently assigned approver can also be allowed to edit the record. Total Admin Owner Workitem Node none

fields.name: State
fields.description: The current state of this process. Active Inactive Obsolete

typeDefs.name: ProcessDefinitionSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the definition of a single approval process.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: ID of the User who currently owns this ProcessException. Default value is the User logged in to the API to perform the create.

fields.name: ProcessExceptionNumber
fields.description: The unique name of the ProcessException, formatted as PE-(00000000).

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: Timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. A null value can mean that this record has only been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: Timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

fields.name: AttachedToId
fields.description: ID of the object associated with the ProcessException.

fields.name: Message
fields.description: Short description of the ProcessException

fields.name: StatusCategory
fields.description: Status category of the ProcessException. Each status category corresponds to one or more statuses.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Status of the ProcessException. Each status corresponds to one status category, shown here in parentheses. You can customize the status picklist to represent your business processes. If you customize the status picklist, include at least one status value for each status category.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: ProcessingException type. You can customize the category picklist to represent your business processes.

fields.name: Severity
fields.description: Severity of the ProcessException. Each severity value corresponds to one severity category. You can customize the severity picklist to represent your business processes. If you customize the severity picklist, include at least one severity value for each severity category.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Resolution priority for the ProcessException. You can customize the priority picklist to represent your business processes.

fields.name: CaseId
fields.description: ID of the case associated with the ProcessException.

fields.name: ExternalReference
fields.description: Description of external entities associated with the ProcessException.

fields.name: SeverityCategory
fields.description: Severity category of the ProcessException. Each severity category corresponds to one or more severity values. The severity category is used to show the severity icon in the ProcessException list view.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Detailed description of the ProcessException.

typeDefs.name: ProcessExceptionSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a processing failure on an order summary. A separate process is required to resolve the failure that caused the process exception before order summary processing can continue.

fields.name: UserType
fields.description: The category of user license. Each UserType is associated with one or more UserLicense records. Each UserLicense is associated with one or more profiles. In API version 10.0 and later, valid values include: Standard: user license. This user type also includes Salesforce Platform and Salesforce Platform One user licenses. Label is Standard. PowerPartner: User whose access is limited because he or she is a partner and typically accesses the application through a partner portal or Experience Cloud site. Label is Partner. CSPLitePortal: user whose access is limited because he or she is an org's customer and accesses the application through a Customer Portal or Experience Cloud site. Label is High Volume Portal. CustomerSuccess: user whose access is limited because he or she is an org's customer and accesses the application through a Customer Portal. Label is Customer Portal User. PowerCustomerSuccess: user whose access is limited because he or she is an org's customer and accesses the application through a Customer Portal. Label is Customer Portal Manager. Users with this license type can view and edit data they directly own or data owned by or shared with users below them in the Customer Portal role hierarchy. CsnOnly: user whose access to the application is limited to Chatter. This user type includes Chatter Free and Chatter moderator users. Label is Chatter Free. UserType replaces LicenseType, which is unavailable as of API version 10.0. In API versions 8.0 and 9.0 LicenseType is still available with the following valid values: AUL: Lightning Platform user license. Label is Apex Platform. AUL1: Lightning Platform user license with only one user. Label is Apex Platform One. Salesforce: Salesforce user license. Label is Salesforce. PackageManager: user who can create and work with managed packages for Salesforce AppExchange. Label is Package Manager. PRM: user whose access is limited because he or she is a partner and typically accesses the application through a partner portal. Label is Partner. CustomerUser: user whose access is limited because he or she is an org's customer and accesses the application through a Customer Portal. Label is Customer Portal User. CustomerManager: user whose access is limited because he or she is an org's customer and accesses the application through a Customer Portal. Label is Customer Portal Manager. Users with this license type can view and edit data they directly own or data owned by or shared with users below them in the Customer Portal role hierarchy.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a subscriber’s organization.When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, performance may slow while Salesforce generates one for each record.

typeDefs.description: Represents record details about an in-app guidance prompt or walkthrough.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: ID of the in-app guidance.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The master label. Maximum of 80 characters.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the in-app guidance. Maximum of 255 characters.

fields.name: DisplayType
fields.description: Indicates the type of prompt. Valid values are: DockedComposer—the docked prompt FloatingPanel—the floating prompt

fields.name: DisplayPosition
fields.description: Indicates the position of the floating prompt on the page. Valid values are: TopLeft TopCenter TopRight MiddleLeft MiddleCenter MiddleRight BottomLeft BottomCenter BottomRight

fields.name: TimesToDisplay
fields.description: Maximum number of times to display the in-app guidance (that is, the number of occurrences). Salesforce detects if the user interacts with (or ignores) the in-app guidance to determine if we should show the in-app guidance again or cancel scheduled recurrences. This may run counter to the number of occurrences scheduled. Maximum value of 30. For walkthroughs, this field can only be specified on the first step.

fields.name: DelayDays
fields.description: Number of days between occurrences. For walkthroughs, this field can only be specified on the first step.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: Indicates the date to start showing. For walkthroughs, this field can only be specified on the first step.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: Indicates the date to stop showing the in-app guidance. For walkthroughs, this field can only be specified on the first step.

fields.name: UserAccess
fields.description: Indicates which permissions can see the in-app guidance. Valid values are: Everyone—there are no restrictions on who can see SpecificPermissions—only users with all the specific user permissions specified can see the in-app guidance

fields.name: IsPublished
fields.description: Indicates if the in-app guidance is active yes or not no.

fields.name: PublishedDate
fields.description: Indicates the date the in-app guidance was activated. If the in-app guidance is part of a package, this is the date when the package was installed. For walkthroughs, this field can only be specified on the first step.

fields.name: PublishedByUserId
fields.description: The ID of the user who activated the in-app guidance. If the in-app guidance is part of a package, this is the user who installed the package.

fields.name: Header
fields.description: Label for the header of the docked prompt. This is the label contained in the window’s browser bar. Maximum of 36 characters.

fields.name: DismissButtonLabel
fields.description: Label for the dismiss button of a floating prompt. Maximum of 15 characters.

fields.name: ShouldDisplayActionButton
fields.description: Indicates if an action button or link is included in the in-app guidance yes or not no.

fields.name: ActionButtonLabel
fields.description: Label for the action button. Maximum of 25 characters. For walkthroughs, this field can only be specified on the last step.

fields.name: ActionButtonLink
fields.description: URL for the action button. Maximum of 1,000 characters. You can’t use the GROUP BY option in a SOQL query for this field. For walkthroughs, this field can only be specified on the last step.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: The label for the title of the in-app guidance. Maximum of 36 characters.

fields.name: VersionNumber
fields.description: The number remains 1 since multiple versions aren’t saved in the org.

fields.name: TargetPageType
fields.description: The type of page where the in-app guidance appears.

fields.name: TargetPageKey1
fields.description: Used by Salesforce to identify the page location along with targetPageKey2, targetPageKey3, and targetPageType.

fields.name: TargetPageKey2
fields.description: Used by Salesforce to identify the prompt’s page location along with targetPageKey1, targetPageKey3, and targetPageType.

fields.name: TargetAppNamespacePrefix
fields.description: The app’s namespace prefix where the in-app guidance appears. Must match the target app’s NamespacePrefix in the org that the package is being installed into. Maximum of 15 characters. Deprecated in API version of 51.0.

fields.name: TargetAppDeveloperName
fields.description: The app’s developer name where the in-app guidance appears. Deprecated in API version 51.0.

fields.name: Body
fields.description: Body content. For floating prompts, there’s a maximum of 240 characters. For docked prompts, there’s a maximum of 4000 characters. However, docked prompts use a rich text editor, so the maximum refers to the HTML markup, not the readable text.

fields.name: ShouldIgnoreGlobalDelay
fields.description: Indicates if the prompt ignores the global time delay between in-app guidance and instead shows on page load yes or not no. The default is no.

fields.name: UserProfileAccess
fields.description: Indicates which profiles can see the in-app guidance. Valid values are: Everyone—there are no permission restrictions on who can see SpecificProfiles—users with any of the specific user profiles specified can see the in-app guidance

fields.name: VideoLink
fields.description: URL for the video in a docked prompt. Maximum of 1,000 characters. You can only specify this field or the ImageId field, not both. To find the embed code for a video, follow the instructions from the video host website. Usually the steps can be found by searching for the name of the website and “embed video.” For example, here’s what the embed code looks like for YouTube: <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ko-gcObzTVo" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe> Then, you would enter the URL found in the src attribute. For the example used, enter https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ko-gcObzTVo.

fields.name: StepNumber
fields.description: Indicates the number of the last step the user viewed or interacted with in a walkthrough. Maximum value is 10.

fields.name: ThemeColor
fields.description: Indicates which custom theme color is applied to in-app guidance. Required if themeSaturation is specified. Specify on the first step of the walkthrough to apply to the entire walkthrough. Valid values are: Theme1—derived from the current brand color Theme2—derived from the current page background color Theme3—derived from the current global header color Theme4—derived from the current app theme color

fields.name: ThemeSaturation
fields.description: Indicates which color value, or saturation, is applied to in-app guidance that has a custom theme color applied. Required if themeColor is specified. Specify on the first step of the walkthrough to apply to the entire walkthrough. Valid values are: Dark Light

fields.name: TargetPageKey1Ref
fields.description: Used by Salesforce to identify the prompt’s page location along with targetPageKey2, targetPageKey3, and targetPageType.

fields.name: ImageAltText

fields.name: ImageId

fields.name: ImageLocation

fields.name: TargetPageKey3
fields.description: Used by Salesforce to identify the prompt’s page location along with targetPageKey1, targetPageKey2, and targetPageType.

fields.description: Used by Salesforce for efficient querying.

fields.name: IndexWithoutIsPublished
fields.description: Used by Salesforce for efficient querying.
