fields.description: Required. API version to use for executing the query specified in Query. It must be an API version greater than 20.0. If your query applies to a custom object from a package, this value must match the package's ApiVersion. Example value:

In API version 29.0 and later, this field is read-only, and doesn’t contain information about delete and undelete events. Use NotifyForOperationCreate, NotifyForOperationDelete, NotifyForOperationUndelete and NotifyForOperationUpdate to specify which record events should generate a notification. Possible values are: All (default) Create Extended Update A value of Extended means that neither create or update operations are set to generate events.

fields.name: NotifyForOperationUpdate

fields.name: NotifyForOperationUndelete
fields.description: true if an undelete operation should generate a notification, otherwise, false. Defaults to true. Clients must connect using the cometd/29.0 (or later) Streaming API endpoint to receive delete and undelete event notifications. This field is available in API version 29.0 and later.

fields.name: ParentRecordId
fields.description: Required. The parent record for the associated action.

fields.name: ActionDefinitionApiName
fields.description: Required. The API name of the action associated with the record. To distinguish a quick action from a flow with the same API name, we prepend "QuickAction" to the API name of every quick action.

fields.name: ActionDefinitionLabel
fields.description: Required. The label of the action that took place.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.description: Required. The type of action associated with the record. Possible values are: Flow (default) QuickAction

fields.name: State
fields.description: Required. The state of the action. A state change triggers the logging of a history event. Possible values are: New (default) Paused Complete Started Unlinked—The action was unlinked because the flow was paused and the current record for the flow interview changed.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: Required. The user that conducted the action.

fields.name: RecordActionId
fields.description: Required. The ID of the RecordAction.

fields.name: LoggedTime
fields.description: Required. The timestamp when the state change occurred.

fields.name: Pinned
fields.description: Optional. Specifies whether the action is pinned to the top or bottom, or unpinned. Possible values are: None Top Bottom

fields.name: IsMandatory
fields.description: Optional. Specifies whether the action is mandatory. The default value is false.

typeDefs.name: RecordActionHistorySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the lifecycle of a RecordAction as it goes through different states.

fields.name: RecordId
fields.description: Required. Record associated with the action. In version 46.0 and above, we support most object types. To learn about supported objects, see the Lightning Flow for Service Developer’s Guide.

fields.name: FlowDefinition
fields.description: Optional in Lightning Flow for Service implementations using version 42.0 or 43.0 of the API. An upgrade to Winter '19 or later, which uses API version 44.0 or later, copies FlowDefinition to ActionDefinition. For versions 42.0 and 43.0, this field is the API name of the flow that’s associated with the record.

fields.name: FlowInterviewId
fields.description: Optional. The flow interview ID of the paused or completed flow. This field can’t be set in Process Builder.

fields.name: Order
fields.description: Required. The order of the action among all actions associated with this record.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Required. The current state of the action. Possible values are: New (default) Paused Complete Started Unlinked—The action was unlinked because the flow was paused and the current record for the flow interview changed. Paused and unlinked statuses do not apply to quick actions. This field can’t be set in Process Builder.

fields.name: Pinned
fields.description: Required. Specifies whether the action is pinned to the top or bottom of the component. If an action is pinned, users see the Remove option in the UI unless IsUiRemoveHidden is set to true. Possible values are: None (default) Top Bottom

fields.name: ActionType
fields.description: Required in Lightning Flow for Service implementations that use version 46.0 or later of the API. The type of action. Possible values are: Flow (default) QuickAction For versions of the API prior to version 46.0, this field is set to Flow.

fields.name: ActionDefinition
fields.description: Required in Lightning Flow for Service implementations that use version 44.0 or later of the API. The API name of the action to associate with the record; for example, the API name of a flow. Use this field rather than FlowDefinition. To distinguish a quick action from a flow with the same API name, we prepend "QuickAction" to the API name of every quick action.

fields.name: IsMandatory
fields.description: Optional. Specifies whether the action is mandatory. The default value is false. At runtime, we show a reminder when the user closes a mandatory flow without completing it. We don't show the reminder for quick actions.

fields.name: IsUiRemoveHidden
fields.description: Optional. Specifies whether the ability to remove the action is hidden in the UI. The default value is false. If true, the UI hides the ability to remove the action. However, actions can still be deleted using the API.

typeDefs.name: RecordActionSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a relationship between a record and an action, such as a flow. Create a RecordAction for every action that you want to associate with a particular record.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Required. Label of the record type in the user interface. Limit: 80 characters. Label is Record Type Label.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: Required. The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a subscriber’s organization. Label is Record Type Name.When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, performance may slow while Salesforce generates one for each record.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A description of this record. Limit: 255 characters.

fields.name: BusinessProcessId
fields.description: Required for Opportunity and Lead record types in API version 17.0 and later. ID of an associated BusinessProcess.

fields.name: SobjectType
fields.description: Object to which this record type applies, including custom objects.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Indicates whether this record is active (true) or not (false). Only active record types can be applied to records. Label is Active.

typeDefs.name: RecordTypeSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a record type.

fields.name: DeveloperName

It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. The label corresponds to section title in the user interface. Limit: 80 characters.When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, performance may slow while Salesforce generates one for each record.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: Language of the label.

fields.name: Url

fields.name: RefundLinePaymentNumber

fields.name: PaymentId
fields.description: The payment record that this refund line targets. Refund applications and unapplications are made against this payment.

fields.name: RefundId
fields.description: The parent refund of this refund line.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: The total amount applied to or unapplied from a payment by the refund line.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Defines whether this line represents a refund that’s been applied or unapplied from a payment.

fields.name: HasBeenUnapplied
fields.description: Shows whether this refund line has been unapplied.

fields.name: Comments
fields.description: Users can add comments to provide additional information on the refund line payment.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: By default, the day the refund line payment record was created. Users can also enter a different date.

fields.name: AppliedDate
fields.description: The date that the refund was applied to the linked payment.

fields.name: EffectiveDate
fields.description: Defines the date and time when the refund line application or unapplication becomes effective.

fields.name: UnappliedDate
fields.description: The date that this refund line was unapplied from a payment.

fields.name: AssociatedAccountId
fields.description: The account for the payment that received the refund.

fields.name: AssociatedRefundLinePaymentId
fields.description: The refundLine that was unapplied. Populated only when RefundLinePayment’s Type has a value of Unapplied.

fields.name: ImpactAmount
fields.description: Shows how this payment refund line impacts a customer’s accounts receivable. This value is positive when RefundLinePayment’s Type field is Applied, and negative when RefundLinePayment’s Type is Unapplied.

fields.name: EffectiveImpactAmount
fields.description: Shows how this payment refund line impacts a customer’s accounts receivable. This value is positive when RefundLinePayment’s Type field is Applied, and negative when RefundLinePayment’s Type is Unapplied. If there’s an unapplied line related to this record, EffectiveImpactAmount has a value of 0.

fields.name: RefundBalance
fields.description: The refund record’s balance following the application or unapplication of this payment refund line.

fields.name: PaymentBalance
fields.description: The payment record’s balance following the application or unapplication of this refund line.

typeDefs.name: RefundLinePaymentSObject
typeDefs.description: A refund line that has been applied to a payment.

fields.name: RefundNumber
fields.description: System-created unique ID for this refund.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Defines how this refund is used.

fields.name: PaymentGroupId
fields.description: The payment group for the payment being refunded.

fields.name: ImpactAmount
fields.description: Shows the refund’s financial impact against the customer’s accounts receivable. Equals the refund’s Amount field if the refund amount is valid. Equals 0 when the refund amount is void. Has a null value when the refund is canceled.

fields.name: ProcessingMode
fields.description: Defines whether the payment has been made outside of the payment platform.

fields.name: Amount

fields.name: AccountId

fields.name: PaymentMethodId
fields.description: The payment method used to create the payment being refunded.

fields.name: Comments
fields.description: Users can add comments to provide additional details about a record. Maximum of 1000 characters.

fields.name: GatewayResultCodeDescription

fields.description: Salesforce-specific result code that can map to one or more gateway result codes. We recommend configuring the payment gateway adapter layer to map gateway result codes to the appropriate Salesforce result code.

fields.name: GatewayDate
fields.description: The date that a successful gateway communication caused the creation of this refund.

fields.name: IpAddress

fields.name: MacAddress
fields.description: Fraud parameter.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: Fraud parameter.

fields.name: Email

fields.name: EffectiveDate

fields.name: CancellationEffectiveDate
fields.description: The date that the cancellation of this refund takes effect.

fields.name: CancellationDate

fields.name: CancellationGatewayRefNumber
fields.description: Unique ID for the cancellation transaction. Generated by the payment gateway.

fields.name: CancellationGatewayResultCode
fields.description: Gateway-specific result code for the cancellation transaction. Generated by the payment gateway. Must be mapped to a Salesforce-specific result code.

fields.name: CancellationSfResultCode
fields.description: Salesforce-specific result code that can map to one or more gateway result codes. We recommend configuring the payment gateway adapter layer to map gateway result codes to the appropriate Salesforce result code.

fields.name: CancellationGatewayDate
fields.description: The date when the cancellation transaction was processed in the payment gateway.

fields.name: PaymentGatewayId
fields.description: The payment gateway used to process this refund.

fields.name: TotalApplied
fields.description: The sum of Amount fields across all of this refund’s applied refund lines.

fields.name: TotalUnapplied
fields.description: The sum of Amount fields across all of this refund’s unapplied refund lines.

fields.name: NetApplied
fields.description: Equals the Total Applied field – the Total Unapplied field.

fields.name: Balance
fields.description: Remaining balance following refund line applications. Equal to the Amount field – the Net Applied field.

typeDefs.name: RefundSObject

fields.name: LastViewedDate

fields.name: AbsenceNumber

fields.name: LastViewedDate

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the resource absence was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: ResourceId
fields.description: The absent service resource.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The type of absence: Meeting, Training, Medical, or Vacation. The default value is Vacation. You can add custom values if needed, but the name Break is reserved for the managed package.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description of the absence.

fields.name: Start
fields.description: The date and time when the absence begins.

fields.name: End
fields.description: The date and time when the absence ends.

fields.name: Street

fields.name: City

fields.name: State

fields.name: Country

fields.name: Longitude

fields.name: GeocodeAccuracy
fields.description: The level of accuracy of a location’s geographical coordinates compared with its physical address. Usually provided by a geocoding service based on the address’s latitude and longitude coordinates.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: Address
fields.description: The compound form of the address associated with the absence.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate

fields.name: ServiceResourceId

fields.name: RelatedRecordId
fields.description: The work order or account with the resource preference.

fields.name: PreferenceType
fields.description: Resource preference type. Values include: Preferred: Indicates that the customer would like their field service work assigned to the resource Required: Indicates that the resource must be assigned to the customer’s field service work Excluded: Indicates that the customer does not want their field service work assigned to the resource Resource preferences serve more as a suggestion than a requirement. You can still assign a service appointment to any resource regardless of the related work order’s resource preferences.

fields.name: ReturnOrderId
fields.description: ID of the associated return order.

fields.name: ReturnOrderItemAdjustmentId
fields.description: If this object represents a tax on an adjustment, this value is the ID of the return order item adjustment to which the tax applies. If this value is null, the adjustment applies to a return order line item.

fields.name: TaxEffectiveDate
fields.description: Date on which the Amount was calculated. Important due to tax rate changes over time.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the return order item tax.

fields.name: ReturnOrderLineItemNumber
fields.description: (Read only) Auto-generated number that identifies the return order line item.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the return order line item was last viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the return order line item was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: ReturnOrderId
fields.description: The return order that the return order line item belongs to.

fields.name: OrderItemId
fields.description: The order product associated with the return order line item. One or more of the following fields must be filled out: AssetId, OrderItemId, Product2Id, ProductItemId, and ProductRequestLineItemId.

fields.name: Product2Id
fields.description: The product associated with the return order line item. One or more of the following fields must be filled out: AssetId, OrderItemId, Product2Id, ProductItemId, and ProductRequestLineItemId.

fields.name: QuantityReturned
fields.description: The quantity of items being returned. If multiple types of products are being returned, track each product in a different return order line item.

fields.name: QuantityUnitOfMeasure
fields.description: Units of the returned items; for example, kilograms or liters. Quantity Unit of Measure picklist values are inherited from the Quantity Unit of Measure field on products.

fields.name: SourceLocationId
fields.description: The items’ location at the start of the return or repair. For example, if the return order tracks the return of products from a technician’s service vehicle to a warehouse, the service vehicle is the source location.

fields.name: DestinationLocationId
fields.description: The location where the items are being returned to. For example, if the return order tracks the return of products from a technician’s van to a warehouse, the warehouse is the destination location.

fields.name: AssetId
fields.description: The asset associated with the return order line item. One or more of the following fields must be filled out: AssetId, OrderItemId, Product2Id, ProductItemId, and ProductRequestLineItemId.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Notes or context about the return order line item.

fields.name: ReasonForReturn
fields.description: The reason the items are being returned. Available values are: Damaged Defective Duplicate Order Wrong Item Wrong Quantity Not Satisfied Outdated Other

fields.name: ProcessingPlan
fields.description: Indicates the preferred fate of the items following their return. Available values are: Repair—Repair the items and return them to the owner Discard—Discard the items Salvage—Salvage the items’ working parts Restock—Return the items to your inventory

fields.name: RepaymentMethod
fields.description: The method by which the customer or owner will be reimbursed for the items being returned. Available values are: Replace—The items will be replaced Refund—The items will be returned and the owner will be refunded Credit—The items will be returned and the owner will receive credit for them Return—The items will be returned to the owner (for example, following their repair)

fields.name: ChangeOrderItemId
fields.description: ID of the change order item associated with the return order line item.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Type of the return order line item. Matches the type of the associated order item summary. Delivery Charge indicates that the return order line item represents a delivery charge. Order Product indicates that it represents any other type of product, service, or charge. Each type corresponds to one type code.

fields.name: TypeCode
fields.description: Type code of the return order line item. Matches the type code of the associated order item summary. Processing depends on this value. Charge indicates that the return order line item represents a delivery charge. Product indicates that it represents an other type of product, service, or charge. Each type category corresponds to one or more types.

fields.name: QuantityReceived

fields.name: QuantityExpected
fields.description: The quantity of items expected to be returned.

fields.name: QuantityRejected
fields.description: The quantity of items rejected for return.

fields.name: ReasonForRejection
fields.description: Reason for rejecting returned items on this return order line item.

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: Unit price of the return order line item.

fields.name: GrossUnitPrice
