fields.name: TotalLineAmount
fields.description: Total, not including adjustments or tax, of the return order line item.

fields.name: TotalLineTaxAmount
fields.description: Tax on the TotalLineAmount.

fields.name: TotalAdjustmentTaxAmount
fields.description: Tax on the TotalAdjustmentAmount.

fields.name: TotalAdjustmentAmount
fields.description: Total of all price adjustments applied to the return order line item.

fields.name: TotalLineAmountWithTax
fields.description: Total price of the return order line item, inclusive of tax. This amount is equal to TotalLineAmount + TotalLineTaxAmount.

fields.name: TotalAdjustmentAmountWithTax
fields.description: Total amount of the price adjustments applied to the return order line item, inclusive of tax. This amount is equal to TotalAdjustmentAmount + TotalAdjustmentTaxAmount.

fields.name: TotalPrice
fields.description: Total, including adjustments but not tax, of the return order line item. Equal to UnitPrice times Quantity.

fields.name: TotalTaxAmount
fields.description: Tax on the TotalAmount.

fields.name: TotalAmount
fields.description: Total, including adjustments and tax, of the return order line item.

typeDefs.name: ReturnOrderLineItemSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a specific product that is returned or repaired as part of a return order in Field service, or a specific order item that is returned as part of a return order in Order Management.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The owner of the return order.

fields.name: ReturnOrderNumber
fields.description: (Read only) Auto-generated number identifying the return order.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the return order was last viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the return order was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: The account associated with the return order.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.description: The contact associated with the return order.

fields.name: CaseId
fields.description: The case associated with the return order.

fields.name: OrderId
fields.description: The order associated with the return order. When you associated a return order with an order, you can associate the return order’s line items with order products.

fields.name: SourceLocationId
fields.description: The items’ location at the start of the return or repair. For example, if the return order tracks the return of products from a technician’s service vehicle to a warehouse, the service vehicle is the source location.

fields.name: DestinationLocationId
fields.description: The location where the items are being returned to. For example, if the return order tracks the return of products from a technician’s van to a warehouse, the warehouse is the destination location.

fields.name: ShipmentType
fields.description: The type of shipment associated with the return order. Available values are: Standard (default value) Rush Overnight Next Business Day Pickup

fields.name: ShipFromStreet
fields.description: The street of the return shipping address. This address tracks the location of the items at the start of the return or repair. For example, if a customer is returning an item, the Ship From address is the customer’s address.

fields.name: ShipFromCity
fields.description: The city of the return shipping address. This address tracks the location of the items at the start of the return or repair. For example, if a customer is returning an item, the Ship From address is the customer’s address.

fields.name: ShipFromState
fields.description: The state of the return shipping address. This address tracks the location of the items at the start of the return or repair. For example, if a customer is returning an item, the Ship From address is the customer’s address.

fields.name: ShipFromPostalCode
fields.description: The postal code of the return shipping address. This address tracks the location of the items at the start of the return or repair. For example, if a customer is returning an item, the Ship From address is the customer’s address.

fields.name: ShipFromCountry
fields.description: The country of the return shipping address. This address tracks the location of the items at the start of the return or repair. For example, if a customer is returning an item, the Ship From address is the customer’s address.

fields.name: ShipFromLatitude
fields.description: Used with Longitude to specify the precise geolocation of the return shipping address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: ShipFromLongitude
fields.description: Used with Latitude to specify the precise geolocation of the return shipping address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: ShipFromGeocodeAccuracy
fields.description: Accuracy level of the geocode for the return shipping address. See Compound Field Considerations and Limitations for details on geolocation compound fields.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: ShipFromAddress
fields.description: The return shipping address. This address tracks the location of the items at the start of the return or repair. For example, if a customer is returning an item, the Ship From address is the customer’s address.

fields.name: ReturnedById
fields.description: ID of the user returning the items.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Notes or context about the return order.

fields.name: ExpectedArrivalDate
fields.description: The date when the items are expected to arrive at the destination location.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The status of the return order. Available values are: Draft Submitted Approved Canceled Closed

fields.name: StatusCategory
fields.description: Status category of the return order. Processing of the return order depends on this value. Each status category corresponds to one or more statuses.

fields.name: ExpirationDate
fields.description: Authorizations can’t be captured after their expiration dates.

fields.name: TotalProductAmount
fields.description: Total of the product charges on the return order. This value only includes return order line items of type code Product.

fields.name: TotalProductTaxAmount
fields.description: Tax on the TotalProductAmount.

fields.name: TotalDeliveryAmount
fields.description: Total of the delivery charges on the return order. This value only includes return order line items of type code Charge.

fields.name: TotalDeliveryTaxAmount
fields.description: Tax on the TotalDeliveryAmount.

fields.name: TotalProductAdjustAmount
fields.description: Total amount of the price adjustments applied to the products on the return order. This value only includes adjustments to return order line items of type code Product.

fields.name: TotalProductAdjustTaxAmount
fields.description: Tax on the TotalProductAdjustmentAmount.

fields.name: TotalDeliveryAdjustAmount
fields.description: Total amount of the price adjustments applied to the delivery charges on the return order. This value only includes adjustments to return order line items of type code Charge.

fields.name: TotalDeliveryAdjustTaxAmount
fields.description: Tax on the TotalDeliveryAdjustmentAmount.

fields.name: TotalAmount
fields.description: Adjusted total, not including tax, of the return order line items, including products and delivery charges, on the ReturnOrder.

fields.name: TotalTaxAmount
fields.description: Tax on the TotalAmount.

fields.name: TaxLocaleType
fields.description: The system used to handle tax on the original order associated with the return order. Gross usually applies to taxes like value-added tax (VAT), and Net usually applies to taxes like sales tax.

fields.name: TotalProductAmtWithTax
fields.description: Total amount of the product charges on the return order, inclusive of tax. This value only includes return order line items of type code Product. This amount is equal to TotalProductAmount + TotalProductTaxAmount.

fields.name: TotalDeliveryAmtWithTax
fields.description: Total amount of the delivery charges on the return order, inclusive of tax. This value only includes return order line items of type code Charge. This amount is equal to TotalDeliveryAmount + TotalDeliveryTaxAmount.

fields.name: TotalProductAdjustAmtWithTax
fields.description: Total amount of the price adjustments applied to the products on the return order, inclusive of tax. This value only includes adjustments to return order line items of type code Product. This amount is equal to TotalProductAdjustAmount + TotalProductAdjustTaxAmount.

fields.name: TotalDeliveryAdjustAmtWithTax
fields.description: Total amount of the price adjustments applied to the delivery charges on the return order, inclusive of tax. This value only includes adjustments to return order line items of type code Charge. This amount is equal to TotalDeliveryAdjustAmount + TotalDeliveryAdjustTaxAmount.

fields.name: GrandTotalAmount
fields.description: Total, including adjustments and tax, of the products and delivery charges on the return order. This includes all return order line items associated with the return order. This amount is equal to TotalAmount + TotalTaxAmount.

fields.name: LifeCycleType
fields.description: Specifies whether the order summary is managed by Salesforce Order Management (MANAGED) or by an external system (UNMANAGED). An unmanaged order summary is stored in Salesforce for reference purposes.

typeDefs.name: ReturnOrderSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the return or repair of inventory or products in Field Service, or the return of order products in Order Management.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s name in a managed package, and the changes are reflected in a subscriber’s organization.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language for the organization.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The text that’s used to identify the Visualforce page in the Setup area of Salesforce.

fields.name: Version
fields.description: The SAML version. Valid values are: SAML1_1 SAML2_2

fields.name: Issuer
fields.description: Also called the “Entity ID.” The value is a URL that uniquely identifies the SAML identity provider.

fields.name: OptionsSpInitBinding
fields.description: The service provider initiated request binding, either HTTP Redirect (true) or HTTP POST (false).

fields.name: OptionsUserProvisioning
fields.description: If true, Just-in-Time user provisioning is enabled, which creates users on the fly the first time that they try to log in. Specify Federation ID for the identityMapping value to use this feature.

fields.name: OptionsUseConfigRequestMethod
fields.description: If true, applies the selected Request Signature Method (RSM) during single logout. If false, the default RSM (RSA-SHA1) is applied.

fields.name: AttributeFormat
fields.description: For SAML 2.0 only and when identityLocation is set to Attribute. Possible values include unspecified, emailAddress, or persistent. All legal values can be found in the “Name Identifier Format Identifiers” section of the Assertions and Protocols SAML 2.0 specification.

fields.name: AttributeName
fields.description: The name of the identity provider’s application. Get this name value from your identity provider.

fields.name: Audience
fields.description: The Issuer, also called the “Entity ID.” The value is a URL that uniquely identifies the SAML identity provider.

fields.name: IdentityMapping
fields.description: The identifier that the service provider uses for the user during Just-in-Time user provisioning. Valid values are: Username—The user’s Salesforce username. FederationId—The federation ID from the user object; the identifier that’s used by the service provider for the user. UserId—The user ID from the user’s Salesforce organization.

fields.name: IdentityLocation
fields.description: The location in the assertion where a user is identified. Valid values are: SubjectNameId—The identity is in the <Subject> statement of the assertion. Attribute—The identity is specified in an <AttributeValue>, located in the <Attribute> of the assertion.

fields.name: SamlJitHandlerId
fields.description: The name of an existing Apex class that implements the Auth.SamlJitHandler interface.

fields.name: LoginUrl
fields.description: For SAML 2.0 only: The URL where Salesforce sends a SAML request to start the login sequence.

fields.name: LogoutUrl
fields.description: For SAML 2.0 only: The URL to direct users to where they click the Logout link. The default is http://www.salesforce.com.

fields.name: ErrorUrl
fields.description: When there's an error during login, specify the URL of the page where users are directed. It must be publicly accessible, such as a public site Visualforce page. The URL can be absolute or relative.

fields.name: ValidationCert
fields.description: The certificate that’s used to validate the request. Get this certificate value from your identity provider.

fields.name: RequestSignatureMethod
fields.description: The method that’s used to sign the SAML request. Valid values are: RSA-SHA1 RSA-SHA256

fields.name: SingleLogoutUrl
fields.description: The SAML single logout endpoint. This URL is the endpoint where Salesforce sends LogoutRequests (when Salesforce initiates a logout), or LogoutResponses (when the identity provider initiates a logout).

fields.name: SingleLogoutBinding
fields.description: Determines where to put the LogoutRequest or LogoutResponse in the SAML request during single logout (SLO). The value is base64 encoded. Valid values are: RedirectBinding — Sent in the query string, deflated. PostBinding — Sent in the POST body, not deflated.

typeDefs.name: SamlSsoConfigSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a SAML Single Sign-On configuration.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Required. Name of this custom s-control. Label is Label.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a subscriber’s organization. Label is S-Control Name.When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, performance may slow while Salesforce generates one for each record.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the custom s-control.

fields.name: EncodingKey
fields.description: Picklist of character set encodings, including ISO-08859-1, UTF-8, EUC, JIS, Shift-JIS, Korean (ks_c_5601-1987), Simplified Chinese (GB2312), and Traditional Chinese (Big5).

fields.name: HtmlWrapper
fields.description: Required. HTML page that will be delivered when the user views this custom s-control. This HTML page can be the entire content of the custom s-control, or it can reference the binary. Limit: 1,048,576 characters. Label is HTML Body.

fields.name: Filename
fields.description: An uploaded object to display when the custom s-control is added to a custom link. Can be a Java applet, an ActiveX control, or any other type of desired content.

fields.name: BodyLength
fields.description: The length of the custom s-control. Label is Binary Length.

fields.name: Binary
fields.description: Binary content of this custom s-control, such as an ActiveX control or a Java archive. Can be specified when created, but not when updated. Limit: 5 MB.

fields.name: ContentSource
fields.description: Specifies the source of the s-control content, either custom HTML, a snippet (s-controls that are included in other s-controls), or a URL.

fields.name: SupportsCaching
fields.description: Indicates whether the s-control supports caching (true) or not (false).

typeDefs.name: ScontrolSObject
typeDefs.description: A custom s-control, which is custom content that is hosted by the system but executed by the client application.

fields.name: Query
fields.description: The text of the promoted search term. Maximum length: 100 characters. You can associate the same promoted search term with multiple articles. If the user’s search matches the promoted term, all associated articles are promoted in search results, ordered by relevancy. For best results, create promoted search terms selectively and limit the number of articles that are promoted per term.

typeDefs.name: SearchPromotionRuleSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a promoted search term, which is one or more keywords that you associate with a Salesforce Knowledge article. When a user’s search query includes these keywords, the associated article is returned first in search results.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores.When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, performance may slow while Salesforce generates one for each record.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language of the presence status.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: Label for the category node.

fields.name: NamespacePrefix
fields.description: The namespace prefix associated with the package.

fields.name: Baseline
fields.description: The definition of an org’s security settings standards.

fields.name: IsDefault
fields.description: Sets the baseline as the default in Security Health Check.

typeDefs.name: SecurityCustomBaselineSObject
typeDefs.description: Provides the ability to read, create, and delete user-defined custom security baselines, which define an org’s security standards.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The owner of the service appointment.

fields.name: AppointmentNumber
fields.description: An auto-assigned number that identifies the appointment.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the service appointment was last viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the service appointment was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: ParentRecordId
fields.description: The parent record associated with the appointment. The parent record can’t be updated after the service appointment is created.

fields.name: ParentRecordType
fields.description: (Read only) The type of parent record: Account, Asset, Lead, Opportunity, Work Order, or Work Order Line Item.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: (Read only) The account associated with the appointment. If the parent record is a work order or work order line item, this field’s value is inherited from the parent. Otherwise, it remains blank.

fields.name: WorkTypeId
fields.description: The work type associated with the service appointment. The work type is inherited from the appointment’s parent record if the parent is a work order or work order line item.If Lightning Scheduler is also in use, this field is editable. However, users see an error if they update it to list a different work type than the parent record’s work type.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.description: The contact associated with the parent record. If needed, you can manually update the service appointment contact.

fields.name: Street
fields.description: The street number and name where the service appointment is completed.

fields.name: City
fields.description: The city where the appointment is completed. Maximum length is 40 characters.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The state where the service appointment is completed. Maximum length is 80 characters.

fields.name: PostalCode
fields.description: The postal code where the work order is completed. Maximum length is 20 characters.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: The country where the work order is completed. Maximum length is 80 characters.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Used with Longitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address where the service appointments is completed. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Used with Latitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address where the service appointment is completed. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: GeocodeAccuracy
fields.description: The level of accuracy of a location’s geographical coordinates compared with its physical address. Usually provided by a geocoding service based on the address’s latitude and longitude coordinates.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: Address
fields.description: The address where the appointment is taking place. The address is inherited from the parent record if the parent record is a work order or work order line item.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description of the appointment.

fields.name: EarliestStartTime
fields.description: The date after which the appointment must be completed. Earliest Start Permitted and Due Date typically reflect terms in the customer’s service-level agreement.

fields.name: DueDate
fields.description: The date by which the appointment must be completed. Earliest Start Permitted and Due Date typically reflect terms in the customer’s service-level agreement.

fields.name: Duration
fields.description: The estimated length of the appointment. If the parent record is work order or work order line item, the appointment inherits its parent’s duration, but it can be manually updated. The duration is in minutes or hours based on the value selected in the Duration Type field.

fields.name: ArrivalWindowStartTime
fields.description: The beginning of the window of time in which the technician is scheduled to arrive at the site. This window is typically larger than the Scheduled Start and End window to allow time for delays and scheduling changes. You may choose to share the Arrival Window Start and End with the customer, but keep the Scheduled Start and End internal-only.

fields.name: ArrivalWindowEndTime
fields.description: The end of the window of time in which the technician is scheduled to arrive at the site. This window is typically larger than the Scheduled Start and End window to allow time for delays and scheduling changes. You may choose to share the Arrival Window Start and End with the customer, but keep the Scheduled Start and End internal-only.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The status of the appointment. The picklist includes the following values, which can be customized: None—Default value. Scheduled—Appointment has been assigned to a service resource. Dispatched—Assigned service resource has been notified about their assignment. In Progress—Work has begun. Completed—Work is complete. Cannot Complete—Work could not be completed. Canceled—Work is canceled, typically before any work began

fields.name: SchedStartTime
fields.description: The time at which the appointment is scheduled to start. If you are using the Field Service managed package with the scheduling optimizer, this field is populated once the appointment is assigned to a resource.

fields.name: SchedEndTime
fields.description: The time at which the appointment is scheduled to end. If you are using the Field Service managed package with the scheduling optimizer, this field is populated once the appointment is assigned to a resource. Scheduled End – Scheduled Start = Estimated Duration.

fields.name: ActualStartTime
fields.description: The actual date and time the appointment started.

fields.name: ActualEndTime
fields.description: The actual date and time the appointment ended.

fields.name: ActualDuration
fields.description: The number of minutes that it took the resource to complete the appointment after arriving at the address. When values are first added to the Actual Start and Actual End fields, the Actual Duration is automatically populated to list the difference between the Actual Start and Actual End. If the Actual Start and Actual End fields are subsequently updated, the Actual Duration field doesn’t re-update, but you can manually update it.

fields.name: DurationType
fields.description: The unit of the Duration: Minutes or Hours.

fields.name: ServiceTerritoryId
fields.description: The service territory associated with the appointment. If the parent record is a work order or work order line item, the appointment inherits its parent’s service territory.

fields.name: Subject
fields.description: A short phrase describing the appointment.

fields.name: ParentRecordStatusCategory
fields.description: (Read only) The Status Category of the parent record. If the parent record is a work order or work order line item, this field is populated; otherwise, it remains blank.

fields.name: StatusCategory
fields.description: The category that each Status value falls into. The Status Category field’s values are identical to the default Status values. If you create custom Status values, you must indicate which category it belongs to. For example, if you create a Customer Absent value, you may decide that it belongs in the Cannot Complete category. To learn which processes reference StatusCategory, see How are Status Categories Used?

fields.name: IsAnonymousBooking
fields.description: Indicates whether a service resource was automatically assigned to the appointment. The default value is false.

typeDefs.name: ServiceAppointmentSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an appointment to complete work for a customer in Field Service and Lightning Scheduler.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The label for the picklist value that appears in the UI.

fields.name: ApiName
fields.description: The API name of the status value.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: The value’s position in the drop-down list of values in the UI.

fields.name: IsDefault
fields.description: Indicates that the status value is the default status on service appointments. Only one status value can be the default.

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.description: The status category that the value corresponds to. The Status Category field has seven values which are identical to the default Status values.

typeDefs.name: ServiceAppointmentStatusSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a possible status of a service appointment in field service.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The ID of the user who currently owns the service contract.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the service contract.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: ID of the account associated with the service contract.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.description: Required. ID of the Contact associated with the service contract. Must be a valid ID.

fields.name: Term
fields.description: Number of months that the service contract is valid.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: The first day the service contract is in effect.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: The last day the service contract is in effect.

fields.name: ActivationDate
fields.description: The initial day the service contract went into effect (whereas StartDate may include a renewal date).

fields.name: ApprovalStatus
fields.description: Approval status of the service contract.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the service contract.

fields.name: BillingStreet
fields.description: Street address for the billing address.

fields.name: BillingCity
fields.description: Details for the billing address. Maximum size is 40 characters.

fields.name: BillingState
fields.description: Details for the billing address. Maximum size is 20 characters.

fields.name: BillingPostalCode
fields.description: Details for the billing address. Maximum size is 20 characters.

fields.name: BillingCountry
fields.description: Details for the billing address. Maximum size is 40 characters.

fields.name: BillingLatitude
fields.description: Used with BillingLongitude to specify the precise geolocation of a billing address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: BillingLongitude
fields.description: Used with BillingLatitude to specify the precise geolocation of a billing address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: ShippingStreet
fields.description: The street address of the shipping address. Maximum of 255 characters.

fields.name: ShippingCity
fields.description: Details of the shipping address. Maximum size is 40 characters.

fields.name: ShippingState
fields.description: Details of the shipping address. State maximum size is 20 characters.

fields.name: ShippingPostalCode
fields.description: Details of the shipping address. Postal code maximum size is 20 characters.

fields.name: ShippingCountry
fields.description: Details of the shipping address. Country maximum size is 40 characters.

fields.name: ShippingLatitude
fields.description: Used with ShippingLongitude to specify the precise geolocation of a shipping address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: ShippingLongitude
fields.description: Used with ShippingLatitude to specify the precise geolocation of an address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.

fields.name: Pricebook2Id
fields.description: ID of the Pricebook2 associated with the service contract. Must be a valid ID.

fields.name: Tax
fields.description: Total taxes for the service contract.

fields.name: Subtotal
fields.description: Total of the service contract line items (products) before discounts, taxes, and shipping are applied.

fields.name: TotalPrice
fields.description: Total of the contract line items (products) after discounts and before taxes and shipping.

fields.name: LineItemCount
fields.description: Number of ContractLineItem records associated with the service contract.

fields.name: ContractNumber
fields.description: Unique number automatically assigned to the service contract.

fields.name: SpecialTerms
fields.description: Any terms specifically agreed to and tracked in the service contract.

fields.name: Discount
fields.description: The last day the service contract is in effect.

fields.name: GrandTotal
fields.description: Total price of the service contract plus shipping and taxes.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The status of the service contract, such as Inactive.

fields.name: ParentServiceContractId
fields.description: The service contract’s parent service contract, if it has one.

fields.name: RootServiceContractId
fields.description: (Read only) The top-level service contract in a service contract hierarchy. Depending on where a service contract lies in the hierarchy, its root could be the same as its parent.

typeDefs.name: ServiceContractSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a customer support contract (business agreement).

fields.name: SkillNumber
fields.description: An auto-generated number identifying the resource skill assignment.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the resource skill was last viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the resource skill was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: ServiceResourceId
fields.description: The service resource who possesses the skill.

fields.name: SkillId
fields.description: The skill the service resource possesses.

fields.name: SkillLevel
fields.description: The service resource’s skill level. Skill level can range from zero to 99.99.

fields.name: EffectiveStartDate
fields.description: The date when the service resource gains the skill. For example, if the skill represents a certification, the start date would be the date of certification.

fields.name: EffectiveEndDate
fields.description: The date when the skill expires. For example, if a service resource needs to be re-certified after six months, the end date would be the date their certification expires.

typeDefs.name: ServiceResourceSkillSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a skill that a service resource possesses in Field Service and Lightning Scheduler.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The owner of the service resource.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The resource’s name. You’ll likely want this to be the name or title of the associated user or service crew.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the service resource was last viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the service resource was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: RelatedRecordId
fields.description: The associated user. Its label in the UI is User. If the service resource represents a service crew rather than a user, leave the User field blank and select the related crew in the ServiceCrewId field.

fields.name: ResourceType
fields.description: Indicates whether the resource is a Technician (T), Dispatcher (D), Crew (C), Asset (S), Agent (A), or Planner (P). The default value is Technician (T). Resources who are dispatchers can’t be capacity-based or included in scheduling optimization. Only users with the Field Service Dispatcher permission set license can be dispatchers. You can’t add additional resource types.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description of the resource.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: When selected, this option means that the resource can be assigned to work orders. For service tracking purposes, resources can’t be deleted, so deactivating a resource is the best way to send them into retirement. Deactivating a user deactivates the related service resource. You can’t create a service resource that is linked to an inactive user.

fields.name: LocationId
fields.description: The location associated with the service resource. For example, a service vehicle driven by the service resource.

typeDefs.name: ServiceResourceSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a service technician or service crew in field service in Field Service and Lightning Scheduler.

fields.name: MemberNumber
fields.description: (Read only) An auto-generated number identifying the service territory member.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the territory member was last viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the territory member was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: ServiceTerritoryId
fields.description: The service territory that the service resource is assigned to.

fields.name: ServiceResourceId
fields.description: The service resource assigned to the service territory.

fields.name: TerritoryType
fields.description: Primary, Secondary, or Relocation. The primary territory is typically the territory where the resource works most often—for example, near their home base. Service resources can only have one primary territory. Secondary territories are territories where the resource can be assigned to appointments if needed. Service resources can have multiple secondary territories. Relocation territories represent temporary moves for service resources. If you’re using the Field Service managed packages with the scheduling optimizer, resources with relocation territories are always assigned to services within their relocation territories during the specified relocation dates; if they don’t have a relocation territory, the primary territories are favored over the secondary. For example, a service resource might have the following territories: Primary territory: West Chicago Secondary territories: East Chicago South Chicago Relocation territory: Manhattan, for a three-month period

fields.name: EffectiveStartDate
fields.description: The date when the service resource becomes a member of the service territory.

fields.name: EffectiveEndDate
fields.description: The date when the service resource is no longer a member of the territory. If the resource will be working in the territory for the foreseeable future, leave this field blank. This field is mainly useful for indicating when a temporary relocation ends.

fields.name: Street
fields.description: The street number and name of the member’s address.

fields.name: City
fields.description: The city of the member’s address. Maximum length is 40 characters.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The state of the member’s address. Maximum length is 80 characters.

fields.name: PostalCode
fields.description: The postal code of the member’s address. Maximum length is 20 characters.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: The country of the member’s address. Maximum length is 80 characters.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Used with Longitude to specify the precise geolocation of the member’s address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Used with Latitude to specify the precise geolocation of the member’s address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: GeocodeAccuracy
fields.description: The level of accuracy of a location’s geographical coordinates compared with its physical address. Usually provided by a geocoding service based on the address’s latitude and longitude coordinates.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: Address
fields.description: The member’s address. You may want to list the related service resource’s address in this field.

fields.name: OperatingHoursId
fields.description: The operating hours assigned to the service territory member. If no operating hours are specified, the member is assumed to use their parent service territory’s operating hours. If a member needs special operating hours, create them in Setup and select them in the Operating Hours lookup field on the member’s detail page.

typeDefs.name: ServiceTerritoryMemberSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a service resource who can be assigned to service appointments in a service territory in Field Service and Lightning Scheduler.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the territory.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the territory was last viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date when the territory was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

fields.name: ParentTerritoryId
fields.description: The territory’s parent service territory, if it has one. For example, a Northern California territory can have a State of California territory as its parent. A service territory hierarchy can contain up to 10,000 territories.

fields.name: TopLevelTerritoryId
fields.description: (Read only) The top-level territory in a hierarchy of service territories. Depending on where a territory lies in the hierarchy, its top-level territory might be the same as its parent.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description of the territory.

fields.name: OperatingHoursId
fields.description: The territory’s operating hours, which indicate when service appointments within the territory can occur. Service resources who are members of a territory automatically inherit the territory’s operating hours unless different hours are specified on the resource record.

fields.name: Street
fields.description: The street number and name of the address associated with the territory.

fields.name: City
fields.description: The city of the associated address. Maximum length is 40 characters.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The state of the address associated with the territory. Maximum length is 80 characters.

fields.name: PostalCode
fields.description: The postal code of the address associated with the territory. Maximum length is 20 characters.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: The country to associate with the territory. Maximum length is 80 characters.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Used with Longitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address associated with the territory. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Used with Latitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address associated with the territory. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: GeocodeAccuracy
fields.description: The level of accuracy of a location’s geographical coordinates compared with its physical address. Usually provided by a geocoding service based on the address’s latitude and longitude coordinates.This field is available in the API only.

fields.name: Address
fields.description: An address to associate with the territory. You may want to list the address of the territory’s headquarters.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the service territory is meant to be used. If a territory is inactive, you can’t add members to it or link it to work orders, work order line items, or service appointments.

fields.name: TypicalInTerritoryTravelTime
fields.description: Estimated number of minutes needed to travel from one location to another within the service territory. You can use this field in Apex customization.

typeDefs.name: ServiceTerritorySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a geographic or functional region in which field service work can be performed in Field Service and Lightning Scheduler.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of this service territory-work type relationship.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this object.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date and time that the current user last viewed a record related to this object.

fields.name: WorkTypeId
fields.description: The ID of the work type that’s related to the service territory indicated in the ServiceTerritoryId field.

fields.name: ServiceTerritoryId
fields.description: The ID of the service territory that’s related to the work type indicated in the WorkTypeId field.

typeDefs.name: ServiceTerritoryWorkTypeSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the relationship between a ServiceTerritory object and a WorkType object for Lightning Scheduler appointments.

fields.name: AuthSessionId
fields.description: The session ID related to this permission set assignment for its duration.

fields.name: PermissionSetId
fields.description: The permission set ID related to this permission set assignment and user for its duration.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: The user ID of the user to whom this permission set assignment applies for its duration.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The session details, such as device used and browser.

typeDefs.name: SessionPermSetActivationSObject
typeDefs.description: The SessionPermSetActivation object represents a permission set assignment activated during an individual user session. When a SessionPermSetActivation object is inserted into a permission set, an activation event fires, allowing the permission settings to apply to the user’s specific session.

fields.name: Action
fields.description: The category of the change made in Setup. For example, a value of PermSetCreate indicates that an administrator created a permission set. The Display field contains more specific information.

fields.name: Section
fields.description: The section in the Setup menu where the action occurred. For example, Manage Users or Company Profile.

fields.name: Display
fields.description: The full description of changes made in Setup. For example, if the Action field has a value of PermSetCreate, the Display field has a value like “Created permission set MAD: with user license Salesforce.”

fields.name: DelegateUser
fields.description: The Login-As user who executed the action in Setup. If a Login-As user didn’t perform the action, this field is blank. This field is available in API version 35.0 and later.

fields.name: CreatedByContext
fields.description: The context under which the Setup change was made. For example, if Einstein uses cloud-to-cloud services to make a change in Setup, the value of this field is Einstein. This field is available in API version 48.0 and later.

fields.name: CreatedByIssuer
fields.description: Reserved for future use.

typeDefs.name: SetupAuditTrailSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents changes you or other admins made in your org’s Setup area for at least the last 180 days.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: The ID of the entity’s parent PermissionSet.

fields.name: SetupEntityId
fields.description: The ID of the entity for which access is enabled, such as an Apex class or Visualforce page.

fields.name: SetupEntityType
fields.description: The type of setup entity for which access is enabled. Valid values are: ApexClass for Apex classes ApexPage for Visualforce pages In API version 28.0 and later, ConnectedApplication for OAuth connected apps In API version 31.0 and later, CustomPermission for custom permissions In API version 28.0 and later, ServiceProvider for service providers In API version 28.0 and later, TabSet for apps In API version 48.0 and later, CustomEntityDefinition for Custom Settings and Custom Metadata Types

typeDefs.name: SetupEntityAccessSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the enabled setup entity access settings (such as for Apex classes) for the parent PermissionSet.

fields.name: ShiftId
fields.description: ID of the shift being tracked. The history is displayed on the detail page for this record.

fields.name: Field
fields.description: The name of the field that was changed.

fields.name: OldValue
fields.description: The value of the field before it was changed.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

typeDefs.name: ShiftHistorySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the history of changes made to tracked fields on a time sheet.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: The shift associated with the sharing entry.

fields.name: UserOrGroupId
fields.description: (Read only) ID of the user or group that has access to the shift record.

fields.name: AccessLevel
fields.description: Level of access that the user or group has to the shift. The possible values are: Read Edit All (This value isn’t valid for create or update calls.) Set to an access level that is at least equal to the organization’s default shift access level.

fields.name: RowCause
fields.description: The reason why this sharing entry exists. You can write to this field only when its value is omitted or set to Manual (default). Valid values include: Manual—The User or Group has access because a user with “All” access manually shared the shift record. Owner—The User is the owner of the shift. Rule—The User or Group has access via a shift sharing rule. GuestRule—The User or Group has access via a shift guest user sharing rule.

typeDefs.name: ShiftShareSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a sharing entry on a field service shift.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The owner of the shift.

fields.name: ShiftNumber
fields.description: The number automatically given to the shift upon creation.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date and time when the current user last viewed this record.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The date and time when the current user last viewed a related record.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: The label that a shift is given.

fields.name: StartTime
fields.description: The date and time that the shift starts.

fields.name: EndTime
fields.description: The date and time that the shift ends.

fields.name: ServiceResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the service resource the shift belongs to. Available in API versions 47.0 and later.

fields.name: ServiceTerritoryId
fields.description: The ID of the service territory the shift belongs to. Available in API versions 47.0 and later.

fields.name: StatusCategory
fields.description: Describes the status of the shift using static values. This field is derived from Status using the mapping defined in setup.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Describes the status of the shift. Users can create custom values. Default values are: Tentative Published Confirmed

fields.name: TimeSlotType
fields.description: Type of time slot for the shift. The same setup values as the TimeSlot field in the OperatingHours object.

typeDefs.name: ShiftSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a shift for service resource scheduling.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: Master label for this shift status value. This display value is the internal label that does not get translated. Limit: 255 characters.

fields.name: ApiName
fields.description: Uniquely identifies a picklist value so it can be retrieved without using an ID or master label.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Number used to sort this value in the shift status picklist. These numbers are not guaranteed to be sequential, as some previous shift status values might have been deleted.

fields.name: IsDefault
fields.description: Indicates whether this is the default shift status value (true) or not (false) in the picklist. Only one value can be the default value.

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.description: Describes the status of the shift using static values. Possible values are: Tentative Published Confirmed

typeDefs.name: ShiftStatusSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a shift, such as Tentative, Published, or Confirmed.

fields.name: ShipmentItemNumber
fields.description: An auto-generated number identifying the shipment item.

fields.name: ShipmentId
fields.description: (Master-Detail) The shipment that contains the shipment item.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the shipment item.

fields.name: Product2Id
fields.description: The product represented by the shipment item.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: The quantity of products represented by the shipment item.

fields.name: ExpectedDeliveryDate
fields.description: Expected delivery date of the shipment that contains the shipment item.

fields.name: TrackingNumber
fields.description: The tracking number of the shipment that contains the shipment item.

fields.name: TrackingUrl
fields.description: The tracking URL of the shipment that contains the shipment item.

typeDefs.name: ShipmentItemSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an order item included in a shipment.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: The owner of the shipment.

fields.name: ShipmentNumber
fields.description: An auto-generated number identifying the shipment.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: SourceLocationId
fields.description: The field service location where the shipment originates.

fields.name: DestinationLocationId
fields.description: The place the product is to be delivered.

fields.name: ShipToName
fields.description: The shipment recipient.

fields.name: TotalItemsQuantity
fields.description: The total quantity of items included in the shipment. This value is calculated as the sum of the quantities of the shipment items in the shipment.

typeDefs.name: ShipmentSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the transport of inventory in field service or a shipment of order items in Order Management.

fields.name: DurableId
fields.description: The ID of the Site object.

fields.name: IsRegistrationEnabled
fields.description: Indicates whether the site allows users to sign up.

fields.name: SecureUrl
fields.description: The URL of the website.

typeDefs.name: SiteDetailSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the details of a Salesforce site or Experience Cloud site.

fields.name: SiteId
fields.description: The ID of the associated Site.

fields.name: Field
fields.description: The name of the field that was changed.

fields.name: OldValue
fields.description: The last value of the field before it was changed.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

typeDefs.name: SiteHistorySObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the history of changes to the values in the fields of a site.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name used when referencing the site in the API.

fields.name: Subdomain
fields.description: The Salesforce domain that you registered for your site. For example, if your domain is SitesSubdomainName.secure.force.com, then SitesSubdomainName is the subdomain.

fields.name: UrlPathPrefix
fields.description: The unique Salesforce URL that the public uses to access this site.

fields.name: GuestUserId
fields.description: The site or Experience Cloud sites specific user that anonymous, unauthenticated users run as when interacting with the site.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The status for the site. For example, Active or In Maintenance.

fields.name: AdminId
fields.description: The site administrator designated as the contact for the site. This user receives site-related communications from site visitors and from Salesforce.

fields.name: OptionsEnableFeeds
fields.description: The option that displays the Syndication Feeds related list, where you can create and manage syndication feeds for users on your public sites. This field is visible only if you have the feature enabled for your organization.

fields.name: OptionsAllowHomePage
fields.description: The option to enable the standard page associated with the Home tab (/home/home.jsp).

fields.name: OptionsAllowStandardIdeasPages
fields.description: The option to enable standard pages associated with an Ideas Experience Cloud site. If you want to use default Ideas pages (such as IdeasHome), enable these pages.

fields.name: OptionsAllowStandardSearch
fields.description: The option to enable the standard search pages. To allow public users to perform standard searches, enable these pages.

fields.name: OptionsAllowStandardLookups
fields.description: The option to enable the standard lookup pages. These are the popup windows associated with lookup fields on Visualforce pages.

fields.name: OptionsAllowStandardAnswersPages
fields.description: The option to enable standard pages associated with an answers Experience Cloud site. If you want to use default Answers pages (such as AnswersHome), enable these pages.

fields.name: OptionsAllowGuestSupportApi
fields.description: The option to enable unauthenticated users to access the Support API.

fields.name: OptionsAllowStandardPortalPages
fields.description: The option to enable authenticated users to access the standard Salesforce pages.

fields.name: OptionsContentSniffingProtection
fields.description: The option to enable content-sniffing protection.

fields.name: OptionsBrowserXssProtection
fields.description: The option to enable the browser's cross-site scripting protection.

fields.name: OptionsReferrerPolicyOriginWhenCrossOrigin
fields.description: The option to enable referrer policy (origin-when-cross-origin).

fields.name: Description
fields.description: An optional description of the site.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The name of the site as it appears in the user interface.

fields.name: AnalyticsTrackingCode
fields.description: The tracking code associated with your site. This code can be used by services like Google Analytics to track page request data for your site.

fields.name: SiteType
fields.description: Identifies whether the site is a Visualforce (Salesforce Sites) or a Site.com site. SiteType is available in API version 21.0 and later. In API version 26.0 and later, if Experience Cloud sites are enabled for your Salesforce org, the site could also be a Network Visualforce or Network Site.com site.

fields.name: ClickjackProtectionLevel
fields.description: Sets the clickjack protection level. The options are: AllowAllFraming—Allow framing by any page (no protection) SameOriginOnly—Allow framing by the same origin only (recommended) NoFraming—Don’t allow framing by any page (most protection)

fields.name: DailyBandwidthLimit
fields.description: The rolling 24-hour daily bandwidth limit for the sites in your organization.

fields.name: DailyBandwidthUsed
fields.description: The current rolling 24-hour daily bandwidth usage for the sites in your organization.

fields.name: DailyRequestTimeLimit
fields.description: The rolling 24-hour daily service request time limit for the sites in your organization. Service request time is calculated as the total server time in minutes required to generate pages for the site.

fields.name: DailyRequestTimeUsed
fields.description: The current rolling 24-hour daily service request time for the sites in your organization.

fields.name: MonthlyPageViewsEntitlement
fields.description: The number of page views allowed for the current calendar month for the sites in your organization.

fields.name: GuestRecordDefaultOwnerId
fields.description: A user in the Salesforce org that is the default owner of records created by unauthenticated (guest) users.

typeDefs.name: SiteSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a public website that is integrated with an org.

fields.name: SkillNumber
fields.description: An auto-generated number identifying the skill requirement.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

fields.name: RelatedRecordId
fields.description: The record that the skill is required for. The related record can be a work order, work order line item, work type, or pending service routing record.

fields.name: SkillId
fields.description: The skill that is required.

fields.name: SkillLevel
fields.description: The level of the skill required. Skill levels can range from zero to 99.99. Depending on your business needs, you might want the skill level to reflect years of experience, certification levels, or license classes.

typeDefs.name: SkillRequirementSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a skill that is required to complete a particular task in Field Service and Lightning Scheduler. Skill requirements can be added to work types, work orders, and work order line items in Field Service and Lightning Scheduler.

fields.name: DeveloperName
fields.description: The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. In managed packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a subscriber’s organization. When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, performance may slow while Salesforce generates one for each record.

fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language of the skill.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The name of the skill.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed the skill.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description of the skill.

typeDefs.name: SkillSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a category or group that Chat users or field service resources can be assigned to.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the entitlement process.

fields.name: NameNorm
fields.description: The read-only value for the unique name of the entitlement process or the entitlement process version. If entitlement versioning is enabled, this value is automatically generated for each version of an entitlement process in this form: process name+_v + x, where x is the version number (for example, “gold_support_v2”).

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A description of the entitlement process.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the entitlement process is active (true) or not (false).

fields.name: StartDateField
fields.description: The criteria for cases to enter the entitlement process. Cases can enter the process based on: The creation date on a case A custom date/time field on a case

fields.name: BusinessHoursId
fields.description: Required. ID of the BusinessHours associated with the entitlement. Must be a valid business hours ID.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The date when the SlaProcess was last viewed.

typeDefs.name: SlaProcessSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents an entitlement process associated with an Entitlement.

fields.name: IsDeleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

fields.name: SolutionNumber
fields.description: An identifying number that is assigned automatically when a solution is created. It can’t be set directly, and it can’t be modified.

fields.name: SolutionName
fields.description: Required. If a client application creates a new Solution and a value for this field is unspecified, a hyphen (-), the default value for this field, is used. Limit: 255 characters. Label is Title.

fields.name: IsPublished
fields.description: Indicates whether the Solution has been published (true) or not (false). A solution’s published state does not affect how it can be used, or whether you can query, update, or delete it. Label is Public.Prior to Spring ‘14, the label was Visible in Self-Service Portal.

fields.name: IsPublishedInPublicKb
fields.description: Indicates whether the Solution has been published as a Public Solution (true) or not (false). Label is Visible in Public Knowledge Base. This field only applies to solutions, not articles in the public knowledge base.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Required. The status of the solution. Directly controls the IsReviewed value. To obtain the status values in the picklist, a client application can query the SolutionStatus.

fields.name: IsReviewed
fields.description: Indicates whether the Solution has been reviewed (true) or not (false). This flag can only be set indirectly via the Status picklist. Each predefined Status value implies an IsReviewed value. Label is Reviewed.

fields.name: SolutionNote
fields.description: The details of the Solution record. Limit: 32,000 characters. Label is Solution Details.If you have HTML Solutions enabled, any HTML tags used in this field are verified before the object is created or updated. If invalid HTML is entered, an error is thrown. Any JavaScript used in this field is removed before the object is created or updated.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.description: ID of the User who owns the Solution.

fields.name: TimesUsed
fields.description: Number of times this solution has been used. Label is Num Related Case.

fields.name: LastViewedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

fields.name: LastReferencedDate
fields.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

fields.name: IsHtml
fields.description: Indicates whether the Solution is an HTML solution (true) or not (false).

typeDefs.name: SolutionSObject

fields.name: MasterLabel

fields.name: ApiName
fields.description: Uniquely identifies a picklist value so it can be retrieved without using an id or master label.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Number used to sort this value in the solution status picklist. These numbers are not guaranteed to be sequential, as some previous solution status values might have been deleted.

fields.name: IsDefault
fields.description: Indicates whether this is the default solution status value (true) or not (false) in the picklist. Only one value can be the default value.

fields.name: IsReviewed
fields.description: Indicates whether this solution status value represents a reviewed Solution (true) or not (false). Multiple solution status values can represent a reviewed Solution.

typeDefs.name: SolutionStatusSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents the status of a Solution, such as Draft, Reviewed, and so on.

fields.name: StampId
fields.description: The unique id generated when creating a user specialty.

fields.name: SubjectId
fields.description: The id for the user getting the User Specialty label.

typeDefs.name: StampAssignmentSObject

fields.name: ParentId
fields.description: The id of the org or network.

fields.name: MasterLabel
fields.description: The User Specialty label that appears under the user’s profile picture. You can create any label you want as long as it’s within the 50 character maximum, including spaces and underscores.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Use this field to describe what the user specialty means and how it applies to a user. You have a 255 character maximum including spaces and underscores.

typeDefs.name: StampSObject
typeDefs.description: Represents a User Specialty.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Required. Name of the static resource.

fields.name: ContentType
fields.description: Type of content. Label is Mime Type. Limit: 120 characters.

fields.name: BodyLength
fields.description: Size of the file (in bytes).

fields.name: Body
fields.description: Required. Encoded file data.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Text description of the static resource. Limit: 255 characters.

fields.name: CacheControl
fields.description: The sharing policy for the static resource when cached. The cache control can have one of the following values: Private specifies that the static resource data cached on the Salesforce server shouldn’t be shared with other users. The static resource is only stored in cache for the current user’s session. Public specifies that the static resource data cached on the Salesforce server be shared with other users in your organization for faster load times.

typeDefs.name: StaticResourceSObject

fields.name: WhoId
fields.description: The WhoId represents a human such as a lead or a contact. WhoIds are polymorphic. Polymorphic means a WhoId is equivalent to a contact’s ID or a lead’s ID. The label is Name ID. If Shared Activities is enabled, the value of this field is the ID of the related lead or primary contact. If you add, update, or remove the WhoId field, you might encounter problems with triggers, workflows, and data validation rules that are associated with the record. The label is Name ID. Beginning in API version 37.0, if the contact or lead ID in the WhoId field is not in the TaskWhoIds list, no error occurs and the ID is added to the TaskWhoIds as the primary WhoId. If WhoId is set to null, an arbitrary ID from the existing TaskWhoIds list is promoted to the primary position.

fields.name: WhatId

fields.name: ActivityDate
fields.description: Represents the due date of the task. This field has a timestamp that is always set to midnight in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone. The timestamp is not relevant; do not attempt to alter it to accommodate time zone differences. Label is Due Date.This field can’t be set or updated for a recurring task (IsRecurrence is true).

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Required. The status of the task, such as In Progress or Completed. Each predefined Status field implies a value for the IsClosed flag. To obtain picklist values, query the TaskStatus object.This field can’t be updated for recurring tasks (IsRecurrence is true).

fields.name: Priority

fields.name: IsHighPriority

fields.name: OwnerId

fields.name: Description

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: Represents the ID of the related Account. The AccountId is determined as follows. If the value of WhatId is any of the following objects, then Salesforce uses that object’s AccountId. Account Opportunity Contract Custom object that is a child of Account If the value of the WhatIdfield is any other object, and the value of the WhoId field is a Contact object, then Salesforce uses that contact’s AccountId. (If your organization uses Shared Activities, then Salesforce uses the AccountId of the primary contact.) Otherwise, Salesforce sets the value of the AccountId field to null. For information on IDs, see ID Field Type.

fields.name: IsArchived

fields.name: CallDisposition

fields.name: ReminderDateTime
fields.description: Represents the time when the reminder is scheduled to fire, if IsReminderSet is set to true. If IsReminderSet is set to false, then the user may have deselected the reminder checkbox in the Salesforce user interface, or the reminder has already fired at the time indicated by the value.

fields.name: IsReminderSet

fields.name: RecurrenceActivityId
fields.description: Read-only. Not required on create. ID of the main record of the recurring task. Subsequent occurrences have the same value in this field.

fields.name: IsRecurrence
fields.description: Indicates whether the task is scheduled to repeat itself (true) or only occurs once (false). This field is read-only on update, but not on create. If this field value is true, then RecurrenceStartDateOnly, RecurrenceEndDateOnly, RecurrenceType, and any recurrence fields associated with the given recurrence type must be populated. See Recurring Tasks.

fields.name: RecurrenceStartDateOnly
fields.description: The date when the recurring task begins. Must be a date and time before RecurrenceEndDateOnly.

fields.name: RecurrenceEndDateOnly
fields.description: The last date on which the task repeats. This field has a timestamp that is always set to midnight in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone. The timestamp is not relevant; do not attempt to alter it to accommodate time zone differences.

fields.name: RecurrenceTimeZoneSidKey
fields.description: The time zone associated with the recurring task. For example, “UTC-8:00” for Pacific Standard Time.

fields.name: RecurrenceType
fields.description: Indicates how often the task repeats. For example, daily, weekly, or every nth month (where “nth” is defined in RecurrenceInstance).

fields.name: RecurrenceInterval
fields.description: The interval between recurring tasks.

fields.name: RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask
fields.description: The day or days of the week on which the task repeats. This field contains a bitmask. The values are as follows: Sunday = 1 Monday = 2 Tuesday = 4 Wednesday = 8 Thursday = 16 Friday = 32 Saturday = 64 Multiple days are represented as the sum of their numerical values. For example, Tuesday and Thursday = 4 + 16 = 20.

fields.name: RecurrenceDayOfMonth
fields.description: The day of the month in which the task repeats.

fields.name: RecurrenceInstance
fields.description: The frequency of the recurring task.

fields.name: RecurrenceMonthOfYear
fields.description: The month of the year in which the task repeats.

fields.name: RecurrenceRegeneratedType
fields.description: Represents what triggers a repeating task to repeat. Add this field to a page layout together with the RecurrenceInterval field, which determines the number of days between the triggering date (due date or close date) and the due date of the next repeating task in the series. Label is Repeat This Task. This field has the following picklist values: None: The task doesn’t repeat. After due date: The next repeating task will be due the specified number of days after the current task’s due date. After the task is closed: The next repeating task will be due the specified number of days after the current task is closed. (Task closed): This task, now closed, was opened as part of a repeating series. When tasks in a series are set to repeat after their due date, Salesforce doesn’t create recurrences that would have been due in the past. Instead, Salesforce keeps adding the interval until a repeated task has a due date in the future. For example, suppose that someone sets a task to repeat three days after it’s due. But, that person doesn’t complete the task (mark it Closed) until five days after it’s due. Instead of creating a task that’s already overdue, Salesforce gives the new task a due date of tomorrow. This due date is equivalent to 6 days after the due date; two intervals of three days each. If that person completes the repeating task (marks it Closed) before the due date, the next task is still due three days after the due date.

fields.name: CompletedDateTime
fields.description: The date and time the task was saved with a Closed status. For insert, if the task is saved with a Closed status the field is set. If the task is saved with an Open status the field is set to NULL. For update, if the task is saved with a new Closed status, the field is reset. If the task is saved with a new non-closed status, the field is reset to NULL. If the task is saved with the same closed status (that is, unchanged) there is no change to the field. The status is a dynamic enum. If the Closed mapping is changed it won’t cause an update of existing tasks. Only new insert/update operations are affected.
