fields.name: RecordingStatusCallback
fields.description: The URL we should call using the `recording_status_callback_method` on each recording event specified in  `recording_status_callback_event`. For more information, see [RecordingStatusCallback parameters](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/recording#recordingstatuscallback).

fields.name: RecordingStatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use to call `recording_status_callback`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`.

fields.name: Trim
fields.description: Whether to trim any leading and trailing silence in the recording. Can be: `trim-silence` or `do-not-trim` and the default is `do-not-trim`. `trim-silence` trims the silence from the beginning and end of the recording and `do-not-trim` does not.

fields.name: RecordingChannels
fields.description: The number of channels used in the recording. Can be: `mono` or `dual` and the default is `mono`. `mono` records all parties of the call into one channel. `dual` records each party of a 2-party call into separate channels.

fields.name: RecordingTrack
fields.description: The audio track to record for the call. Can be: `inbound`, `outbound` or `both`. The default is `both`. `inbound` records the audio that is received by Twilio. `outbound` records the audio that is generated from Twilio. `both` records the audio that is received and generated by Twilio.

fields.name: To
fields.description: The phone number, SIP address, or client identifier to call.

fields.name: From
fields.description: The phone number or client identifier to use as the caller id. If using a phone number, it must be a Twilio number or a Verified [outgoing caller id](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/outgoing-caller-ids) for your account. If the `to` parameter is a phone number, `From` must also be a phone number.

fields.name: Method
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use when calling the `url` parameter's value. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.

fields.name: FallbackUrl
fields.description: The URL that we call using the `fallback_method` if an error occurs when requesting or executing the TwiML at `url`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.

fields.name: FallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method that we should use to request the `fallback_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.

fields.name: StatusCallback
fields.description: The URL we should call using the `status_callback_method` to send status information to your application. If no `status_callback_event` is specified, we will send the `completed` status. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored. URLs must contain a valid hostname (underscores are not permitted).

fields.name: StatusCallbackEvent
fields.description: The call progress events that we will send to the `status_callback` URL. Can be: `initiated`, `ringing`, `answered`, and `completed`. If no event is specified, we send the `completed` status. If you want to receive multiple events, specify each one in a separate `status_callback_event` parameter. See the code sample for [monitoring call progress](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource?code-sample=code-create-a-call-resource-and-specify-a-statuscallbackevent&code-sdk-version=json). If an `application_sid` is present, this parameter is ignored.

fields.name: StatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use when calling the `status_callback` URL. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.

fields.name: SendDigits
fields.description: A string of keys to dial after connecting to the number, maximum of 32 digits. Valid digits in the string include: any digit (`0`-`9`), '`#`', '`*`' and '`w`', to insert a half second pause. For example, if you connected to a company phone number and wanted to pause for one second, and then dial extension 1234 followed by the pound key, the value of this parameter would be `ww1234#`. Remember to URL-encode this string, since the '`#`' character has special meaning in a URL. If both `SendDigits` and `MachineDetection` parameters are provided, then `MachineDetection` will be ignored.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.description: The integer number of seconds that we should allow the phone to ring before assuming there is no answer. The default is `60` seconds and the maximum is `600` seconds. For some call flows, we will add a 5-second buffer to the timeout value you provide. For this reason, a timeout value of 10 seconds could result in an actual timeout closer to 15 seconds. You can set this to a short time, such as `15` seconds, to hang up before reaching an answering machine or voicemail.

fields.name: Record
fields.description: Whether to record the call. Can be `true` to record the phone call, or `false` to not. The default is `false`. The `recording_url` is sent to the `status_callback` URL.

fields.name: RecordingChannels
fields.description: The number of channels in the final recording. Can be: `mono` or `dual`. The default is `mono`. `mono` records both legs of the call in a single channel of the recording file. `dual` records each leg to a separate channel of the recording file. The first channel of a dual-channel recording contains the parent call and the second channel contains the child call.

fields.name: RecordingStatusCallback
fields.description: The URL that we call when the recording is available to be accessed.

fields.name: RecordingStatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use when calling the `recording_status_callback` URL. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`.

fields.name: SipAuthUsername
fields.description: The username used to authenticate the caller making a SIP call.

fields.name: SipAuthPassword
fields.description: The password required to authenticate the user account specified in `sip_auth_username`.

fields.name: MachineDetection
fields.description: Whether to detect if a human, answering machine, or fax has picked up the call. Can be: `Enable` or `DetectMessageEnd`. Use `Enable` if you would like us to return `AnsweredBy` as soon as the called party is identified. Use `DetectMessageEnd`, if you would like to leave a message on an answering machine. If `send_digits` is provided, this parameter is ignored. For more information, see [Answering Machine Detection](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/answering-machine-detection).

fields.name: MachineDetectionTimeout
fields.description: The number of seconds that we should attempt to detect an answering machine before timing out and sending a voice request with `AnsweredBy` of `unknown`. The default timeout is 30 seconds.

fields.name: RecordingStatusCallbackEvent
fields.description: The recording status events that will trigger calls to the URL specified in `recording_status_callback`. Can be: `in-progress`, `completed` and `absent`. Defaults to `completed`. Separate  multiple values with a space.

fields.name: Trim
fields.description: Whether to trim any leading and trailing silence from the recording. Can be: `trim-silence` or `do-not-trim` and the default is `trim-silence`.

fields.name: CallerId
fields.description: The phone number, SIP address, or Client identifier that made this call. Phone numbers are in [E.164 format](https://wwnw.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) (e.g., +16175551212). SIP addresses are formatted as `name@company.com`.

fields.name: MachineDetectionSpeechThreshold
fields.description: The number of milliseconds that is used as the measuring stick for the length of the speech activity, where durations lower than this value will be interpreted as a human and longer than this value as a machine. Possible Values: 1000-6000. Default: 2400.

fields.name: MachineDetectionSpeechEndThreshold
fields.description: The number of milliseconds of silence after speech activity at which point the speech activity is considered complete. Possible Values: 500-5000. Default: 1200.

fields.name: MachineDetectionSilenceTimeout
fields.description: The number of milliseconds of initial silence after which an `unknown` AnsweredBy result will be returned. Possible Values: 2000-10000. Default: 5000.

fields.name: AsyncAmd
fields.description: Select whether to perform answering machine detection in the background. Default, blocks the execution of the call until Answering Machine Detection is completed. Can be: `true` or `false`.

fields.name: AsyncAmdStatusCallback
fields.description: The URL that we should call using the `async_amd_status_callback_method` to notify customer application whether the call was answered by human, machine or fax.

fields.name: AsyncAmdStatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use when calling the `async_amd_status_callback` URL. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`.

fields.name: Byoc
fields.description: The SID of a BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) trunk to route this call with. Note that `byoc` is only meaningful when `to` is a phone number; it will otherwise be ignored. (Beta)

fields.name: CallReason
fields.description: The Reason for the outgoing call. Use it to specify the purpose of the call that is presented on the called party's phone. (Branded Calls Beta)

fields.name: CallToken
fields.description: A token string needed to invoke a forwarded call. A call_token is generated when an incoming call is received on a Twilio number. Pass an incoming call's call_token value to a forwarded call via the call_token parameter when creating a new call. A forwarded call should bear the same CallerID of the original incoming call.

fields.name: RecordingTrack
fields.description: The audio track to record for the call. Can be: `inbound`, `outbound` or `both`. The default is `both`. `inbound` records the audio that is received by Twilio. `outbound` records the audio that is generated from Twilio. `both` records the audio that is received and generated by Twilio.

fields.name: TimeLimit

fields.name: Url

fields.name: InstalledAddOnSid

fields.name: FriendlyName

fields.name: SmsFallbackMethod

fields.name: SmsFallbackUrl

fields.name: SmsMethod

fields.name: SmsUrl

fields.name: StatusCallback
fields.description: The URL we should call using the `status_callback_method` to send status information to your application.

fields.name: StatusCallbackMethod

fields.name: VoiceCallerIdLookup

fields.name: VoiceFallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method that we should use to call `voice_fallback_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and defaults to `POST`.

fields.name: PhoneNumber

fields.name: StatusCallback

URL must contain a valid hostname and underscores are not allowed. If you include this parameter with the `messaging_service_sid`, Twilio uses this URL instead of the Status Callback URL of the [Messaging Service](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/api/service-resource).

fields.name: ApplicationSid
fields.description: The SID of the associated [TwiML Application](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/applications). If this parameter is provided, the `status_callback` parameter of this request is ignored; [Message status callback requests](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/api/message-resource#twilios-request-to-the-statuscallback-url) are sent to the TwiML App's `message_status_callback` URL.

fields.name: MaxPrice
fields.description: The maximum price in US dollars that you are willing to pay for this Message's delivery. The value can have up to four decimal places. When the `max_price` parameter is provided, the cost of a message is checked before it is sent. If the cost exceeds `max_price`, the message is not sent and the Message `status` is `failed`.

fields.name: ProvideFeedback
fields.description: Boolean indicating whether or not you intend to provide delivery confirmation feedback to Twilio (used in conjunction with the [Message Feedback subresource](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/api/message-feedback-resource)). Default value is `false`.

fields.name: Attempt
fields.description: Total number of attempts made (including this request) to send the message regardless of the provider used

fields.name: ValidityPeriod
fields.description: The maximum length in seconds that the Message can remain in Twilio's outgoing message queue. If a queued Message exceeds the `validity_period`, the Message is not sent. Accepted values are integers from `1` to `14400`. Default value is `14400`. A `validity_period` greater than `5` is recommended. [Learn more about the validity period](https://www.twilio.com/blog/take-more-control-of-outbound-messages-using-validity-period-html)

fields.name: ForceDelivery
fields.description: Reserved

fields.name: SmartEncoded
fields.description: Whether to detect Unicode characters that have a similar GSM-7 character and replace them. Can be: `true` or `false`.

fields.name: PersistentAction
fields.description: Rich actions for non-SMS/MMS channels. Used for [sending location in WhatsApp messages](https://www.twilio.com/docs/whatsapp/message-features#location-messages-with-whatsapp).

fields.name: ShortenUrls
fields.description: For Messaging Services with [Link Shortening configured](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/features/how-to-configure-link-shortening) only: A Boolean indicating whether or not Twilio should shorten links in the `body` of the Message. Default value is `false`. If `true`, the `messaging_service_sid` parameter must also be provided.

fields.name: SendAt
fields.description: The time that Twilio will send the message. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: SendAsMms
fields.description: If set to `true`, Twilio delivers the message as a single MMS message, regardless of the presence of media.

fields.name: ContentVariables
fields.description: For [Content Editor/API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content) only: Key-value pairs of [Template variables](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/using-variables-with-content-api) and their substitution values. `content_sid` parameter must also be provided. If values are not defined in the `content_variables` parameter, the [Template's default placeholder values](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/content-api-resources#create-templates) are used.

fields.name: From
fields.description: The sender's Twilio phone number (in [E.164](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164) format), [alphanumeric sender ID](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/send-messages#use-an-alphanumeric-sender-id), [Wireless SIM](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iot/wireless/programmable-wireless-send-machine-machine-sms-commands), [short code](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/api/short-code), or [channel address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/channels) (e.g., `whatsapp:+15554449999`). The value of the `from` parameter must be a sender that is hosted within Twilio and belongs to the Account creating the Message. If you are using `messaging_service_sid`, this parameter can be empty (Twilio assigns a `from` value from the Messaging Service's Sender Pool) or you can provide a specific sender from your Sender Pool.

fields.name: MessagingServiceSid
fields.description: The SID of the [Messaging Service](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/services) you want to associate with the Message. When this parameter is provided and the `from` parameter is omitted, Twilio selects the optimal sender from the Messaging Service's Sender Pool. You may also provide a `from` parameter if you want to use a specific Sender from the Sender Pool.

fields.name: Body
fields.description: The text content of the outgoing message. Can be up to 1,600 characters in length. SMS only: If the `body` contains more than 160 [GSM-7](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-is-gsm-7-character-encoding) characters (or 70 [UCS-2](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-is-ucs-2-character-encoding) characters), the message is segmented and charged accordingly. For long `body` text, consider using the [send_as_mms parameter](https://www.twilio.com/blog/mms-for-long-text-messages).

fields.name: MediaUrl
fields.description: The URL of media to include in the Message content. `jpeg`, `jpg`, `gif`, and `png` file types are fully supported by Twilio and content is formatted for delivery on destination devices. The media size limit is 5 MB for supported file types (`jpeg`, `jpg`, `png`, `gif`) and 500 KB for [other types](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/accepted-mime-types) of accepted media. To send more than one image in the message, provide multiple `media_url` parameters in the POST request. You can include up to ten `media_url` parameters per message. [International](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/223179808-Sending-and-receiving-MMS-messages) and [carrier](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/223133707-Is-MMS-supported-for-all-carriers-in-US-and-Canada-) limits apply.

fields.name: ContentSid
fields.description: For [Content Editor/API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content) only: The SID of the Content Template to be used with the Message, e.g., `HXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX`. If this parameter is not provided, a Content Template is not used. Find the SID in the Console on the Content Editor page. For Content API users, the SID is found in Twilio's response when [creating the Template](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/content-api-resources#create-templates) or by [fetching your Templates](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/content-api-resources#fetch-all-content-resources).

fields.name: FriendlyName
fields.description: A descriptive string that you create to describe the resource. It can be up to 64 characters long.

fields.name: FriendlyName
fields.description: A descriptive string that you create to describe the resource. It can be up to 64 characters long.

fields.name: From
fields.description: The phone number, Client identifier, or username portion of SIP address that made this call. Phone numbers are in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format (e.g., +16175551212). Client identifiers are formatted `client:name`. If using a phone number, it must be a Twilio number or a Verified [outgoing caller id](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/outgoing-caller-ids) for your account. If the `to` parameter is a phone number, `from` must also be a phone number. If `to` is sip address, this value of `from` should be a username portion to be used to populate the P-Asserted-Identity header that is passed to the SIP endpoint.

fields.name: To
fields.description: The phone number, SIP address, or Client identifier that received this call. Phone numbers are in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format (e.g., +16175551212). SIP addresses are formatted as `sip:name@company.com`. Client identifiers are formatted `client:name`. [Custom parameters](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/conference-participant-resource#custom-parameters) may also be specified.

fields.name: StatusCallback
fields.description: The URL we should call using the `status_callback_method` to send status information to your application.

fields.name: StatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use to call `status_callback`. Can be: `GET` and `POST` and defaults to `POST`.

fields.name: StatusCallbackEvent
fields.description: The conference state changes that should generate a call to `status_callback`. Can be: `initiated`, `ringing`, `answered`, and `completed`. Separate multiple values with a space. The default value is `completed`.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: A label for this participant. If one is supplied, it may subsequently be used to fetch, update or delete the participant.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.description: The number of seconds that we should allow the phone to ring before assuming there is no answer. Can be an integer between `5` and `600`, inclusive. The default value is `60`. We always add a 5-second timeout buffer to outgoing calls, so  value of 10 would result in an actual timeout that was closer to 15 seconds.

fields.name: Record
fields.description: Whether to record the participant and their conferences, including the time between conferences. Can be `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.

fields.name: Muted
fields.description: Whether the agent is muted in the conference. Can be `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.

fields.name: Beep
fields.description: Whether to play a notification beep to the conference when the participant joins. Can be: `true`, `false`, `onEnter`, or `onExit`. The default value is `true`.

fields.name: StartConferenceOnEnter
fields.description: Whether to start the conference when the participant joins, if it has not already started. Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `true`. If `false` and the conference has not started, the participant is muted and hears background music until another participant starts the conference.

fields.name: EndConferenceOnExit
fields.description: Whether to end the conference when the participant leaves. Can be: `true` or `false` and defaults to `false`.

fields.name: WaitUrl
fields.description: The URL we should call using the `wait_method` for the music to play while participants are waiting for the conference to start. The default value is the URL of our standard hold music. [Learn more about hold music](https://www.twilio.com/labs/twimlets/holdmusic).

fields.name: WaitMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use to call `wait_url`. Can be `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. When using a static audio file, this should be `GET` so that we can cache the file.

fields.name: EarlyMedia
fields.description: Whether to allow an agent to hear the state of the outbound call, including ringing or disconnect messages. Can be: `true` or `false` and defaults to `true`.

fields.name: MaxParticipants
fields.description: The maximum number of participants in the conference. Can be a positive integer from `2` to `250`. The default value is `250`.

fields.name: ConferenceRecord
fields.description: Whether to record the conference the participant is joining. Can be: `true`, `false`, `record-from-start`, and `do-not-record`. The default value is `false`.

fields.name: ConferenceTrim
fields.description: Whether to trim leading and trailing silence from the conference recording. Can be: `trim-silence` or `do-not-trim` and defaults to `trim-silence`.

fields.name: ConferenceStatusCallback
fields.description: The URL we should call using the `conference_status_callback_method` when the conference events in `conference_status_callback_event` occur. Only the value set by the first participant to join the conference is used. Subsequent `conference_status_callback` values are ignored.

fields.name: ConferenceStatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use to call `conference_status_callback`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and defaults to `POST`.

fields.name: ConferenceStatusCallbackEvent
fields.description: The conference state changes that should generate a call to `conference_status_callback`. Can be: `start`, `end`, `join`, `leave`, `mute`, `hold`, `modify`, `speaker`, and `announcement`. Separate multiple values with a space. Defaults to `start end`.

fields.name: RecordingChannels
fields.description: The recording channels for the final recording. Can be: `mono` or `dual` and the default is `mono`.

fields.name: RecordingStatusCallback
fields.description: The URL that we should call using the `recording_status_callback_method` when the recording status changes.

fields.name: RecordingStatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use when we call `recording_status_callback`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and defaults to `POST`.

fields.name: SipAuthUsername
fields.description: The SIP username used for authentication.

fields.name: SipAuthPassword
fields.description: The SIP password for authentication.

fields.name: Region
fields.description: The [region](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/223132167-How-global-low-latency-routing-and-region-selection-work-for-conferences-and-Client-calls) where we should mix the recorded audio. Can be:`us1`, `ie1`, `de1`, `sg1`, `br1`, `au1`, or `jp1`.

fields.name: ConferenceRecordingStatusCallback
fields.description: The URL we should call using the `conference_recording_status_callback_method` when the conference recording is available.

fields.name: ConferenceRecordingStatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use to call `conference_recording_status_callback`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and defaults to `POST`.

fields.name: RecordingStatusCallbackEvent
fields.description: The recording state changes that should generate a call to `recording_status_callback`. Can be: `started`, `in-progress`, `paused`, `resumed`, `stopped`, `completed`, `failed`, and `absent`. Separate multiple values with a space, ex: `'in-progress completed failed'`.

fields.name: ConferenceRecordingStatusCallbackEvent
fields.description: The conference recording state changes that generate a call to `conference_recording_status_callback`. Can be: `in-progress`, `completed`, `failed`, and `absent`. Separate multiple values with a space, ex: `'in-progress completed failed'`

fields.name: Coaching
fields.description: Whether the participant is coaching another call. Can be: `true` or `false`. If not present, defaults to `false` unless `call_sid_to_coach` is defined. If `true`, `call_sid_to_coach` must be defined.

fields.name: CallSidToCoach
fields.description: The SID of the participant who is being `coached`. The participant being coached is the only participant who can hear the participant who is `coaching`.

fields.name: JitterBufferSize
fields.description: Jitter buffer size for the connecting participant. Twilio will use this setting to apply Jitter Buffer before participant's audio is mixed into the conference. Can be: `off`, `small`, `medium`, and `large`. Default to `large`.

fields.name: Byoc
fields.description: The SID of a BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) trunk to route this call with. Note that `byoc` is only meaningful when `to` is a phone number; it will otherwise be ignored. (Beta)

fields.name: CallerId
fields.description: The phone number, Client identifier, or username portion of SIP address that made this call. Phone numbers are in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format (e.g., +16175551212). Client identifiers are formatted `client:name`. If using a phone number, it must be a Twilio number or a Verified [outgoing caller id](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/outgoing-caller-ids) for your account. If the `to` parameter is a phone number, `callerId` must also be a phone number. If `to` is sip address, this value of `callerId` should be a username portion to be used to populate the From header that is passed to the SIP endpoint.

fields.name: CallReason
fields.description: The Reason for the outgoing call. Use it to specify the purpose of the call that is presented on the called party's phone. (Branded Calls Beta)

fields.name: RecordingTrack
fields.description: The audio track to record for the call. Can be: `inbound`, `outbound` or `both`. The default is `both`. `inbound` records the audio that is received by Twilio. `outbound` records the audio that is sent from Twilio. `both` records the audio that is received and sent by Twilio.

fields.name: TimeLimit
fields.description: The maximum duration of the call in seconds. Constraints depend on account and configuration.

fields.name: MachineDetection
fields.description: Whether to detect if a human, answering machine, or fax has picked up the call. Can be: `Enable` or `DetectMessageEnd`. Use `Enable` if you would like us to return `AnsweredBy` as soon as the called party is identified. Use `DetectMessageEnd`, if you would like to leave a message on an answering machine. For more information, see [Answering Machine Detection](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/answering-machine-detection).

fields.name: MachineDetectionTimeout
fields.description: The number of seconds that we should attempt to detect an answering machine before timing out and sending a voice request with `AnsweredBy` of `unknown`. The default timeout is 30 seconds.

fields.name: MachineDetectionSpeechThreshold
fields.description: The number of milliseconds that is used as the measuring stick for the length of the speech activity, where durations lower than this value will be interpreted as a human and longer than this value as a machine. Possible Values: 1000-6000. Default: 2400.

fields.name: MachineDetectionSpeechEndThreshold
fields.description: The number of milliseconds of silence after speech activity at which point the speech activity is considered complete. Possible Values: 500-5000. Default: 1200.

fields.name: MachineDetectionSilenceTimeout
fields.description: The number of milliseconds of initial silence after which an `unknown` AnsweredBy result will be returned. Possible Values: 2000-10000. Default: 5000.

fields.name: AmdStatusCallback
fields.description: The URL that we should call using the `amd_status_callback_method` to notify customer application whether the call was answered by human, machine or fax.

fields.name: AmdStatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use when calling the `amd_status_callback` URL. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`.

fields.name: Trim
fields.description: Whether to trim any leading and trailing silence from the participant recording. Can be: `trim-silence` or `do-not-trim` and the default is `trim-silence`.

fields.name: CallToken
fields.description: A token string needed to invoke a forwarded call. A call_token is generated when an incoming call is received on a Twilio number. Pass an incoming call's call_token value to a forwarded call via the call_token parameter when creating a new call. A forwarded call should bear the same CallerID of the original incoming call.

fields.name: IdempotencyKey
fields.description: A unique token that will be used to ensure that multiple API calls with the same information do not result in multiple transactions. This should be a unique string value per API call and can be a randomly generated.

fields.name: StatusCallback
fields.description: Provide an absolute or relative URL to receive status updates regarding your Pay session. Read more about the [expected StatusCallback values](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/payment-resource#statuscallback)

fields.name: ChargeAmount
fields.description: A positive decimal value less than 1,000,000 to charge against the credit card or bank account. Default currency can be overwritten with `currency` field. Leave blank or set to 0 to tokenize.

fields.name: Currency
fields.description: The currency of the `charge_amount`, formatted as [ISO 4127](http://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/currency_codes.htm) format. The default value is `USD` and all values allowed from the Pay Connector are accepted.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: The description can be used to provide more details regarding the transaction. This information is submitted along with the payment details to the Payment Connector which are then posted on the transactions.

fields.name: Input
fields.description: A list of inputs that should be accepted. Currently only `dtmf` is supported. All digits captured during a pay session are redacted from the logs.

fields.name: MinPostalCodeLength
fields.description: A positive integer that is used to validate the length of the `PostalCode` inputted by the user. User must enter this many digits.

fields.name: Parameter
fields.description: A single-level JSON object used to pass custom parameters to payment processors. (Required for ACH payments). The information that has to be included here depends on the <Pay> Connector. [Read more](https://www.twilio.com/console/voice/pay-connectors).

fields.name: PaymentConnector
fields.description: This is the unique name corresponding to the Pay Connector installed in the Twilio Add-ons. Learn more about [<Pay> Connectors](https://www.twilio.com/console/voice/pay-connectors). The default value is `Default`.

fields.name: PostalCode
fields.description: Indicates whether the credit card postal code (zip code) is a required piece of payment information that must be provided by the caller. The default is `true`.

fields.name: SecurityCode
fields.description: Indicates whether the credit card security code is a required piece of payment information that must be provided by the caller. The default is `true`.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.description: The number of seconds that <Pay> should wait for the caller to press a digit between each subsequent digit, after the first one, before moving on to validate the digits captured. The default is `5`, maximum is `600`.

fields.name: ValidCardTypes
fields.description: Credit card types separated by space that Pay should accept. The default value is `visa mastercard amex`

fields.name: FriendlyName
fields.description: A descriptive string that you created to describe this resource. It can be up to 64 characters long.

fields.name: MaxSize
fields.description: The maximum number of calls allowed to be in the queue. The default is 1000. The maximum is 5000.

fields.name: CredentialListSid
fields.description: The SID of the CredentialList resource to map to the SIP domain.

fields.name: IpAccessControlListSid
fields.description: The SID of the IpAccessControlList resource to map to the SIP domain.

fields.name: CredentialListSid
fields.description: The SID of the CredentialList resource to map to the SIP domain.

fields.name: CredentialListSid
fields.description: A 34 character string that uniquely identifies the CredentialList resource to map to the SIP domain.

fields.name: FriendlyName
fields.description: A human readable descriptive text that describes the CredentialList, up to 64 characters long.

fields.name: Username
fields.description: The username that will be passed when authenticating SIP requests. The username should be sent in response to Twilio's challenge of the initial INVITE. It can be up to 32 characters long.

fields.name: Password
fields.description: The password that the username will use when authenticating SIP requests. The password must be a minimum of 12 characters, contain at least 1 digit, and have mixed case. (eg `IWasAtSignal2018`)

fields.name: DomainName
fields.description: The unique address you reserve on Twilio to which you route your SIP traffic. Domain names can contain letters, digits, and "-" and must end with `sip.twilio.com`.

fields.name: FriendlyName
fields.description: A descriptive string that you created to describe the resource. It can be up to 64 characters long.

fields.name: VoiceUrl
fields.description: The URL we should when the domain receives a call.

fields.name: VoiceMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use to call `voice_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST`.

fields.name: VoiceFallbackUrl
fields.description: The URL that we should call when an error occurs while retrieving or executing the TwiML from `voice_url`.

fields.name: VoiceFallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use to call `voice_fallback_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST`.

fields.name: VoiceStatusCallbackUrl
fields.description: The URL that we should call to pass status parameters (such as call ended) to your application.

fields.name: VoiceStatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The HTTP method we should use to call `voice_status_callback_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST`.

fields.name: SipRegistration
fields.description: Whether to allow SIP Endpoints to register with the domain to receive calls. Can be `true` or `false`. `true` allows SIP Endpoints to register with the domain to receive calls, `false` does not.

fields.name: EmergencyCallingEnabled
fields.description: Whether emergency calling is enabled for the domain. If enabled, allows emergency calls on the domain from phone numbers with validated addresses.

fields.name: Secure
fields.description: Whether secure SIP is enabled for the domain. If enabled, TLS will be enforced and SRTP will be negotiated on all incoming calls to this sip domain.

fields.name: ByocTrunkSid
fields.description: The SID of the BYOC Trunk(Bring Your Own Carrier) resource that the Sip Domain will be associated with.

fields.name: EmergencyCallerSid
fields.description: Whether an emergency caller sid is configured for the domain. If present, this phone number will be used as the callback for the emergency call.

fields.name: IpAccessControlListSid
fields.description: The unique id of the IP access control list to map to the SIP domain.

fields.name: FriendlyName
fields.description: A human readable descriptive text that describes the IpAccessControlList, up to 255 characters long.

fields.name: FriendlyName
fields.description: A human readable descriptive text for this resource, up to 255 characters long.

fields.name: IpAddress
fields.description: An IP address in dotted decimal notation from which you want to accept traffic. Any SIP requests from this IP address will be allowed by Twilio. IPv4 only supported today.

fields.name: CidrPrefixLength
fields.description: An integer representing the length of the CIDR prefix to use with this IP address when accepting traffic. By default the entire IP address is used.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The user-specified name of this Siprec, if one was given when the Siprec was created. This may be used to stop the Siprec.

fields.name: ConnectorName
fields.description: Unique name used when configuring the connector via Marketplace Add-on.

fields.name: StatusCallback
fields.description: Absolute URL of the status callback.

fields.name: StatusCallbackMethod
fields.description: The http method for the status_callback (one of GET, POST).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
The query parameter is used to search text-based fields for records that match specific query terms. The query can be multiple words or numbers. Every record that matches the beginning of any word or number in the query string is returned.

For example, you might want to search for records related to Tesla vehicles: `query=Tesla`. In this example the API would return every record for the given custom object where any of the text fields contain the word 'Tesla'.

If needed, you could include multiple words or numbers in your search. For example: `query=Tesla Honda 2020`. This would be URL encoded as `query=Tesla%20Honda%202020`. In this example, the API would return every record for the custom object for which any of the text fields contained 'Tesla', 'Honda', or '2020'.

functions.name: basename
functions.description:
Retrieves the base name of the file from the provided location,
which is the last element of the path.
Trailing path separators are removed before extracting the last element.
```ballerina
 string name = check file:basename("/A/B/C.txt");
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of file path

return.description: The name of the file or else a `file:Error` if the path is invalid

functions.name: copy
functions.description:
Copy the file/directory in the old path to the new path.
```ballerina
check file:copy("/A/B/C", "/A/B/D", true);
```

parameters.name: sourcePath
parameters.description: String value of the old file path

parameters.name: destinationPath
parameters.description: String value of the new file path

parameters.name: options
parameters.description:
Parameter to denote how the copy operation should be done. Supported options are,
`REPLACE_EXISTING` - Replace the target path if it already exists,
`COPY_ATTRIBUTES` - Copy the file attributes as well to the target,
`NO_FOLLOW_LINKS` - If source is a symlink, only the link is copied, not the target of the link.

functions.name: create
functions.description:
Creates a file in the specified file path.
Truncates if the file already exists in the given path.
```ballerina
check file:create("bar.txt");
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of the file path

functions.name: createDir
functions.description:
Creates a new directory with the specified name.
```ballerina
check file:createDir("foo/bar");
```

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: Directory name

parameters.name: option
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the `createDir` should create non-existing parent directories. The default is only to
create the given current directory.

return.description: A `file:Error` if the directory creation failed

functions.name: createTemp
functions.description:
Creates a temporary file.
```ballerina
string tmpFile = check file:createTemp();
```

parameters.name: suffix
parameters.description: Optional file suffix

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Optional file prefix

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description:
The directory path where the temp file should be created. If not specified,
temp file will be created in the default temp directory of the OS.

return.description: Temporary file path or else a `file:Error` if there is an error

functions.name: createTempDir
functions.description:
Creates a temporary directory.
```ballerina
string tmpDir = check file:createTempDir();
```

parameters.name: suffix
parameters.description: Optional directory suffix

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Optional directory prefix

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description:
The directory path where the temp directory should be created. If not specified, temp directory
will be created in the default temp directory of the OS.

return.description: Temporary directory path or else a `file:Error` if there is an error

functions.name: getAbsolutePath
functions.description:
Retrieves the absolute path from the provided location.
```ballerina
 string absolutePath = check file:getAbsolutePath("test.txt");
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of the file path free from potential malicious codes

return.description: The absolute path reference or else a `file:Error` if the path cannot be derived

functions.name: getCurrentDir
functions.description:
Returns the current working directory.
```ballerina
string dirPath = file:getCurrentDir();
```

return.description: Current working directory or else an empty string if the current working directory cannot be determined

functions.name: getMetaData
functions.description:
Returns the metadata information of the file specified in the file path.
```ballerina
file:MetaData result = check file:getMetaData("foo/bar.txt");
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of the file path.

return.description: The `MetaData` instance with the file metadata or else a `file:Error`

functions.name: isAbsolutePath
functions.description:
Reports whether the path is absolute.
A path is absolute if it is independent of the current directory.
On Unix, a path is absolute if it starts with the root.
On Windows, a path is absolute if it has a prefix and starts with the root: c:\windows.
```ballerina
 boolean isAbsolute = check file:isAbsolutePath("/A/B/C");
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of the file path

return.description:
`true` if path is absolute, `false` otherwise, or else an `file:Error`
occurred if the path is invalid

functions.name: joinPath
functions.description:
Joins any number of path elements into a single path.
```ballerina
 string path = check file:joinPath("/", "foo", "bar");
```

parameters.name: parts
parameters.description: String values of the file path parts

return.description: String value of the file path or else a `file:Error` if the parts are invalid

functions.name: normalizePath
functions.description:
Normalizes a path value.
```ballerina
 string normalizedPath = check file:normalizePath("foo/../bar", file:CLEAN);
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of the file path

parameters.name: option
parameters.description:
Normalization option. Supported options are,
`CLEAN` - Get the shortest path name equivalent to the given path by eliminating multiple separators, '.', and '..',
`SYMLINK` - Evaluate a symlink,
`NORMCASE` - Normalize the case of a pathname. On windows, all the characters are converted to lowercase and "/" is
converted to "\\".

return.description: Normalized file path or else a `file:Error` if the path is invalid

functions.name: parentPath
functions.description:
Returns the enclosing parent directory.
If the path is empty, parent returns ".".
The returned path does not end in a separator unless it is the root directory.
```ballerina
 string parentPath = check file:parentPath("/A/B/C.txt");
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of the file/directory path

return.description:
Path of the parent directory or else a `file:Error`
if an error occurred while getting the parent directory

functions.name: readDir
functions.description:
Reads the directory and returns a list of metadata of files and directories
inside the specified directory.
```ballerina
file:MetaData[] results = check file:readDir("foo/bar");
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of the directory path

return.description: The `MetaData` array or else a `file:Error` if there is an error

functions.name: relativePath
functions.description:
Returns a relative path, which is logically equivalent to the target path when joined to the base path with an
intervening separator.
An error is returned if the target path cannot be made relative to the base path.
```ballerina
 string relative = check file:relativePath("a/b/e", "a/c/d");
```

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: String value of the base file path

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: String value of the target file path

return.description:
The target path relative to the base path, or else an
`file:Error` if target path cannot be made relative to the base path

functions.name: remove
functions.description:
Removes the specified file or directory.
```ballerina
check file:remove("foo/bar.txt");
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of the file/directory path

parameters.name: option
parameters.description: Indicates whether the `remove` should recursively remove all the files inside the given directory

functions.name: rename
functions.description:
Renames(Moves) the old path with the new path.
If the new path already exists and it is not a directory, this replaces the file.
```ballerina
check file:rename("/A/B/C", "/A/B/D");
```

parameters.name: oldPath
parameters.description: String value of the old file path

parameters.name: newPath
parameters.description: String value of the new file path

functions.name: splitPath
functions.description:
Splits a list of paths joined by the OS-specific path separator.
```ballerina
 string[] parts = check file:splitPath("/A/B/C");
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of the file path

return.description: String array of the path components or else a `file:Error` if the path is invalid

functions.name: test
functions.description:
Tests a file path against a test condition .
```ballerina
boolean result = check file:test("foo/bar.txt", file:EXISTS);
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String value of the file path

parameters.name: testOption
parameters.description:
The option to be tested upon the path. Supported options are,
`EXISTS` - Test whether a file path exists,
`IS_DIR` - Test whether a file path is a directory,
`IS_SYMLINK` - Test whether a file path is a symlink,
`READABLE` - Test whether a file path is readable,
`WRITABLE` - Test whether a file path is writable.

return.description: True/false depending on the option to be tested or else a `file:Error` if there is an error

Executes a GraphQL document and data binds the GraphQL response to a record with data and extensions

parameters.name: document
parameters.description:
The GraphQL document. It can include queries & mutations.
For example `query OperationName($code:ID!) {country(code:$code) {name}}`.

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: The GraphQL variables. For example `{"code": "<variable_value>"}`.

parameters.name: operationName
parameters.description:
The GraphQL operation name. If a request has two or more operations, then each operation must have a name.
A request can only execute one operation, so you must also include the operation name to execute.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: The GraphQL API headers to execute each query

parameters.name: targetType
parameters.description:
The payload, which is expected to be returned after data binding. For example
`type CountryByCodeResponse record {| map<json?> extensions?; record {| record{|string name;|}? country; |} data;`

return.description:
The GraphQL response or a `graphql:ClientError` if failed to execute the query

services.instructions:
# Service writing instructions

- GraphQL Service always requires a graphql listener to be attatched to it.
- Service requires base path to be set. Specify /graphql if not specified explictily by the user query.
- Figure out are the Query and Mutation operations required based on the user query.
- Input fields are represented by function parameters. Only use records and basic types as types for input parameters.

## Query
- Represented by resource functions.

## Mutation
- Represented by remote functions.

The Amazon SQS API Client.

Provides access to Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) using the AWS SDK for Java V2.
Supports static and profile-based credential configurations.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initializes the Amazon SQS client with the provided connection configuration.

parameters.name: connectionConfig
parameters.description: The Amazon SQS client configuration

return.description: The `sqs:Client` instance or `sqs:Error` if initialization fails

functions.name: sendMessage
functions.description: Delivers a message to the specified SQS queue.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the Amazon SQS queue to which the message is sent

parameters.name: messageBody
parameters.description: Message to send; minimum size is 1 byte and maximum is 262,144 bytes (256 KiB)

parameters.name: sendMessageConfig
parameters.description: Optional parameters such as `delaySeconds`, `messageAttributes`, `messageSystemAttributes`, `messageDeduplicationId`, and `messageGroupId`

return.description: A `sqs:SendMessageResponse` on success, or an `sqs:Error` on failure

functions.name: receiveMessage
functions.description: Retrieves one or more messages from the specified queue.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the Amazon SQS queue from which messages are received

parameters.name: receiveMessageConfig
parameters.description: Optional parameters for receiving messages

return.description: An array of `sqs:Message` records, or an `sqs:Error` on failure

functions.name: deleteMessage
functions.description: Deletes a specified message from an Amazon SQS queue using the given receipt handle.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the Amazon SQS queue from which messages are deleted

parameters.name: receiptHandle
parameters.description: Receipt handle associated with the message to delete

functions.name: sendMessageBatch
functions.description: Sends up to 10 messages as a batch to the specified Amazon SQS queue.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the Amazon SQS queue to which batched messages are sent

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: A list of `sqs:SendMessageBatchEntry` records

return.description: A `sqs:SendMessageBatchResponse` indicating which messages succeeded or failed, or an `sqs:Error` on failure

functions.name: deleteMessageBatch
functions.description:
Deletes up to ten messages from the specified queue. This is a batch version of `sqs:deleteMessage`.
The result of the action on each message is reported individually in the response.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the Amazon SQS queue from which messages are deleted

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: List of `sqs:DeleteMessageBatchEntry` records containing receipt handles of messages to delete

return.description: A `sqs:DeleteMessageBatchResponse` indicating which deletions succeeded or failed, or an `sqs:Error` on failure

functions.name: createQueue
functions.description: Creates a new Amazon SQS queue with the specified attributes and tags.

parameters.name: queueName
parameters.description:
Name of the new queue; valid values include alphanumeric characters, hyphens (-), and underscores
(_), and can be up to 80 characters long. FIFO queue names must end with the `.fifo` suffix

parameters.name: createQueueConfig
parameters.description: Optional configuration such as `queueAttributes` and `tags`

return.description: URL of the created queue, or an `sqs:Error` on failure

functions.name: deleteQueue
functions.description: Deletes the specified Amazon SQS queue.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the Amazon SQS queue to delete

functions.name: getQueueUrl
functions.description: Retrieves the URL of the specified Amazon SQS queue.

parameters.name: queueName
parameters.description: Name of the queue; can include alphanumeric characters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and must be up to 80 characters long

parameters.name: getQueueUrlConfig
parameters.description: Optional parameters such as `queueOwnerAWSAccountId`

return.description: URL of the requested queue, or an `sqs:Error` on failure

functions.name: listQueues
functions.description: Lists the Amazon SQS queues in the current region. Supports filtering by name prefix and paginated results.

parameters.name: listQueuesConfig
parameters.description: Optional parameters such as `queueNamePrefix`, `maxResults`, and `nextToken`

return.description: A `sqs:ListQueuesResponse` containing queue URLs and an optional `nextToken`, or an `sqs:Error` on failure

functions.name: getQueueAttributes
functions.description: Retrieves the attributes of the specified Amazon SQS queue.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the Amazon SQS queue whose attributes are retrieved

parameters.name: getQueueAttributesConfig
parameters.description: Optional parameters such as `attributeNames`

return.description: A `sqs:GetQueueAttributesResponse` containing the queue attributes, or an `sqs:Error` on failure

functions.name: setQueueAttributes
functions.description: Sets one or more attributes for the specified Amazon SQS queue.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the Amazon SQS queue to configure

parameters.name: queueAttributes
parameters.description: Attributes to set for the queue

functions.name: changeMessageVisibility
functions.description: Changes the visibility timeout of a specific message in a queue.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the Amazon SQS queue containing the message

parameters.name: receiptHandle
parameters.description: Receipt handle of the message returned by the `sqs:receiveMessage` operation

parameters.name: visibilityTimeout
parameters.description: New visibility timeout value in seconds (minimum 0, maximum 43,200)

functions.name: purgeQueue
functions.description: Purges the specified queue, deleting all messages in it. This action is irreversible.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: TURL of the queue to purge

functions.name: tagQueue
functions.description:
Adds cost allocation tags to the specified Amazon SQS queue.

- A maximum of 50 tags per queue is recommended
- Tags are case-sensitive and treated as plain character strings
- New tags with duplicate keys overwrite existing ones

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the queue to which tags are added

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Map of tags to add, where each tag is a key-value pair

functions.name: untagQueue
functions.description: Removes cost allocation tags from the specified Amazon SQS queue.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the queue from which tags are removed

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: List of tag keys to remove

functions.name: listQueueTags
functions.description: Lists all cost allocation tags added to the specified Amazon SQS queue.

parameters.name: queueUrl
parameters.description: URL of the queue whose tags are listed

return.description: A `sqs:ListQueueTagsResponse` with associated tags, or an `sqs:Error` on failure

functions.name: startMessageMoveTask
functions.description:
Starts a message movement task to transfer messages from a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to another queue.

- Only supported for DLQs whose sources are other Amazon SQS queues
- Not supported for non-SQS sources (e.g., AWS Lambda, Amazon SNS)
- Only one active task is allowed per queue at any time

parameters.name: sourceARN
parameters.description: ARN of the DLQ from which messages are moved

parameters.name: startMessageMoveTaskConfig
parameters.description: Optional parameters such as `destinationARN` and `maxNumberOfMessagesPerSecond`

return.description: A `sqs:StartMessageMoveTaskResponse` if successful, or an `sqs:Error` on failure

functions.name: cancelMessageMoveTask
functions.description:
Cancels an active message movement task for the given task handle.

- Only applicable when the task status is `RUNNING`
- Already moved messages will not be reverted
- Only one active task is allowed per queue at any time

parameters.name: taskHandle
parameters.description: Identifier of the message movement task

return.description: A `sqs:CancelMessageMoveTaskResponse` with the number of messages moved before cancellation, or an `sqs:Error`

functions.name: close
functions.description: Gracefully closes the AWS SQS client and releases all associated resources.

return.description: An `sqs:Error` if closing fails, or else nil
